paper.abstract: Hyperparameter optimization is crucial to achieving high performance in deep learning. On top of the performance, other criteria such as inference time or memory requirement often need to be optimized due to some practical reasons. This motivates research on multi-objective optimization (MOO). However, Pareto fronts of MOO methods are often shown without considering the variability caused by random seeds and this makes the performance stability evaluation difficult. Although there is a concept named \emph{empirical attainment surface} to enable the visualization with uncertainty over multiple runs, there is no major Python package for empirical attainment surface. We, therefore, develop a Python package for this purpose and describe the usage. The package is available at https://github.com/nabenabe0928/empirical-attainment-func. OptunaHub now provides our implementation at https://hub.optuna.org/visualization/plot_empirical_attainment_surface/.
paper.title: Python Tool for Visualizing Variability of Pareto Fronts over Multiple Runs

paper.abstract: By aggregating distributed energy resources (DERs) into a single dispatchable resource, virtual power plants (VPPs) enable the grid to use the flexibility of numerous small-scale DERs. Delivering an aggregate VPP commitment requires multi-agent coordination, where agents manage local DER models and operating constraints while jointly meeting a power commitment within limited communication rounds. Classical distributed optimization is computationally intensive, requiring iterative local optimization and repeated communication to reach consensus. Learning-based methods can accelerate coordination but often lack guarantees of local feasibility and accurate commitment tracking. This paper proposes LOOP-MAC (Learning to Optimize the Optimization Process for Multi-Agent Coordination), a fully decentralized learning-based framework that ensures local feasibility by construction while efficiently reducing the aggregate commitment gap. LOOP-MAC employs a two-stage decision process. Learned coordination uses neural optimizers equipped with a gauge layer to produce locally feasible schedules through a few rounds of message exchange. Local adjustment then rebalances each schedule toward feasible flexibility extremes using a commitment-gap estimate inferred from messages already received. The adjusted schedule remains locally feasible as a convex combination of feasible schedules, and the adjustment requires no additional communication round. On a 100-agent VPP, five communication rounds followed by local adjustment reduce the mean commitment gap from 5.1% to 0.75% of the agents' aggregate absolute power and the optimality gap from 3.93% to 3.07% relative to learned coordination alone. Per-agent online computation takes approximately 1.1 ms, including the adjustment.
paper.title: LOOP-MAC: Learning-Based Multi-Agent Coordination with Guaranteed Local Feasibility in a Virtual Power Plant

analysis.analysis: 作者通过表示等价性分析、信息论下界构造和算法上界证明三条路径分析问题。首先建立离散 MDP、Exo-MDP 与离散线性混合 MDP 之间的表示等价，从而将 Exo-MDP 归入已有可分析框架并引入有效维数 r。接着分别在外生状态不可观测和可观测两种信息条件下构造下界，展示观测外生状态带来的统计收益为 Θ(√r)。最后通过设计算法并证明其上界与下界匹配，说明样本复杂度仅依赖 r、H 和 K，而与动作空间及内生状态空间无关。
challenges: 如何形式化外生-内生结构的表示能力，并给出与现有 MDP 类的等价关系
在外生状态不可观测时如何设计算法以利用外生结构的统计规律
分别刻画外生状态可观测与不可观测下的最小最大遗憾下界和上界，并证明其匹配性
证明 Exo-MDP 的样本复杂度确实与动作空间和内生状态空间解耦

evidence.claim: 论文研究的状态空间被划分为外生和内生两部分，外生状态独立于动作，内生状态确定性演化。
evidence.quote: We study a structured class of Markov Decision Processes, known as Exo-MDPs, in which the state space is partitioned into exogenous and endogenous components. Exogenous states evolve stochastically, independent of the agent's actions, while endogenous states evolve deterministically based on both state components and actions.

evidence.claim: 论文建立了离散 MDP、Exo-MDP 和离散线性混合 MDP 之间的表示等价。
evidence.quote: Our first contribution is structural: we establish a representational equivalence between discrete MDPs, Exo-MDPs, and discrete linear mixture MDPs.

evidence.claim: 外生状态不可观测时的最小最大遗憾为 Θ(Hr√K)。
evidence.quote: When the exogenous states are unobserved, we prove matching upper and lower regret bounds of order $\Theta(Hr \sqrt{K})$ over $K$ episodes of horizon $H$, where $r$ is the effective dimension of the Exo-MDP.

evidence.claim: 外生状态可观测时，最小最大遗憾改进为 Θ(H√(rK))，存在 Θ(√r) 的统计差距。
evidence.quote: When exogenous states are observed, the minimax regret improves to $\Theta(H\sqrt{ r K})$, revealing a $\Theta(\sqrt{r})$ statistical gap due to observation of the exogenous states.

evidence.claim: Exo-MDP 的样本复杂度与动作空间及内生状态空间解耦。
evidence.quote: These results show that Exo-MDPs decouple sample complexity from action space and endogenous state space.

evidence.claim: 实验在库存控制和资源分配两个场景上验证了理论发现。
evidence.quote: We validate these insights with experiments on inventory control and resource allocation.

experiments: 作者在库存控制和资源分配两个运筹学场景上进行了实验验证，以支撑理论发现。摘要未提供具体实验规模、基线算法、数值结果、运行时间或消融研究等细节。
analysis.insight: 论文的核心洞察在于：Exo-MDP 的结构使有效维数 r 而非完整状态空间和动作空间的大小决定样本复杂度。外生状态因与动作无关而可以视为对决策无影响的“可分离噪声”，内生状态的确定性演化则允许算法将学习问题约化为对低维内生动态的估计，从而解耦样本复杂度与动作空间及内生状态空间的大小。这一结构性解耦是该类问题能够实现样本高效学习的根本原因。
limitations: 材料未说明
method: 定义 Exo-MDP 模型：状态空间划分为外生和内生两部分；外生状态转移仅依赖自身且与动作无关；内生状态转移由当前外生状态、内生状态和动作确定。
证明离散 MDP、Exo-MDP 和离散线性混合 MDP 之间的表示等价，为使用线性混合 MDP 的工具分析 Exo-MDP 奠定基础。
引入有效维数 r，并针对外生状态不可观测的情形给出 Θ(Hr√K) 的最小最大遗憾上下界。
针对外生状态可观测的情形，证明最小最大遗憾改进为 Θ(H√(rK))，揭示观测外生状态带来的 Θ(√r) 统计差距。
设计算法分别在两种信息条件下达到所证明的上界，验证样本复杂度与动作空间和内生状态空间的解耦。
analysis.motivation: 现实中的许多运筹学问题（如库存控制、资源管理、共享出行）天然具有状态变量中一部分由外部随机因素驱动、另一部分由决策确定性影响的结构。然而，标准强化学习算法往往需要与环境规模（状态数、动作数）相关的样本复杂度。作者希望回答：能否利用这种外生-内生结构来设计样本高效的强化学习算法，并刻画其统计极限。
analysis.primary_topic: 结构化马尔可夫决策过程的样本高效强化学习理论
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文直接研究强化学习的样本效率理论，属于人工智能驱动运筹优化（AI4OR）的基础方法层。其外生-内生状态分解的结构化建模思想与生产调度中常见的“环境动态（如机器故障、订单到达）与调度决策可分离”的设定高度契合。论文证明的样本复杂度解耦机制可启发设计面向生产调度的样本高效强化学习算法：例如将订单到达、设备随机故障等视为外生状态，将作业排序、资源分配等决策相关状态视为内生状态。迁移到柔性作业车间、流水车间或生产运输协同问题时，需要解决的关键条件包括：建立调度问题的 Exo-MDP 形式化，验证内生状态确定演化假设是否成立，以及将连续或大离散动作空间纳入有效维数框架。上述迁移属于推测，尚需针对调度问题的具体结构和约束进行改造和验证。
analysis.setting: 论文研究一类结构化的马尔可夫决策过程（称为 Exo-MDPs），其中状态空间被划分为外生部分和内生部分：外生状态按随机过程演化，与智能体动作无关；内生状态则根据两类状态和动作确定性地演化。决策对象是智能体在每个决策周期选择的动作，目标是在 K 个回合、每回合长度 H 的设定下最小化累积遗憾。关键约束或信息假设包括：外生状态可能可观测或不可观测，有效维数 r 相对内生状态空间和动作空间较小。环境被视为静态的随机 MDP，未明确讨论动态扰动或非平稳性。
analysis.title_zh: 利用外生结构实现样本高效强化学习
analysis.uncertainty: 由于仅能获取标题和摘要，无法验证实验的具体设计、基线对比、数值结果以及算法的实际计算开销。此外，论文的理论分析假设内生状态确定性演化，该假设在生产调度问题中的适用性需要结合具体场景判断，因此相关迁移建议具有较高的推测成分。
analysis.why_recommended: 该论文为利用问题结构实现样本高效强化学习提供了严格的理论分析，给出了可观测与不可观测外生状态下遗憾的紧界。对于研究生产调度中强化学习应用的研究者而言，其外生-内生分解建模思路可直接启发如何将调度环境中不可控的随机因素与可控决策变量分离，从而降低学习复杂度。此外，论文展示的表示等价与最小最大遗憾分析范式也可为调度领域的学习算法设计提供理论分析工具。

paper.abstract: We study a structured class of Markov Decision Processes, known as Exo-MDPs, in which the state space is partitioned into exogenous and endogenous components. Exogenous states evolve stochastically, independent of the agent's actions, while endogenous states evolve deterministically based on both state components and actions. Exo-MDPs capture many operations research settings, including inventory control, resource management, and ride-sharing. Our first contribution is structural: we establish a representational equivalence between discrete MDPs, Exo-MDPs, and discrete linear mixture MDPs. Our second contribution is statistical. We characterize the minimax regret of learning in Exo-MDPs when the effective dimension r is small relative to the endogenous state and action spaces. When the exogenous states are unobserved, we prove matching upper and lower regret bounds of order $\Theta(Hr \sqrt{K})$ over $K$ episodes of horizon $H$, where $r$ is the effective dimension of the Exo-MDP. When exogenous states are observed, the minimax regret improves to $\Theta(H\sqrt{ r K})$, revealing a $\Theta(\sqrt{r})$ statistical gap due to observation of the exogenous states. These results show that Exo-MDPs decouple sample complexity from action space and endogenous state space. We validate these insights with experiments on inventory control and resource allocation.
paper.title: Exploiting Exogenous Structure for Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning

method: 非线性 ERM：以 E(t)=E(t0)+(1/C_batt)∫[η_c(τ)P_c(τ)−P_d(τ)/η_d(τ)]dτ 描述 SoC 动态，效率 η_c、η_d 为功率的非线性函数
数据驱动：采集 DC 与 AC 功率的完整充电与放电过程数据，基于文献中的非线性效率函数生成训练数据
ICNN 架构：N 层结构 z_i=g_i(W_i z_{i−1}+D_i x+b_i)，f(x;θ)=z_N；约束 W_{2:N} 非负、激活函数凸且非减，以保证输出对输入 x 为凸函数

analysis.motivation: 电池储能对可再生能源并网至关重要，但并网电池功率变换器的部分负载效率呈强非线性。精确非线性模型虽准确，却给优化带来非凸性与计算可处理性难题；而常用线性或恒定效率 ERM 模型会引入模型失配，导致计划与实际运行成本、收益和 SoC 轨迹出现偏差。作者希望找到一种既能保留非线性效率精度、又能保持优化凸性从而保证可处理性的建模途径。
analysis.primary_topic: 输入凸神经网络近似非线性效率并嵌入凸优化以求解电池储能调度
analysis.relation_to_research: 本文与智能优化和 AI4OR 的关联在于：它展示了如何用具有结构保证的神经网络（ICNN）替换优化模型中的非线性环节，再通过上图变换把数据驱动模型重新嵌入凸优化，从而兼顾精度与可处理性。这一“学习模型—凸化嵌入—求解器求解”的模式与学习辅助搜索、数学规划结合神经网络的思想一致，可迁移到生产调度中那些含非线性效率、非线性能耗或非线性速度-能耗关系的约束（例如机床能耗、变频设备效率、运输速度与能耗）。但需注意：本文对象是单电池、单目标、静态 24 小时调度，材料未涉及柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造、多智能体或强化学习；能否迁移到多机、多约束、离散决策与大规模车间调度，取决于是否仍存在可用凸函数近似的非线性环节以及离散变量是否主导问题难度——该迁移属于推测。
analysis.setting: 研究面向并网电池储能系统（BESS）的调度优化问题，决策对象为充放电功率（P_c 与 P_d）及由此导出的荷电状态（SoC）轨迹，目标是在给定价格信号下最大化收益或平滑光伏出力。关键约束包括 SoC 上下限 E(t)∈[E̲,Ē]、充放电功率范围 [0,P̄] 以及充放电效率 η_c、η_d∈(0,1] 的非线性关系；信息假设为效率随部分负载非线性变化且可由数据驱动方式学习。环境为静态的单电池 24 小时调度场景，材料未说明是否考虑动态扰动或实时反馈。

analysis.uncertainty: 证据范围仅包含摘要与部分全文节选，全文中的收益数值对比表、运行时间、训练代价、可行率与最优性差距等关键定量结果未完整呈现，因此无法在此基础上对方法优越性做量化判断。此外，论文与生产调度、多智能体、强化学习等主题没有直接关系，相关性评分主要基于方法论可迁移性而非领域一致性，存在一定主观性。
analysis.why_recommended: 对研究 AI 驱动运筹优化的读者而言，本文给出了一个清晰范式：用带凸性结构保证的神经网络学习物理非线性关系，并以上图方式将其无损地嵌入凸规划求解。该范式在方法论层面与学习辅助优化、数学规划与神经网络结合高度相关，可作为把学习模型安全嵌入优化求解器的参考案例。同时论文提供了与线性模型、非线性模型和混合整数模型的对照实验设计思路，对关注约束可行性、求解质量与公平比较的研究者有借鉴意义。尽管应用领域为电力系统而非生产调度，但其“保结构学习 + 凸化 + 求解器”的技术路线对生产调度中非线性约束的建模具有明确的迁移启发。

paper.abstract: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) play an increasingly vital role in integrating renewable generation into power grids due to their ability to dynamically balance supply. Grid-tied batteries typically employ power converters, where part-load efficiencies vary non-linearly. While this non-linearity can be modeled with high accuracy, it poses challenges for optimization, particularly in ensuring computational tractability. In this paper, we consider a non-linear BESS formulation based on the Energy Reservoir Model (ERM). A data-driven approach is introduced with the input-convex neural network (ICNN) to approximate the nonlinear efficiency with a convex function. The epigraph of the convex function is used to engender a convex program for battery ERM optimization. This relaxed ICNN method is applied to two battery optimization use-cases: PV smoothing and revenue maximization, and it is compared with three other ERM formulations (nonlinear, linear, and mixed-integer). Specifically, ICNN-based methods appear to be promising for future battery optimization with desirable feasibility and optimality outcomes across both use-cases.
paper.title: Towards Input-Convex Neural Network Modeling for Battery Optimization in Power Systems

analysis.analysis: 作者从两阶段随机规划的结构出发，指出追索函数在凸2SP中具有凸性，因此可以选择在架构上强制凸性的ICNN作为代理。分析路径是：先识别传统学习型方法（Neur2SP）因标准NN代理嵌入需要MIP而计算昂贵；再论证ICNN的凸性可转化为LP可表示性，从而在2SP框架内实现代理的精确嵌入而不引入整数变量；最后通过基准问题实验比较训练时间、验证精度、求解时间和解质量，并考察问题规模增大时优势的变化。材料未说明作者是否给出理论下界、分解策略或图表示。

evidence.quote: Two-stage stochastic programming (2SP) offers a basic framework for modelling decision-making under uncertainty, yet scalability remains a challenge due to the computational complexity of recourse function evaluation. Existing learning-based methods like Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Programming (Neur2SP) employ neural networks (NNs) as recourse function surrogates but rely on computationally intensive mixed-integer programming (MIP) formulations.

evidence.claim: 作者用ICNN利用凸2SP的LP可表示性，通过架构强制凸性和LP精确推断，消除MIP中的整数变量并保留精确嵌入。
evidence.quote: We propose ICNN-enhanced 2SP, a method that leverages Input Convex Neural Networks (ICNNs) to exploit linear programming (LP) representability in convex 2SP problems. By architecturally enforcing convexity and enabling exact inference through LP, our approach eliminates the need for integer variables inherent in the conventional MIP-based formulation while retaining an exact embedding of the ICNN surrogate within the 2SP framework.

evidence.claim: 实验显示ICNN训练时间仅略长、验证精度与标准NN相当，且求解时间常显著快于MIP形式并保持解质量，规模增大时优势更明显。
evidence.quote: Comprehensive experiments reveal that ICNNs incur only marginally longer training times while achieving validation accuracy on par with their standard NN counterparts. Across benchmark problems, ICNN-enhanced 2SP often exhibits considerably faster solution times than the MIP-based formulations while preserving solution quality, with these advantages becoming significantly more pronounced as problem scale increases.

evidence.claim: 在最困难实例上最高100倍加速且解质量优于MIP形式。
evidence.quote: For the most challenging instances, the method achieves speedups of up to 100$\times$ with solution quality superior to MIP-based formulations.

analysis.insight: 核心洞察在于：对于追索函数为凸的两阶段随机规划，可以用输入凸神经网络（ICNN）从架构上强制凸性，而ICNN在输入凸且权重非负的条件下可精确表示为线性规划（LP）。这样既保留了神经网络代理对追索函数的拟合能力，又使代理的嵌入不需要整数变量，将原本的MIP形式替换为LP形式，从而利用LP的高效求解器获得计算优势。有效性的来源不是单纯用神经网络替代追索函数，而是让代理的凸性与可LP表示性匹配问题结构，使精确嵌入与计算效率同时成立。

analysis.motivation: 两阶段随机规划的可扩展性受限于追索函数评估的计算复杂度。已有的基于学习的方法（如Neur2SP）用神经网络作为追索函数代理，但将其嵌入优化模型时依赖计算昂贵的混合整数规划（MIP）形式，因为标准神经网络代理的嵌入通常需要整数变量或分段线性重构。作者希望利用凸2SP问题中追索函数的凸性结构，避免MIP嵌入，从而在保持解质量的同时显著降低求解时间。
analysis.primary_topic: 学习增强的随机规划求解方法：用输入凸神经网络作为两阶段随机规划追索函数代理，并以线性规划实现精确嵌入
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文属于AI4OR中“学习辅助优化求解”的方向，具体是用神经网络代理目标或约束函数并嵌入数学规划，与生产调度中的随机优化、追索决策和不确定性下调度问题有概念上的关联。其LP可表示性思路可能启发：在柔性作业车间或分布式制造中，若某类调度子问题的价值函数或惩罚项具有凸性，可尝试用ICNN代理并嵌入LP或凸优化模型，以避免MIP嵌入带来的计算开销。但这是推测，迁移需要满足追索函数或子问题价值函数为凸、可用场景离散化、且ICNN的LP表示规模可控等条件。论文未涉及生产调度、多智能体、强化学习或动态扰动，因此与当前研究的直接关联有限，主要价值在于可迁移的学习增强建模范式。
analysis.setting: 论文研究两阶段随机规划（2SP）在不确定性下的决策问题：第一阶段决策在不确定参数实现前做出，第二阶段追索决策在参数实现后做出，目标是最小化第一阶段成本与期望追索成本之和，关键约束是追索函数的结构与可表示性。信息假设为随机参数服从已知分布且以场景形式离散化（由2SP的常规框架隐含），环境为静态的单期不确定决策，而非序贯动态决策。问题规模与场景数量导致追索函数评估计算复杂，可扩展性成为核心瓶颈。材料未说明具体应用领域、约束类型或场景生成方式。
analysis.title_zh: ICNN增强的两阶段随机规划：利用输入凸神经网络求解两阶段随机规划
analysis.uncertainty: 证据范围仅为标题与摘要，未提供全文，因此无法确认具体基准问题、实例规模、场景数、训练与求解的绝对时间、硬件预算、消融实验和理论保证细节。第一单位和通讯作者在摘要中未给出，无法判断。相关性评分6反映其属于相邻方向，具有明确的可迁移路径，但未直接研究生产调度或强化学习/多智能体优化。
analysis.why_recommended: 对于关注学习辅助搜索与数学规划结合的研究者，本文提供了一个清晰的机制范例：通过选择具有可表示性保证的神经网络架构（ICNN）来匹配问题的凸结构，从而把昂贵的MIP嵌入替换为LP嵌入。这种“架构选择服务于求解器嵌入效率”的思路可迁移到生产调度中凸子问题的代理建模与约束生成。此外，论文强调随规模增大加速更明显，对关注可扩展性和公平计算预算的研究者有参考价值。

paper.abstract: Two-stage stochastic programming (2SP) offers a basic framework for modelling decision-making under uncertainty, yet scalability remains a challenge due to the computational complexity of recourse function evaluation. Existing learning-based methods like Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Programming (Neur2SP) employ neural networks (NNs) as recourse function surrogates but rely on computationally intensive mixed-integer programming (MIP) formulations. We propose ICNN-enhanced 2SP, a method that leverages Input Convex Neural Networks (ICNNs) to exploit linear programming (LP) representability in convex 2SP problems. By architecturally enforcing convexity and enabling exact inference through LP, our approach eliminates the need for integer variables inherent in the conventional MIP-based formulation while retaining an exact embedding of the ICNN surrogate within the 2SP framework. This results in a more computationally efficient alternative, and we show that good solution quality can be maintained. Comprehensive experiments reveal that ICNNs incur only marginally longer training times while achieving validation accuracy on par with their standard NN counterparts. Across benchmark problems, ICNN-enhanced 2SP often exhibits considerably faster solution times than the MIP-based formulations while preserving solution quality, with these advantages becoming significantly more pronounced as problem scale increases. For the most challenging instances, the method achieves speedups of up to 100$\times$ with solution quality superior to MIP-based formulations.
paper.title: ICNN-enhanced 2SP: Leveraging input convex neural networks for solving two-stage stochastic programming

paper.abstract: Modeling scheduling problems with conditional time intervals and cumulative functions has become a common approach when using modern commercial constraint programming solvers. This paradigm enables the modeling of a wide range of scheduling problems, including those involving producers and consumers. However, it is unavailable in existing open-source solvers and practical implementation details remain undocumented. In this work, we present an implementation of this modeling approach using a single, generic global constraint called the Generalized Cumulative. We also introduce a novel timetabling filtering algorithm specifically designed to handle tasks defined on conditional time-intervals. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach, combined with the new filtering algorithm, performs competitively with existing solvers enabling the modeling of producer and consumer scheduling problems and effectively scales to large-scale problems.
paper.title: Implementing Cumulative Functions with Generalized Cumulative Constraints

analysis.analysis: 作者将自然语言优化问题先用固定模板经 LLM 分解为逻辑组件（如 context、objective、constraints），对每个组件生成候选计划步骤并由 LLM 评估器打分，从而把建模过程结构化为可搜索的计划树；随后将其视为序贯决策问题，用 UCT 式规则在备选 RDP 之间探索与精炼，每个候选计划被展开为完整可执行 Python 程序并实际执行，由执行结果给出奖励并回传更新树上的价值估计，以此利用问题本身的求解反馈指导后续计划选择；同时提出块状 Search-then-Apply 策略，在一部分实例上搜索并将最优块内 RDP 复用于后续实例以摊销树搜索开销。
challenges: 长结构化自然语言描述下的长程多步推理难以在一次自回归生成中保持一致
约束容易被遗漏或误译，导致不可行或非凸模型
生成程序可能语法合理但逻辑不一致或与求解器不兼容
搜索空间为计划序列的组合空间，需要平衡探索与利用并控制推断成本
把执行反馈转化为可回传的奖励需要评估器同时衡量可执行性、约束满足与解质量

evidence.claim: 论文提出用蒙特卡洛树搜索在代码合成之前搜索推理分解计划，并以执行反馈作为奖励
evidence.quote: We introduce Monte Carlo Tree Search for Reasoning Decomposition Plans (MCTS-RDP), which performs pre-hoc test-time scaling by searching over decomposition plans and their resulting programs before committing to the final output.

evidence.claim: 标准提示在真实优化建模任务上会遗漏约束并产生不可行、非凸或不可执行程序
evidence.quote: it struggles with long, structured task descriptions, mishandles constraints, and produces infeasible, non-convex, or non-executable programs.

evidence.claim: 每个候选计划被展开为可执行代码并以可执行性、约束满足与解质量评分，反馈回传搜索树
evidence.quote: Each candidate plan is rolled out into executable code, executed, and scored with an execution-grounded evaluator measuring executability, constraint satisfaction, and solution quality; this feedback is backpropagated through the search tree to guide subsequent search.

evidence.claim: 实验覆盖无线优化任务以及 NL4OPT 与 NLP4LP 基准，并优于 one-shot、CoT、Self-Refine 与 OPTIMUS 等基线
evidence.quote: Across wireless optimization tasks and the NL4OPT and NLP4LP benchmarks, MCTS-RDP consistently outperforms strong baselines, including one-shot prompting, Chain-of-Thought prompting, Self-Refine, and OPTIMUS, improving execution success, reward, stability, and optimality attainment.

evidence.claim: 当前实验主要覆盖线性与凸优化，混合整数与非凸问题仍需评估
evidence.quote: The present experiments primarily cover linear and convex optimization formulations, and further evaluation is needed for mixed-integer, nonconvex, and broader domain-specific problems.

evidence.claim: Search-then-Apply 假设搜索阶段得到的计划能迁移到同一分布的后续实例
evidence.quote: the search–then–apply variant assumes that plans discovered during the search phase transfer effectively to subsequent instances from the same problem distribution.

experiments: 在修改版 NL4OPT（100 题）、NLP4LP（242 题）与 100 个无线资源分配问题共 442 个自然语言优化任务上评估
修改版 NL4OPT 通过增加决策变量与辅助参数、引入分层与相互依赖约束、丰富上下文描述来提升结构难度，同时保持凸性
无线任务建模 SINR 约束与用户干扰下的功率分配等场景
基线包括 GPT-3.5-Turbo、GPT-4、GPT-5、Gemini-2.5-Pro 的 one-shot 提示，以及 Chain-of-Thought、Self-Refine 与 OPTIMUS
摘要报告 MCTS-RDP 在可执行成功率、奖励、稳定性与最优性达成上一致优于强基线，但材料未给出具体数值
全文结论段报告成功率高 25–70 个百分点、奖励高 2∼4 倍、标准差低 3 倍、最优性达成最多提升 10 倍（该段以 MCTS-OPS 命名，与 MCTS-RDP 名称不一致）
评估指标包含执行成功率、约束满足、最优性达成、token 用量与端到端推断时间；实验在 AMD EPYC 7513 32 核 CPU 与 NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU 的 Linux 机器上以 Python 3 实现
块状 Search-then-Apply 在 242 实例基准上块大小为 24，每块 SEARCH 实例数为 3，归档 GPT-5 运行共 32 个 SEARCH 与 210 个 APPLY 实例，实际搜索比例为 32/242=13.2%
analysis.insight: 其有效性来自把“如何分解问题并组织建模步骤”本身当作序贯决策对象，在代码合成之前先搜索计划空间，并用真实执行得到的可执行性、约束满足与解质量作为奖励回传到搜索树，从而让搜索直接以优化问题本身的求解表现为信号来区分不同分解方案，而不是把早期建模选择固定下来只做最终候选筛选。
limitations: 实验主要覆盖线性与凸优化建模，混合整数、非凸及更广领域问题仍需进一步评估
Search-then-Apply 变体假设搜索阶段得到的计划能有效迁移到同一问题分布的后续实例
搜索预算可能被花费在探索不一致的分支上（材料提到生成与执行之间存在不一致）
method: 用固定模板和 LLM 将问题描述分解为 context、objective、constraints 等逻辑组件
对每个组件生成候选计划步骤，并用基于 LLM 的评估器进行初始打分

analysis.motivation: 数学优化建模仍依赖专家将非正式领域描述翻译为精确的目标、约束和求解器代码，过程缓慢且易错，微小错误会导致不可行、非凸或次优模型；标准 one-shot 或 few-shot 提示在长结构化描述上容易遗漏约束、产生逻辑不一致或不可执行程序，因此需要将推理期算力投入到规划与建模阶段而非只在最终解阶段做后验筛选。

analysis.why_recommended: 对关注 AI4OR 自动建模与学习辅助搜索的研究者而言，该文提供了一个清晰的把搜索放在建模规划阶段而非最终候选筛选阶段的范式，并给出以执行结果为奖励的评估闭环与摊销搜索成本的块状复用策略，这些机制可直接启发生产调度等约束优化问题的自然语言建模与求解流水线设计，同时其仅覆盖线性/凸问题的局限也提示了向混合整数调度模型扩展的研究空间。

paper.abstract: Mathematical optimization is a core tool in engineering, operations research, and data science, but modeling real problems remains difficult and time-consuming. In practice, an expert must work with clients to translate informal domain descriptions into precise objectives, constraints, and solver-ready code; small mistakes in this process can lead to infeasible, nonconvex, or suboptimal formulations, and the iterative process is often slow. Large language models (LLMs) could automate this translation from natural language to optimization code, but standard prompting often fails on realistic tasks: it struggles with long, structured task descriptions, mishandles constraints, and produces infeasible, non-convex, or non-executable programs. We introduce Monte Carlo Tree Search for Reasoning Decomposition Plans (MCTS-RDP), which performs pre-hoc test-time scaling by searching over decomposition plans and their resulting programs before committing to the final output. MCTS-RDP treats plan construction as a sequential decision problem: given a problem description, it decomposes the task descriptions into logical components and generates candidate plan steps for each component. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) then explores and refines Reasoning Decomposition Plans (RDPs) prior to code synthesis, balancing exploration and exploitation across alternative plan sequences. Each candidate plan is rolled out into executable code, executed, and scored with an execution-grounded evaluator measuring executability, constraint satisfaction, and solution quality; this feedback is backpropagated through the search tree to guide subsequent search. Across wireless optimization tasks and the NL4OPT and NLP4LP benchmarks, MCTS-RDP consistently outperforms strong baselines, improving execution success, reward, stability, and optimality attainment.
paper.title: Optimizing Prompt Sequences using Monte Carlo Tree Search for LLM-Based Optimization

paper.abstract: Data-driven inverse optimization for mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), which seeks to learn an objective function and constraints consistent with observed decisions, is important for building accurate mathematical models in a variety of domains, including power systems and scheduling. However, to the best of our knowledge, existing data-driven inverse optimization methods primarily focus on learning objective functions under known constraints, and learning both objective functions and constraints from data for MILPs remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose a two-stage approach for a class of inverse optimization problems in which the objective is a linear combination of given feature functions and the constraints are parameterized by unknown functions and thresholds. Our method first learns the constraints and then, conditioned on the learned constraints, estimates the objective-function weights. On the theoretical side, we provide finite-sample guarantees for solving the proposed inverse optimization problem. To this end, we develop statistical learning tools for pseudo-metric spaces under sub-Gaussian assumptions and use them to derive a learning-theoretic framework for inverse optimization with both unknown objectives and constraints. On the experimental side, we demonstrate that our method successfully solves inverse optimization problems on scheduling instances formulated as ILPs with up to 100 decision variables.
paper.title: Inverse Mixed-Integer Programming: Learning Constraints then Objective Functions

paper.abstract: Constraint Programming (CP) offers an intuitive, declarative framework for modeling Vehicle Routing Problems (VRP). While classical successor-based CP models can be adapted to handle optional visits or insertion-based heuristics, sequence variables provide a significantly more natural and elegant formulation for these requirements. Building upon our prior work that introduced the initial concept, the main contribution of this article is the complete semantic and operational formalization of sequence variables as a computational domain. Specifically, we formally define the sequence domain and its update operations, and detail the implementation and data structures required to integrate sequence variables into trail-based CP solvers. Furthermore, we introduce consistency levels for associated constraints on this domain alongside specialized global constraints tailored for routing problems. Finally, we demonstrate that sequence variables simplify problem modeling while achieving competitive computational performance on Pickup and Delivery Problems with and without Time Windows, the Dial-a-Ride Problem, and a Prize-Collecting Scheduling Problem.
paper.title: Sequence Variables: A Constraint Programming Computational Domain for Routing and Sequencing

analysis.setting: 研究露 open-pit 矿调度问题（OPMSP），属于长期矿山规划中的复杂优化问题，包含大量运营与地质约束。决策对象为露天矿的生产调度方案，目标是在地质品位不确定性下同时最大化期望折现净现值并最小化调度风险。关键约束涉及运营约束、地质约束以及以预设置信水平满足的概率约束。信息假设为矿体品位存在地质不确定性，环境为静态规划场景（长期矿山规划），动态扰动未说明。
analysis.title_zh: 地质不确定性下大规模露天矿调度的双目标机会约束进化优化
analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据标题与摘要进行分析，未提供全文，因此对算法具体机制、约束处理方式、实验数值、计算预算和消融细节的了解有限；相关性评分基于方法建模范式与调度优化的关联，实际迁移价值需结合全文验证。
analysis.why_recommended: 该论文展示了如何在不预设置信水平的情况下，通过双目标机会约束进化优化显式呈现风险与收益的权衡，并处理多达 112687 个区块的大规模实例。对于关注生产调度中不确定性建模、机会约束、多目标进化算法以及约束可行性验证的研究者，该建模范式和求解策略具有直接参考价值，尤其是将置信水平选择后置为 Pareto 权衡的设计思路，可启发动态扰动和多目标约束优化场景下的求解框架设计。

paper.abstract: The open-pit mine scheduling problem (OPMSP) is a complex optimization problem in long-term mine planning that involves numerous operational and geological constraints. Traditional deterministic approaches often ignore geological uncertainty, leading to suboptimal or unreliable production schedules. Chance constraints provide a framework for handling uncertainty by ensuring that probabilistic constraints are satisfied with a predefined confidence level. In this paper, we consider the OPMSP under geological grade uncertainty and propose a bi-objective chance-constrained formulation that simultaneously maximizes the expected discounted net present value and minimizes scheduling risk. Unlike traditional chance-constrained approaches, the proposed formulation does not require a predefined confidence level during optimization. Instead, it generates a set of Pareto-optimal solutions representing different trade-offs between profitability and risk within a single optimization run. To solve the resulting large-scale stochastic optimization problem, we employ multi-objective evolutionary algorithms and compare their performance against a single-objective chance-constrained evolutionary approach and a deterministic MILP benchmark. We further evaluate the contribution of the problem-specific initialization and mutation components through an ablation study. Experimental results on MineLib benchmark instances containing up to 112 687 blocks demonstrate that the proposed formulation effectively captures the trade-off between profitability and risk under geological uncertainty while providing greater flexibility than confidence-level-dependent approaches.
paper.comment: This version is accepted in Swarm and Evolutionary Computation, Elsevier
paper.title: Bi-objective chance-constrained evolutionary optimization for large-scale open-pit mine scheduling under geological uncertainty

analysis.analysis: 作者从概率决策的角度区分了三类前瞻信息情形：零前瞻对应无条件概率查询，完整前瞻对应确定性逻辑查询，而不完整前瞻要求基于已观测扰动做后验更新。作者进一步将信息视界划分为确定性视界内可直接决策的部分与之后未观测但可通过系统结构（STN 布局、切换策略）推理的部分，并指出挑战主要来自第二部分的概率推理。基于此，作者提出用从扰动概率分布中学习的贝叶斯网络表示各操作受扰动影响的概率，并在在线执行中做后验更新来引导重调度；同时通过理论证明说明当扰动相互独立时影响变量满足贝叶斯网络的独立性假设。
challenges: 不完整前瞻信息下，已观测区间与未观测区间之间的信息衔接与不确定性推理困难。
如何将生产系统结构与运行先验知识统一编码进一个可在线更新的概率模型。
如何量化每个操作受扰动影响的程度并据此决定重调度策略。
在长期成本与系统神经紧张度之间取得平衡，避免频繁重调度带来的破坏。
扩展到作业车间调度与连续过程等其他调度问题时，需要定义问题特定的操作依赖关系。

evidence.claim: 现有方法常假设完整前瞻信息，与现实不符，可能导致次优长期成本与高系统神经紧张度。
evidence.quote: Existing methods often assume complete look-ahead information over the scheduling horizon. This assumption contrasts with realistic situations where schedulers can only access incomplete look-ahead information.

evidence.claim: 作者提出基于贝叶斯网络的动态调度方法，从扰动概率分布中学习网络以表示每个操作受扰动影响的概率，并在在线执行中更新后验分布来引导重调度。
evidence.quote: Our method relies on learning a Bayesian Network from the probability distribution of disturbances. Specifically, the Bayesian Network represents how likely each operation will be impacted by disturbances. During the online execution, when new disturbances become observed, this method updates the posterior distribution and therefore guides the rescheduling strategy.

evidence.claim: 在四个基准问题上与周期式完全重调度策略比较，所提方法在长期成本与系统神经紧张度上取得统计上更优的结果。
evidence.quote: We compare our method with the existing periodically-completely rescheduling strategy (which generates new schedules from scratch at fixed intervals) on four benchmark problems. Computational results show that our method achieves statistically better long-term costs and system nervousness.

evidence.claim: 作者证明若扰动相互独立，影响量化变量自动满足贝叶斯网络所需的独立性假设，并据此指出可扩展到作业车间调度与连续过程。
evidence.quote: we prove that if disturbances are mutually independent, the impact-quantifying variables inherently satisfy the independence assumptions required by Bayesian Networks. As an implication, practitioners can extend the method to other scheduling problems (such as job shop scheduling and continuous processes), provided that they define the problem-specific dependencies between operations.

evidence.claim: 在不完整前瞻信息下，提高重调度频率并不必然降低长期成本。
evidence.quote: under the incomplete look-ahead information, increasing the rescheduling frequency does not necessarily reduce long-term cost.

evidence.claim: 作者将问题描述分为静态部分（结构、机理与调度决策）和动态部分（系统演化、扰动信息动态揭示、长期性能度量）。
evidence.quote: We partition the problem description into two parts: the static part and the dynamic part. The static part includes the structure, mechanism, and scheduling decisions of typical multipurpose batch processes. The dynamic part includes how the production system evolves through time, how disturbance information is dynamically revealed to the scheduler, and how to measure the long-term performance of a dynamic scheduling algorithm.

evidence.claim: 作者指出不完整前瞻在概率决策上不同于零前瞻与完整前瞻：零前瞻对应无条件概率查询，完整前瞻对应确定性逻辑查询。
evidence.quote: the incomplete look-ahead implies a fundamentally different challenge than the zero or complete look-ahead. That is, how to use observed disturbances to update the posterior distribution based on physical knowledge.

experiments: 在四个基准问题上比较所提贝叶斯动态调度方法与现有的周期式完全重调度策略（固定间隔从头生成新调度）。
计算结果显示，所提方法在长期成本与系统神经紧张度上取得统计上更优的表现。
实验还表明，在不完整前瞻信息下，提高重调度频率并不必然降低长期成本；在某些扰动场景下，所提算法在全部重调度频率下均取得比周期式完全重调度策略更低的长期成本。
材料未提供具体的基准问题名称、实例规模、求解质量数值、运行时间、训练开销、计算预算公平性或消融实验数据。
analysis.first_affiliation: 曼彻斯特大学化学工程系过程集成中心（Centre for Process Integration, Department of Chemical Engineering, The University of Manchester）
analysis.insight: 该工作的核心洞察在于：生产过程的内在结构（如 STN 布局与切换策略）使得已观测扰动对未观测区间的影响并非完全不可知——操作之间的依赖关系会被已观测信息传播，因此可以用贝叶斯网络把‘哪些操作可能受扰动影响’这一概率关系编码下来，并在线用新观测更新后验分布，从而把部分前瞻信息转化为对未观测不确定性的可计算信念，指导重调度只做必要且破坏性小的调整，兼顾长期成本与调度稳定性。作者进一步证明，当系统固有扰动相互独立时，用于量化影响的变量天然满足贝叶斯网络所需的独立性假设，为方法的适用性提供了理论依据。
limitations: 作者明确指出，扩展到其他调度问题（如作业车间调度、连续过程）时，需要由实践者定义问题特定的操作依赖关系。
作者指出其贝叶斯网络的独立性假设成立的前提是系统固有扰动相互独立（理论部分给出该条件）。
材料未说明其他局限。
method: 将动态调度问题分解为静态部分（多用途批处理过程的结构、机理与调度决策）与动态部分（系统随时间的演化、扰动信息如何动态揭示、长期性能如何度量）。
给定调度时域与决策时刻，区分确定性视界内已观测信息与之后未观测信息，并利用系统结构推理未观测区间的不确定性。
从扰动的概率分布中学习一个贝叶斯网络，用以表示每个操作被扰动影响的概率。
在线执行时，当新的扰动被观测到，更新后验分布，并据此引导重调度策略（而非按固定间隔从头重排）。
使用 MILP 进行调度建模，并配合动态系统形式化描述（细节见附录）。
理论上证明：若系统固有扰动相互独立，则影响量化变量自动满足贝叶斯网络所需的条件独立性语义，从而支持将该框架推广到作业车间调度与连续过程等问题。
analysis.motivation: 现有多数动态调度方法假设调度时域内具有完整前瞻信息，且常采用纯周期式重调度（固定间隔从头生成新调度），既不利用扰动的概率特性，也不复用先前调度的信息，在工业规模问题上可能导致不可接受的计算时间与高系统神经紧张度。作者指出，从概率决策角度看，不完整前瞻与零前瞻、完整前瞻本质不同：零前瞻对应无条件概率查询，完整前瞻对应确定性逻辑查询，而不完整前瞻要求利用已观测扰动更新后验分布，这一挑战尚未被系统研究。
analysis.primary_topic: 不完整前瞻信息下的动态调度与贝叶斯网络引导的重调度策略
analysis.relation_to_research: 本文面向生产调度中的动态扰动与重调度问题，与智能优化、生产调度方向直接相邻：其核心是用概率图模型（贝叶斯网络）从扰动分布中学习操作受影响概率，并在线更新后验以指导重调度，属于‘学习辅助搜索/学习辅助决策’的一种形态，而非强化学习或多智能体优化。需要说明的是，本文方法不含神经网络、强化学习或大模型智能体成分，求解仍依赖 MILP 与重调度策略；若迁移到柔性作业车间或分布式制造等场景，推测需要重新定义操作与扰动之间的依赖结构、设计相应的影响量化变量，并验证扰动独立性假设是否成立，这些均为迁移设想，而非作者结论。
analysis.setting: 研究多用途批处理过程在动态环境下的重调度问题：决策对象是当扰动（如加工延迟、需求波动）被逐步观测到时，如何更新对未观测调度区间内操作受影响程度的信念并据此触发重调度；目标是最小化长期成本与系统神经紧张度（即对原调度造成的破坏性变更）；关键约束包括设备共享、切换策略、STN 网络结构以及信息限制——调度者只能在每个决策时刻获得部分前瞻信息（确定性视界与预测视界之间信息不完整），未观测区间的不确定性需借助物理结构知识进行推理；环境为在线动态环境，扰动随时间逐步显现。材料未说明具体的调度时域长度、求解时间预算与静态优化模型细节。
analysis.title_zh: 面向不完整前瞻信息的多用途批处理过程贝叶斯动态调度
analysis.uncertainty: 本次分析仅基于摘要与部分正文节选，未获取完整方法与实验细节：无法确认基准问题的具体规模、MILP 求解时间、重调度频率设定、统计检验方式，以及贝叶斯网络的学习数据来源与训练开销；也无法判断其方法在柔性作业车间等更复杂约束下的可行性。因此对相关性评分（6）与方法要点的判断可能随全文细节而调整。
analysis.why_recommended: 本文对关注动态调度与扰动响应的研究者有参考价值：它清晰地区分了零前瞻、完整前瞻与不完整前瞻三类信息假设，指出不完整前瞻下重调度频率与长期成本之间不存在单调关系，并提供了一种用贝叶斯网络编码系统结构知识、在线更新后验来驱动重调度的思路。其对系统神经紧张度与长期成本的联合度量、以及扩展到其他调度问题时可迁移的‘问题特定依赖定义’框架，对生产调度中的约束可行性与调度稳定性研究具有借鉴意义。

paper.abstract: Multipurpose batch processes become increasingly popular in manufacturing industries since they adapt to low-volume, high-value products and shifting demands. These processes often operate in a dynamic environment, which faces disturbances such as processing delays and demand changes. To minimise long-term cost and system nervousness (i.e., disruptive changes to schedules), schedulers must design rescheduling strategies to address such disturbances effectively. Existing methods often assume complete look-ahead information over the scheduling horizon. This assumption contrasts with realistic situations where schedulers can only access incomplete look-ahead information. Sticking with existing methods may lead to suboptimal long-term costs and high-level system nervousness. In this work we propose a Bayesian dynamic scheduling method. Our method relies on learning a Bayesian Network from the probability distribution of disturbances. Specifically, the Bayesian Network represents how likely each operation will be impacted by disturbances. During the online execution, when new disturbances become observed, this method updates the posterior distribution and therefore guides the rescheduling strategy. We compare our method with the existing periodic rescheduling strategy (which generates new schedules from scratch at fixed intervals) on four benchmark problems. Computational results show that our method achieves statistically better long-term costs and system nervousness. In the theoretical aspect, we prove that if disturbances are mutually independent, the impact-quantifying variables inherently satisfy the independence assumptions required by Bayesian Networks. As an implication, practitioners can extend the method to other scheduling problems (such as job shop scheduling and continuous processes), given that they define the problem-specific dependencies between operations.
paper.title: Bayesian dynamic scheduling of multipurpose batch processes under incomplete look-ahead information

analysis.analysis: 作者利用KM迭代的准Fejér单调性性质，将学习扰动设计为可和序列，从而在理论上保证收敛。通过度量次正则性假设，作者分析了参数化的表达能力，证明了其包含所有线性收敛的迭代，并给出了局部线性收敛的保证。此外，作者展示了如何将框架用于增强多种算子分裂方法，如Douglas-Rachford分裂，将不动点迭代的学习加速推广到结构化单调包含问题。
challenges: 如何在注入学习扰动的同时保证KM迭代的收敛性
如何证明参数化能够覆盖所有快速线性收敛的迭代
如何将框架扩展到多种算子分裂方法以求解结构化单调包含问题
如何量化学习扰动对平均情况性能的提升

evidence.claim: 通过注入可和扰动，可以加速Krasnosel'skii-Mann迭代同时保持收敛保证。
evidence.quote: Our idea is to deliberately inject summable perturbations into a standard Krasnosel'skii-Mann iteration to improve its average-case performance over a specific distribution of problems while retaining its convergence guarantees.

evidence.claim: 在度量次正则性假设下，参数化包含所有快速线性收敛的迭代。
evidence.quote: Under a metric sub-regularity assumption, we prove that the proposed parametrization includes only iterations that locally achieve linear convergence—up to a vanishing bias term—and that it encompasses all iterations that do so at a sufficiently fast rate.

evidence.claim: 框架可以增强多种算子分裂方法，并在最佳逼近问题上用L2O增强的Douglas-Rachford分裂算法验证。
evidence.quote: We then demonstrate how our framework can be used to augment several widely-used operator splitting methods to accelerate the solution of structured monotone inclusion problems, and validate our approach on a best approximation problem using an L2O-augmented Douglas–Rachford splitting algorithm.

experiments: 在最佳逼近问题上验证L2O增强的Douglas-Rachford分裂算法，使用1024个独立的问题参数实现，计算解与影子迭代之间的距离。
报告了平均距离随迭代次数的演化，并与标准迭代进行比较，展示了学习加速的效果（具体数值未在摘要和节选中给出）。
实验结果表明，所提出的框架能够加速收敛，同时保持收敛保证。
analysis.first_affiliation: 瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）决策与控制系及Digital Futures
analysis.insight: 通过向标准KM迭代中故意注入可和扰动，可以将学习参数化嵌入迭代中，使得在学习到的问题分布上加速收敛，同时由于扰动的可和性，迭代的准Fejér单调性得以保留，从而维持收敛保证。在度量次正则性假设下，该参数化仅包含局部线性收敛（至消失偏差项）的迭代，并且涵盖所有以足够快速率线性收敛的迭代，这解释了为何学习扰动能够有效加速而不破坏收敛性。
limitations: 材料未说明
method: 在标准Krasnosel'skii-Mann迭代中注入可和扰动序列，扰动由神经网络参数化，以学习问题分布上的加速策略。
利用自动微分通过训练问题优化扰动参数，目标是最小化平均情况下的求解误差或时间。
在度量次正则性假设下，证明参数化仅包含局部线性收敛的迭代（至消失偏差），并涵盖所有快速线性收敛的迭代。
将框架应用于增强多种算子分裂方法，例如L2O增强的Douglas-Rachford分裂算法，用于求解结构化单调包含问题。
在最佳逼近问题上进行数值验证，使用L2O增强的DR分裂算法，比较标准迭代与学习加速迭代的性能。
analysis.motivation: 标准KM迭代对病态问题和参数选择敏感，收敛慢；现有加速方案（如动量、线搜索）虽能改善最坏情况收敛，但可能过于保守，因为实际问题的平均情况性能更相关。L2O范式利用机器学习自动设计针对训练实例分布的求解方法，可显著加速，但需保证收敛性。本文旨在将L2O与KM迭代结合，注入可和扰动，在保持收敛保证的同时提升平均情况性能。
analysis.primary_topic: 学习优化（L2O）框架，用于加速Krasnosel'skii-Mann不动点迭代，同时保持收敛保证
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文研究学习优化（L2O）框架，用于加速不动点迭代，特别是Krasnosel'skii-Mann迭代。这与智能优化和生产调度中的学习辅助搜索、神经网络辅助求解有直接关联，因为许多生产调度问题可转化为凸优化或单调包含问题，并通过算子分裂方法求解。此外，文中利用神经网络参数化扰动序列，并通过自动微分训练，这与强化学习或学习优化中的策略学习有相似之处。迁移到生产调度问题需要将问题建模为参数化不动点问题，并设计合适的网络结构和训练目标，这可能需要额外的领域适应。推测该框架可以用于加速调度问题中的迭代求解器，如ADMM或Douglas-Rachford分裂，但需要验证约束可行性和收敛保证。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是将标准Krasnosel'skii-Mann（KM）迭代加速求解涉及一般非扩张映射的不动点问题。决策对象是KM迭代中的扰动序列，目标是在给定问题分布上最小化平均情况下的求解时间或加速收敛，同时保留标准KM迭代的收敛保证。关键约束包括扰动必须可和（summable）以确保收敛，以及映射的非扩张性。信息假设是问题来自参数化分布，训练时可见该分布下的实例。环境是静态的确定性不动点问题，但可扩展到参数化族；随机或动态环境在材料中未说明。

analysis.uncertainty: 由于仅提供了摘要和部分全文，实验部分的详细数字、基线比较和消融研究未完全给出，因此对实验结果的全面评估存在不确定性。此外，该方法是否直接适用于生产调度中的离散约束和动态环境尚不明确，需要进一步研究。
analysis.why_recommended: 本文提出了一种具有理论保证的L2O框架，能够加速经典不动点迭代，同时保持收敛性。这对于智能优化和AI4OR领域的研究者具有参考价值，因为它展示了如何将学习与经典优化算法结合，并在理论上保证收敛。此外，该方法可扩展到多种算子分裂方法，可能应用于生产调度中的大规模优化问题。论文的严谨分析和实验验证为学习优化提供了新的思路，值得关注。

paper.abstract: We introduce a principled learning to optimize (L2O) framework for solving fixed-point problems involving general nonexpansive mappings. Our idea is to deliberately inject summable perturbations into a standard Krasnosel'skii-Mann iteration to improve its average-case performance over a specific distribution of problems while retaining its convergence guarantees. Under a metric sub-regularity assumption, we prove that the proposed parametrization includes only iterations that locally achieve linear convergence-up to a vanishing bias term-and that it encompasses all iterations that do so at a sufficiently fast rate. We then demonstrate how our framework can be used to augment several widely-used operator splitting methods to accelerate the solution of structured monotone inclusion problems, and validate our approach on a best approximation problem using an L2O-augmented Douglas-Rachford splitting algorithm.
paper.title: Learning to accelerate Krasnosel'skii-Mann fixed-point iterations with guarantees

paper.abstract: To lower the expertise barrier in machine learning, the AutoML community has focused on the CASH problem, which jointly automates algorithm selection and hyperparameter tuning. While traditional methods like Bayesian Optimization (BO) struggle with cold-start issues, Large Language Models (LLMs) can mitigate these through semantic priors. However, existing LLM-based optimizers generalize poorly to high-dimensional, structured CASH spaces. CASH requires coordinated exploration and exploitation both across candidate algorithms and within their algorithm-specific hyperparameter spaces. Yet existing approaches often rely on flat optimization histories that mix observations across algorithms and obscure configuration-refinement trajectories. In this paper, we propose LB-MCTS, a trajectory-structured optimization framework that uses a Monte Carlo Tree Search tree as a shared state for algorithm selection, hyperparameter refinement, and BO-LLM proposer synergy. Within this shared state, BO provides algorithm-specific surrogate modeling for quantitative search, while the LLM exploits path-aware selective memory to generate semantic proposals and reflections. As the surrogate model improves, a reliability-aware proposer policy adaptively shifts from LLM-driven to BO-driven proposals within a unified search trajectory. Experiments on 104 AMLB datasets demonstrate that LB-MCTS consistently outperforms BO-based, LLM-based, and hybrid baselines. Code: https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/open-box.

analysis.insight: 公平评估的关键不在于对各DM指标做平均，而在于把每个DM可接受的让步纳入解质量定义：以让步率向量刻画各方愿意承受的妥协，再用纳什乘积把各DM的评估值耦合成一个整体分数。纳什乘积对任一DM得分下降极为敏感，因而天然要求各主体相对收益均衡，避免均值聚合掩盖某一方被牺牲。同时，让步率使共识解从“严格共同Pareto最优”扩展为“各方均可接受的区域”，使评估框架既能奖励严格共同解，也能在没有严格共同解时识别有效覆盖公共可接受区域的算法。
limitations: 材料未说明

analysis.motivation: 经典性能指标在MPMOP中先对每个DM计算指标再跨DM求均值，隐含假设不同DM上相同的几何逼近质量具有可比评估意义，从而可能偏向某些主体，无法反映异质DM之间的平衡相对收益或真正共识。同时主流MPMOP最优解概念仅限严格共同Pareto最优解，合作形式过窄，掩盖了不存在严格共同解时各方通过让步达成可接受共识的情形。

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文属于多主体多目标优化的评估与解概念层面，而非直接求解生产调度问题。它与智能优化、多目标进化算法和分布式制造中的多决策者协同有概念联系：在分布式制造或生产运输协同中，不同工厂、运输方常可视为异质决策者，各自有目标与可接受妥协范围。论文事实是：作者提出以让步率和纳什乘积评估多主体解集公平性并推广共识解。迁移到生产调度或其他约束优化问题需要条件：需将调度方案映射为各决策者的目标向量，定义各方的让步率或可接受阈值，并将纳什乘积评估嵌入算法选择或搜索引导；这些属于推测，并非作者结论。对强化学习或神经网络辅助求解，该框架可作为多智能体奖励聚合或解选择的公平评价模块，但同样需额外验证。
analysis.setting: 研究多主体多目标优化问题（MPMOP）：多个决策者（DM）各自具有异质偏好或多目标，求解算法需输出解决方案集；研究目标不是直接设计新优化算法，而是提出评估这类解集质量的公平感知度量，并据此重新定义“共识最优解”。关键约束是不同DM的Pareto前沿（PF）接近质量不应被简单均值聚合，因为各DM所重视的目标维度、可接受的让步程度不同；信息假设是每个DM可给出一个让步率向量以量化其可接受的妥协，静态多目标优化环境，材料未说明动态扰动。
analysis.title_zh: 面向多主体多目标优化的公平感知性能评估
analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据标题、摘要和作者列表判断，未提供全文，无法核验四公理的具体内容、让步率向量的数学定义、纳什乘积嵌入的细节、基准问题的规模与算法基线，也无法判断实验是否使用公平计算预算或是否可复现。相关性评分基于评估框架与多主体多目标优化的关联，但因不直接处理生产调度或强化学习求解，评分存在主观区间。
analysis.why_recommended: 对研究多目标生产调度、分布式制造中多决策者利益平衡的读者，该文提供了评估层面的公平性公理化视角和纳什乘积聚合机制，可启发如何避免均值指标掩盖某一方被牺牲；其让步率与广义共识解概念也可迁移到多工厂、多运输方协同场景的解选择与基准设计。但该文不直接涉及调度求解算法，价值主要在评估与概念层面。

paper.abstract: In multiparty multiobjective optimization problems, solution sets are usually evaluated using classical performance metrics, aggregated across DMs. However, such mean-based evaluations may be unfair by favoring certain parties, as they assume identical geometric approximation quality to each party's PF carries comparable evaluative significance. Moreover, prevailing notions of MPMOP optimal solutions are restricted to strictly common Pareto optimal solutions, representing a narrow form of cooperation in multiparty decision making scenarios. These limitations obscure whether a solution set reflects balanced relative gains or meaningful consensus among heterogeneous DMs. To address these issues, this paper develops a fairness-aware performance evaluation framework grounded in a generalized notion of consensus solutions. From a cooperative game-theoretic perspective, we formalize four axioms that a fairness-aware evaluation function for MPMOPs should satisfy. By introducing a concession rate vector to quantify acceptable compromises by individual DMs, we generalize the classical definition of MPMOP optimal solutions and embed classical performance metrics into a Nash-product-based evaluation framework, which is theoretically shown to satisfy all axioms. To support empirical validation, we further construct benchmark problems that extend existing MPMOP suites by incorporating consensus-deficient negotiation structures. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed evaluation framework is able to distinguish algorithmic performance in a manner consistent with consensus-aware fairness considerations. Specifically, algorithms converging toward strictly common solutions are assigned higher evaluation scores when such solutions exist, whereas in the absence of strictly common solutions, algorithms that effectively cover the commonly acceptable region are more favorably evaluated.
paper.title: Fairness-Aware Performance Evaluation for Multi-Party Multi-Objective Optimization

analysis.analysis: 作者将电动汽车充电站选址与定容问题精确建模为混合整数双线性规划，保留非平衡三相交流潮流约束，不松弛整数变量也不凸化交流约束；随后采用空间分支定界作为全局优化算法。为了应对大规模馈线，作者分析候选选址对电网电压和电流的灵敏度，优先处理电网更敏感的候选点；同时分析双线性项和提升McCormick变量在分支定界松弛中的影响，设计顺序边界收紧算法分别收紧双线性变量和提升变量的边界，并用罚函数NLP启发式为分支定界提供热启动。

analysis.insight: Grid-ECO的有效性并非来自简单模块堆叠，而是来自将非凸交流电网物理精确建模为混合整数双线性规划后，通过预求解阶段同时收紧双线性变量和提升McCormick变量的边界；更紧的边界直接压缩了空间分支定界中松弛问题的可行域，从而在保持交流可行解的前提下大幅减少节点探索。同时，利用电网电压和电流灵敏度指标排序候选选址，将搜索集中在电网更敏感的节点上，避免了在大量低价值候选点上浪费分支定界资源。
limitations: 作者未在结论中明确列出局限性；材料未说明
method: 问题建模：建立混合整数双线性规划，包含整数选址变量和整数定容变量，目标为在预算约束下最大化充电桩分配以覆盖普查级充电需求，约束为非线性、非凸、三相不平衡交流网络约束
候选点排序：利用电网电压和电流灵敏度指标对候选充电站位置进行优先级排序，聚焦于对电网影响更敏感的节点
全局求解：使用空间分支定界算法精确求解混合整数双线性规划，以获得近零最优性间隙
罚函数NLP热启动：将积分性约束通过非负松弛变量以不等式约束形式加入，避免直接扰动目标函数；通过自适应更新罚参数μ和η，分别控制二元变量和整数变量的整性违反，使用增长因子λ在二元变量满足整性但整数变量仍为分数时更激进地增加η，否则同时缩放μ和η；每次NLP求解后热启动下一次NLP，最终将解舍入到最近整数点
顺序边界收紧：开发SBT算法，对双线性变量和提升McCormick变量分别推导更紧的边界，以缩小空间分支定界的松弛可行域
预求解组合流程：将罚函数NLP热启动与顺序边界收紧组合为预求解例程，在分支定界前执行，以降低节点探索量和求解时间
analysis.motivation: 电动汽车快速普及需要大规模扩建公共充电基础设施，而随意选址会导致变压器过载、电压跌落和电网不稳定，因此需要从候选站点中系统优化充电站位置与充电桩数量，同时准确刻画电网物理约束；既有方法无法在不松弛整数变量或凸化交流约束的前提下保证交流可行性和最优性，这促使作者求解精确的混合整数双线性规划。

paper.abstract: We develop Grid-ECO, a method for optimally allocating electric vehicle charging stations (EVCS) within a distribution feeder while accounting for EV charging demand at census-level granularity. The underlying problem is a mixed-integer bilinear program (MIBLP) and requires satisfying nonlinear, nonconvex, three-phase unbalanced AC network constraints while including integer siting and sizing decision variables. Existing works cannot guarantee AC feasibility or optimality without either i) relaxing the integer decision variable space or ii) convexifying AC constraints. Grid-ECO solves the exact MIBLP to near-zero optimality gap while prioritizing candidate charging locations using grid voltage and current sensitivity metrics. To solve the MIBLP exactly, we leverage the global optimization algorithm: spatial branch-and-bound (sBnB). To scale the approach to large-scale feeders, we develop a presolving routine that combines i) a penalty-based NLP heuristic for warm-start with b) a sequential bound tightening (SBT) algorithm to derive tight bounds on both bilinear and lifted McCormick variables. Case studies using realistic Seattle city data demonstrate that Grid-ECO substantially outperforms an off-the-shelf commercial sBnB solver. In three of the four test cases, the commercial solver failed to identify a feasible solution or certify optimality within the 12-hour time limit, whereas Grid-ECO solved all instances to a reported optimality gap of 0.00%, with a maximum solver time of 753s. The results further show that tightening both bilinear and lifted McCormick variables reduces sBnB node exploration by up to 98% and solution time by up to 69%, while preserving AC-feasible solutions across all test cases.
paper.title: Grid-ECO: Grid Aware Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Placement Optimizer

analysis.analysis: 作者通过将探测获取与探测处理分离为两个可独立变化的设计维度来分析问题：先固定处理架构比较不同探测设计（分辨率、尺度分布），再固定探测比较不同处理表示，并通过受控消融将探测获取与探测处理解耦。作者还借助 CKA 分析表示对齐程度以解释预测结果，并利用嵌套探测预算分析预算效率。切片有效性几何分析（§IV）用于刻画二维限制的有效性。

analysis.insight: 该工作将探测获取与探测处理视为可分离且相互作用的两个设计选择，并通过沿位置、方向和尺度采样二维限制来显式编码局部几何；其有效性来自视觉表示能够以线性可解码的方式暴露与 ELA 族特征互补的求解器性能信息，但这种互补信息部分反映的是绝对难度而非相对求解器优势，因此表示的可访问性本身不足以保证问题级别迁移下的选择安全。
limitations: 部分互补信息涉及绝对难度而非相对求解器优势，增加的可访问性本身不能保证问题级别迁移下的平均安全选择。
视觉表示更受 50d 探测的限制，尤其在 relERT 上，其主要额外收益在 100d 至 150d 处获得。
在 LIO 下 ELA 在每个所示预算上仍更强，尽管领先幅度收缩。
在 LPO 下 AOCC 曲线不随观测增加而改善且非单调；relERT 下 GeoPAS 与 ELA 在所有预算上均低于 SBS，且曲线存在中间反转。
method: 探测算子：在归一化搜索域中沿位置、方向和尺度采样多尺度二维限制，生成归一化目标值图及有效性掩码。
处理器：使用共享卷积处理器对每个归一化值图及其有效性掩码进行有效性感知卷积编码，并以尺度和幅度统计量对编码进行条件化。
聚合：对得到的各切片表示进行置换不变的平均池化聚合，得到实例级表示。
选择器：使用通用 MLP 选择流水线，将实例表示映射到求解器选择。
对比表示：与经典 ELA 特征和 Deep-ELA 表示在匹配预算下进行比较。
分析设计：进行问题内与问题级别迁移、融合、表示和预算分析，并通过受控消融分离探测获取与探测处理。
analysis.motivation: 连续黑箱优化中不同无导数求解器的相对性能随问题的条件数、模态、可分离性和局部几何等性质变化很大，因此需要自动算法选择。现有流程多将空间填充点设计与手工或学习到的景观描述符结合，当训练与测试问题结构相似时表现良好，但在问题级别或跨基准迁移时往往退化。这引出一个先于模型容量的问题：何种探测-处理器偏差能够暴露在问题族变化时仍然有用的求解器相关结构。

paper.abstract: Automated algorithm selection for continuous black-box optimization depends on what information is acquired from a problem under a limited probing budget and how that information is represented. We introduce a geometric probing framework that samples multi-scale two-dimensional restrictions across location, orientation, and scale, and encodes their normalized objective-value maps with validity-aware convolutional processing and permutation-invariant aggregation. We compare our method with classical ELA and Deep-ELA under matched budgets, within-problem and problem-level transfer, fusion, representation, and budget analyses. We further disentangle probe acquisition from probe processing by controlled ablation. The results show that the proposed visual representation exposes solver-performance information complementary to ELA-family features and retains a relative advantage for relative expected runtime under problem-level transfer, while greater coverage, feature richness, or predictive accessibility alone does not guarantee better selection.

paper.abstract: This paper presents HUANet, a constrained deep neural network architecture that unrolls the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) into a trainable neural network for accelerating parametric constrained convex optimization. Existing end-to-end learning methods operate as black-box mappings from parameters to solutions, often without explicitly incorporating optimality principles or guaranteeing constraint satisfaction. To address these limitations, HUANet embeds a hard-constrained neural network within each unrolled ADMM iteration, where a differentiable correction stage enforces the affine equalities of the primal subproblem. Furthermore, we incorporate first-order optimality conditions into a self-supervised training loss to promote the convergence of the proposed unrolled algorithm. Extensive numerical experiments for benchmark optimization problems and a control application demonstrate and validate the effectiveness of HUANet in accelerating constrained convex optimization solving.
paper.title: HUANet: Hard-Constrained Unrolled ADMM for Constrained Convex Optimization

paper.abstract: Open-pit mine scheduling is a complex real-world optimization problem that involves uncertain economic values and dynamically changing resource capacities. Evolutionary algorithms are particularly effective in these scenarios, as they can easily adapt to uncertain and changing environments. However, uncertainty and dynamic changes are often studied in isolation in real-world problems. In this paper, we study a dynamic chance-constrained open-pit mine scheduling problem in which block economic values are stochastic and mining and processing capacities vary over time. We adopt a bi-objective evolutionary formulation that simultaneously maximizes expected discounted profit and minimizes its standard deviation. To address dynamic changes, we propose a diversity-based change response mechanism that repairs a subset of infeasible solutions and introduces additional feasible solutions whenever a change is detected. We evaluate the effectiveness of this mechanism across four multi-objective evolutionary algorithms and compare it with a baseline re-evaluation-based change-response strategy. Experimental results on six mining instances demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently outperforms the baseline methods across different uncertainty levels and change frequencies.

paper.abstract: We propose ZeroFolio, a feature-free approach to algorithm selection that uses pretrained text embeddings instead of hand-crafted instance features. It reads the raw instance file as plain text, embeds it with a pretrained embedding model, and selects an algorithm via weighted k-nearest neighbors. Our approach is based on the observation that pretrained embeddings can distinguish problem instances without any domain knowledge or task-specific training. ZeroFolio applies to any problem domain with text-based instance formats. We evaluate our approach on 11 ASlib scenarios spanning 7 domains (SAT, MaxSAT, QBF, ASP, CSP, MIP, and graph problems). ZeroFolio outperforms a random forest trained on hand-crafted features in 9 of 11 scenarios, often substantially, and in 8 of them with every serialization seed. It wins 8 of 11 scenarios against a per-scenario-tuned random forest. On the three scenarios with published AutoFolio results from the 2015 ICON Challenge, ZeroFolio comes within a small margin of AutoFolio without any per-scenario tuning. Our ablation study on SAT12-ALL shows that inverse-distance weighting and line shuffling improve performance. We further analyze the sensitivity of our approach to the serialization seed. On the SAT12-ALL scenario, where the random forest is stronger, both methods can be combined via soft voting to achieve further improvements.
paper.title: Algorithm Selection with Zero Domain Knowledge via Text Embeddings

paper.abstract: We develop a homotopy continuation framework for computing Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) points of constrained multiobjective optimization problems. The proposed homotopy map continuously deforms an easily solvable system into the KKT system associated with the original multiobjective problem, yielding a deterministic continuation path. Under the stated regularity and reference-point cone avoidance assumptions, we establish the existence of a smooth, bounded continuation path whose set of accumulation points as the homotopy parameter approaches zero is nonempty and consists of KKT points. The framework is implemented using two numerical continuation algorithms including an enhanced pseudo-arclength predictor--corrector strategy with adaptive step-size control and branch-restarting mechanisms to improve robustness for challenging nonconvex and degenerate problems. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method remains effective even when initialized from nonfeasible points, indicating practical robustness beyond the theoretical guarantees. Comparative studies evaluate the proposed framework against classical scalarization approaches and the evolutionary algorithms. Experiments on benchmark problems, disconnected and nonconvex multiobjective problems, analytically solvable three-objective problems, and a multiobjective IEEE 5-bus optimal power flow problem demonstrate the ability of the framework to compute KKT points in a variety of constrained settings. The results also highlight the effects of initialization and the limitations of continuation-based methods in recovering complete Pareto-front coverage. Overall, the proposed framework provides a deterministic and interpretable approach to computing Pareto-critical (KKT) points in constrained multiobjective optimization.
paper.title: A Homotopy Framework for Constrained Multiobjective Optimization

paper.abstract: Most neural methods for Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are limited to Euclidean settings or simple graphs. In this work, we instead consider multigraphs, where parallel edges represent distinct travel options with varying trade-offs (e.g., distance vs. time). Multigraphs are highly relevant in practice, yet few neural methods are designed for them, and those that do exist face major scalability issues. We address these scalability issues with Node-Edge Policy Factorization (NEPF), which splits the routing policy into a node permutation stage and an edge selection stage. To enable the decomposition, we introduce a pre-encoding edge aggregation scheme and a non-autoregressive architecture for the edge stage, as well as a hierarchical reinforcement learning method to train the stages jointly. Our experiments across six VRP variants demonstrate that NEPF trains and runs up to orders of magnitude faster than prior neural multigraph methods and scales to considerably larger instances, while matching or improving on their solution quality.
paper.title: Two-Stage Learned Decomposition for Scalable Routing on Multigraphs

analysis.analysis: 作者通过对 DR-MOO 做拉格朗日对偶重构来分析问题，将原问题转化为对偶变量估计与多梯度下降交替进行的形式。基于该结构，作者首先设计双环 MGDA：内层循环估计对偶变量，外层执行多梯度更新，并据此分析达到 ε-Pareto 平稳点的总样本复杂度。为消除双采样需求，作者进一步引入大批量采样与梯度裁剪，以适应广义光滑性并控制随机偏好更新中的偏差，从而得到单环 double-clip MGDA 并重新分析其样本复杂度。摘要未提供更细的分析步骤（如具体下界构造或证明技术）。
challenges: 现有 MOO 形式未显式建模数据分布偏移，缺乏鲁棒性保证
DR-MOO 的拉格朗日对偶重构引入对偶变量，直接求解需要双层循环与双采样
非凸设定下、且不要求对偶目标梯度一致有界时，收敛性分析困难
随机偏好更新的偏差与广义光滑性导致的偏差需同时控制
需要设计 Pareto 型解概念并给出相应的平稳性保证

evidence.quote: We propose Pareto-type solution concepts for DR-MOO and develop multi-gradient descent algorithms (MGDA) with provable guarantees.

analysis.insight: 核心洞察在于问题结构与算法机制的匹配：对 DR-MOO 做拉格朗日对偶重构后，原本耦合的最坏情况分布与多目标权衡被拆解为“对偶变量的估计”与“偏好/多梯度的更新”两部分。双环 MGDA 通过内层循环估计对偶变量，因而需要双采样；而作者发现若能同时处理广义光滑性带来的偏差和随机偏好更新的偏差，就可以摆脱双层采样结构。将大批量采样与梯度裁剪结合，正是为了在广义光滑条件下控制这两类偏差，从而把单环算法的样本复杂度从 O(ε^{-8}) 改善到 O(ε^{-4})，且理论不再要求对偶目标梯度一致有界。

paper.abstract: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has received growing attention in applications that require learning under multiple criteria. However, most existing MOO formulations do not explicitly account for distributional shifts in the data. We introduce distributionally robust multi-objective optimization (DR-MOO), which minimizes multiple objectives under their respective worst-case distributions. We propose Pareto-type solution concepts for DR-MOO and develop multi-gradient descent algorithms (MGDA) with provable guarantees. Leveraging a Lagrangian dual reformulation, we first design a double-loop MGDA that uses an inner loop to estimate dual variables and achieves a total sample complexity $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-8})$ for reaching an $\epsilon$-Pareto-stationary point. To further improve convergence, we combine large-batch sampling with gradient clipping to accommodate generalized smoothness and control bias in stochastic preference updates, eliminating the need for double sampling. This yields a single-loop double-clip MGDA with substantially improved sample complexity $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-4})$. Our theory applies to nonconvex problems without requiring uniformly bounded gradients of the dual objectives. Experiments demonstrate that our methods are competitive with state-of-the-art MGDA baselines.
paper.title: From Dual Tracking to Clipping: Provably Faster Distributionally Robust Multi-Objective Optimization

analysis.analysis: 作者利用性能估计问题（PEP）这一凸优化算法分析的精确框架，将其扩展为 Wasserstein 分布式鲁棒版本，从而把分布不确定性显式建模进算法设计的优化目标中。通过分析鲁棒半径对目标函数的影响，作者证明该框架在极限情况下分别回退到经典 L2O 和 PEP 最坏情况设计，并给出高概率泛化界，刻画了样本内 L2O 最优值、样本量与最坏情况 PEP 界之间的关系。

paper.abstract: We propose a distributionally robust approach to learning hyperparameters (e.g., step sizes and momentum coefficients) for first-order methods in convex optimization. Given a dataset of problem instances, we minimize a Wasserstein distributionally robust version of the performance estimation problem (PEP). Our framework unifies two extremes. As the robustness radius vanishes, we recover classical learning to optimize (L2O), and as it grows we recover the PEP worst-case algorithm design problem. We solve the resulting problem with stochastic gradient descent, differentiating through the solution of an inner semidefinite program at each step. We prove high-probability bounds showing that the true risk of the learned algorithm is at most the in-sample L2O optimum plus a slack that shrinks with the sample size, and is no worse than the worst-case PEP bound. On logistic regression, LASSO, and linear programming examples, our learned algorithms achieve strong out-of-sample performance with certifiable robustness, outperforming both worst-case optimal and vanilla L2O baselines.
paper.title: Learning Distributionally Robust First-Order Methods for Convex Optimization

analysis.analysis: 作者把推理问题结构化为隐状态空间中的随机轨迹生成：递归深度对应轨迹长度，并行采样对应轨迹数量，从而把推理时扩展分解为深度与宽度两个正交维度。对于多解约束满足问题，作者用覆盖率 Cov@20 与冲突数衡量多样性，用准确率衡量有效性，并通过消融分别检验随机性与引导项的作用。材料未说明作者是否使用下界、图表示或分解等其他问题结构分析手段。

experiments: 在结构化推理与多解约束满足任务上评估：Sudoku-Extreme、ARC-AGI、N-Queens（8×8、10×10）、图着色（8-vertex、10-vertex），并展示无条件 Sudoku 生成能力

analysis.insight: 贡献有效性的关键在于把随机性放在递归的隐状态转移中，并用摊销变分推断进行训练，而不是在输出端事后加噪。这样随机性在训练时让同一输入暴露于多条轨迹（类似数据增强），在推断时提供可并行的多轨迹探索；同时残差式更新把确定性递归与随机引导分离开，使模型在随机项为零时仍能退回确定性更新。消融显示单纯的随机解码或随机初始化无法复制该增益，说明收益来自变分随机递归框架本身而非任意随机性。
limitations: 深度监督的序列性质限制了训练效率，与 Transformer 相比存在差距，构成向更大基础模型扩展的显著障碍

paper.abstract: How should future neural reasoning systems implement extended computation? Recursive Reasoning Models (RRMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive sequence extension by performing iterative latent-state refinement with shared transition functions. Yet existing RRMs are largely deterministic, following a single latent trajectory and converging to a single prediction. We introduce Generative Recursive reAsoning Models (GRAM), a framework that turns recursive latent reasoning into probabilistic multi-trajectory computation. GRAM models reasoning as a stochastic latent trajectory, enabling multiple hypotheses, alternative solution strategies, and inference-time scaling through both recursive depth and parallel trajectory sampling. This yields a latent-variable generative model supporting conditional reasoning via $p_\theta(y \mid x)$ and, with fixed or absent inputs, unconditional generation via $p_\theta(x)$. Trained with amortized variational inference, GRAM improves over deterministic recurrent and recursive baselines on structured reasoning and multi-solution constraint satisfaction tasks, while demonstrating an unconditional generation capability. https://ahn-ml.github.io/gram-website
paper.title: Generative Recursive Reasoning

paper.abstract: Scalarization is widely used in multi-objective optimization owing to its simplicity and scalability. In many applications, the goal is to generate solutions that represent diverse user preferences, ideally with uniform coverage of the Pareto front (PF). However, uniformly sampling scalarization weights usually induces non-uniform coverage of the PF. We explain this mismatch through the geometry of the scalarization path. As the weight varies, the corresponding solutions traverse the PF at a generally nonuniform speed. Integrating this speed gives cumulative arc length. After normalization by the total length, it defines a cumulative distribution function (CDF) on weights whose inverse selects points at equal arc-length intervals. Building on this insight, we propose SURF (Sampling Uniformly along the Pareto Front). For structured problems, including bi-objective bandits, we derive analytical expressions for this CDF map and the resulting PF-aware weight sampling rule. For general problems, SURF alternates between CDF reconstruction and weight sampling. Theoretically, we show that under provable conditions for bi-objective LS, SURF's CDF reconstruction error converges linearly to an $O(N^{-2})$ discretization floor. Empirically, experiments on bandits, multi-objective-gymnasium, and multi-objective LLM alignment demonstrate that SURF efficiently achieves more uniform PF coverage than baselines.
paper.title: SURF: Steering the Scalarization Weight to Uniformly Traverse the Pareto Front

paper.abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is effective for expensive black-box optimization, but its performance often degrades on multimodal or high-dimensional problems. A promising remedy is to run multiple local search processes, such as trust region--based BO, and allocate evaluations to those with high potential. However, current best values do not always reflect the final performance of each process. We propose a trajectory-aware best-arm identification (BAI) framework that uses optimization history to guide this allocation. The proposed method extrapolates improvement trajectories, estimates final performance, and progressively eliminates low-potential candidates. For trust region--based BO, we theoretically show that the proposed BAI-guided allocation accelerates convergence to the global optimum under mild assumptions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves BO on multimodal problems. We also show that the same mechanism can enhance other local or population-based optimizers, suggesting its potential as a general extension strategy for multimodal black-box optimization.
paper.title: Trajectory-Aware Best-Arm Identification for Local Search Allocation in Bayesian Optimization and Beyond

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate executable solver code from natural-language descriptions of optimization problems. However, existing verification signals focus on whether the generated formulation produces the correct objective value. Such signals can overlook constraint-level errors: incorrect formulations may still produce the same optimum when extra or missing constraints do not affect the tested instance. We propose constraint injection, a verification method that directly tests whether the generated code implements the intended constraints. We use feasible solutions to detect incorrectly added constraints and one-constraint-violating solutions to detect omissions. Together with the optimal value check, these tests verify both the objective and the constraint set. We evaluate this approach on vehicle routing problems (VRPs), which provide a challenging testbed with diverse, tightly coupled operational constraints. We develop VRPCoder, an 8B model for generating Gurobi code from natural-language VRP descriptions, and VRPBench, an expert-verified benchmark spanning 21 VRP variants across four subsets. The verifier serves as a rejection-sampling criterion for synthetic data construction and as a rollout-level reward for reinforcement learning (RL). On VRPBench, VRPCoder-RL reaches 93% overall Pass@1, outperforms Gemini-3.1-Pro Preview on three subsets, exceeds Claude-Sonnet-4.5 by 28 percentage points, and exceeds the strongest prior OR-LLM by 78 percentage points.
paper.comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
paper.title: Beyond Objective Equivalence: Constraint Injection for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling on Vehicle Routing Problems

paper.abstract: Scientific discovery is fundamentally an optimization problem, defined by a vast ``state space'' of theories and experiments, and an evaluation criterion based on quality, novelty, and validity. Large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated exploration of this state space, but we argue that simultaneous modification of the evaluation criteria is equally important. Here, we propose formalizing research as meta-optimization, where the optimization objective itself is also being optimized. Our key contribution is ``consensus objective aggregation,'' where a portfolio of LLM-generated objective functions is combined via correlation-weighted voting, allowing the evaluation criterion to evolve alongside the solutions. We apply this framework to algorithm discovery for planted 3-SAT problems based on digital memcomputing machines. The leading solver from the consensus search reduces median integration steps by more than $38\times$ relative to a tuned baseline at 2,560 variables. Objective ablations show that a well-chosen fixed expert objective can also discover strong solvers, while consensus supplies a stable ranking that mitigates reward hacking behaviors. By bringing objective engineering into the discovery loop, this framework offers a practical route toward more adaptable automated research.
paper.title: Scientific discovery as meta-optimization: a combinatorial optimization case study

paper.abstract: Black-box optimization is a fundamental tool in science and engineering for optimizing objectives when gradient information is unavailable. It becomes especially difficult when the objective function is expensive to evaluate, limiting the evaluation budget to a few tens or hundreds of queries, and when good solutions occupy complex, low-measure regions of the search space. Generative models can supply useful structural priors in such settings, but existing generative BBO approaches bring significant evaluation cost. We identify three design principles for generative optimization under such low-budget conditions: avoid objective learning, optimize in candidate space, and make every evaluation count. Together, these principles motivate separating structural modeling from objective-driven search. We instantiate them in SPARROW, a simple sequential optimizer that maintains a persistent, ranked archive of evaluated candidates and uses a fixed, unconditional generative sampler solely as a corruption-refinement operator. SPARROW requires only access to the sampler's corruption and refinement processes, and never needs to evaluate the objective to train or guide it. Across three complementary settings, probing thin feasible geometry, disconnected high-performing regions, and failure-prone evaluations, SPARROW outperforms classical and generative baselines under strict evaluation budgets. These results demonstrate that separating structural priors from objective-driven search can be effective when evaluations are scarce and the search geometry is challenging.
paper.title: Generative Refinement for Low-Budget Black-Box Optimization

paper.abstract: While traditional hub capacity planning models optimize effectively for quantitative inputs, they often fail to digest qualitative business context. We propose a novel framework where a large language model (LLM) agent iteratively proposes hub capacity decisions guided by natural-language business context descriptions. The key mechanism is a chain-of-thought reasoning protocol: the LLM constructs a structured decision table that maps each contextual item to specific capacity adjustments based on the implied direction and magnitude of changes. The new capacity decision is then validated through a feedback loop with an optimization model, which provides routing-based performance metrics to guide the agent's selection. On a real-world 13-hub freight network in the southeastern US, our framework achieves a 2.8% optimality gap relative to the hidden ground-truth, a significant improvement over the 11.0% gap produced by the traditional optimization model without textual business inputs. This demonstrates that LLMs can serve as a contextual bridge, integrating qualitative business insights into Operations Research workflows.
paper.title: LLM-Guided Transportation Hub Capacity Planning with Textual Business Inputs

paper.abstract: Time-dependent routing recognizes that the same journey can take a different time depending on when it begins. Under duration minimization, even the departure time of each vehicle becomes a decision. Exact methods for this setting exist in the literature, but researchers and practitioners have lacked a ready-to-use open solver that combines rich piecewise-linear travel times, early feasible solutions and optimality claims. KAYROS fills this gap with two modes on one checker-consistent engine: an Iterated Local Search that streams improving solutions and a Branch-Price-and-Cut method that can issue computational optimality certificates under explicit arithmetic and search assumptions. It installs with one command and has no proprietary dependency. The public MAMUT-routing store currently contains 704 KAYROS certificates under a four-solve publication protocol, which has also led to the retraction and repair of invalid earlier claims. The report presents two complementary benchmark contributions to MAMUT-routing. The first integrates Blauth2024, a benchmark from the literature whose travel times derive from measured Uber speeds, for which KAYROS provides new best-known solutions on all 40 instances. The second proposes Poryos2026, a new benchmark of 1,080 paired static and time-dependent instances built from OpenStreetMap road networks and controlled synthetic traffic. Finally, the report describes the intensive human-AI collaboration behind this work and the verification practices that kept its outputs independently verifiable.

analysis.analysis: 作者将问题分解为离散决策生成与连续完成两阶段。分析核心围绕：用连续松弛 z^t∈[0,1]^m 作为扩散模型与可行性修正算子之间的接口；通过投影算子将中间松弛预测拉向可行集，并给出阈值恢复误差上界，把投影几何与汉明距离、精确重构指标联系起来；当离散决策恢复并固定后，定义连续完成集 X_ξ(z)，再调用数值优化器求连续变量。该分析说明为何在反向扩散全程注入约束信息比只在末端修复更有优势。

CGD uses a graph-based diffusion model and incorporates constraint information directly into the reverse diffusion process, steering intermediate predictions toward the feasible region throughout generation.

paper.abstract: This paper proposes a novel learning-based approach to approximately solve instances of mixed-integer optimization problems. These problems are computationally challenging, as they require jointly determining discrete and continuous decisions while satisfying complex combinatorial constraints. problem-agnostic and can accommodate a broad class of mixed-integer optimization problems through suitable projection operators. We introduce Constrained Graph Diffusion (CGD), a learning-based framework that approximately solves recurring instances of such problems by learning a conditional distribution over their discrete decisions. CGD uses a graph-based diffusion model and incorporates constraint information directly into the reverse diffusion process, steering intermediate predictions toward the feasible region throughout generation. By operating on continuous relaxations of the discrete variables, CGD defines a differentiable constrained generation pathway up to terminal discrete recovery. Once the discrete decision is recovered and fixed, a numerical optimizer solves the remaining continuous problem, avoiding online combinatorial search over the binary variables while retaining numerical optimization for continuous completion. We evaluate CGD on AC-OPF with branch switching and discrete portfolio optimization, demonstrating substantial improvements in feasibility and solution quality over learning-based baselines while achieving speedups of up to $543\times$ over state-of-the-art MIP solvers on large instances.
paper.title: Constrained Graph Diffusion for Mixed Integer Optimization

paper.abstract: Maritime moving-target observation scheduling with agile Earth observation satellites is a dynamic, sequence-dependent combinatorial optimization problem. Sea-surface targets move continuously, causing feasible observation windows to vary with target motion and satellite orbital geometry. The scheduler must jointly determine task selection, satellite assignment, observation-window selection, and observation ordering under time-window, attitude-maneuvering, and onboard-resource constraints. This paper proposes an implicit Q-learning-bootstrapped ant colony optimization method, termed IQACO, for multi-satellite maritime moving-target observation scheduling. Rather than directly learning a task-selection policy, IQACO embeds an offline implicit Q-learning module into constructive ant colony optimization to adaptively adjust the pheromone factor, heuristic factor, and evaporation rate. A compact search-state representation captures pheromone distribution, current and historical-best solution quality, and iteration progress. During online scheduling, ant colony optimization constructs feasible observation sequences, while the learned policy adjusts the search behavior according to the current search state. Experiments on 14 scenarios with different scales and satellite configurations show that IQACO consistently outperforms the compared algorithms, improving the mean objective value over conventional ant colony optimization by 2.86%-9.41%. Further comparative and supplementary experiments demonstrate its effectiveness and robustness across different scheduling conditions and problem settings. These results indicate that offline value learning provides an effective adaptive search-control mechanism for constrained maritime moving-target observation scheduling.

paper.title: Implicit Q-learning-bootstrapped ant colony optimization for maritime moving-target observation scheduling with agile satellites

paper.abstract: Autonomous R&D agents now write, run, and improve executable artifacts under automated evaluation-but largely as laboratory instruments: shown on curated benchmarks, with gains that are hard to trace to a cause and costs well above what sustained engineering practice absorbs. The limitation is structural. Most systems treat each attempt as nearly self-contained, so logs, memories, and search trees record what happened without establishing which design element produced an improvement, whether its evidence survived validation, or how it recombines with others. Long campaigns therefore keep re-learning the same lessons. We introduce Praxist, a lineage-centered generational system that converts reproducible artifacts and evaluator outcomes into a typed evidence graph of findings, lane-structured frontiers, and agendas. Separating local artifact construction from cohort-level evidence synthesis lets later attempts inherit validated mechanisms, unresolved claims, and useful constraints, and leaves results attached to an inspectable lineage. On the standardized 75-task MLE-bench suite, the finalized official-grader results give Praxist 60 medals (80.0%), 49 of them gold, against 55 medals (73.3%) and 34 gold for a Claude Code baseline on Claude Opus 4.8-at a recorded model spend of $3054 versus $38370, roughly a twelfth of the cost. Five case studies-quantitative trading, LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM, tokamak magnetic control, rocket landing, and job-shop rescheduling-carry the same process into open-ended engineering problems, improving on each task-native baseline in headline accuracy, survival, or resource cost, with the discovery path on record. Stronger artifacts at an order of magnitude less spend, each backed by an auditable lineage, are, to our knowledge, first brought together here: the operating profile production research requires, not the one a benchmark demonstration establishes.
paper.title: Praxist: From Experimental Artifacts to Solution Lineages
