paper.abstract: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization, using benchmark instances from recent papers in each area. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget. The strongest model we test, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or outperforms the best method reported in those papers on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less than eight months apart, suggesting that this capability is moving quickly. Thus, for the well-specified operations problems we study, a single untuned LLM query can already produce algorithms competitive with specialized methods. These results suggest that frontier LLMs can be a serious empirical baseline for algorithm design in well-specified OR problems.
paper.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms

analysis.analysis: 作者的分析思路是按决策层的性质进行分层解耦：识别出机组组合问题中的离散决策层，将其编码为 move-based MWIS 问题以匹配硬件可编程结构，同时把连续调度与可行性恢复归入经典计算层，从而在保留可行性的前提下利用硬件求解离散内核。摘要指出通过比较硬件解经经典精修后与精确 MWIS 得到的调度裕度来评估编码与硬件质量，并在扩展节点数时分析编码质量与阵列存活概率对规模化的影响；更细致的理论分析材料未说明。

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文的核心是随机机组组合的离散决策建模与硬件求解，属于电力系统调度而非柔性作业车间或流水车间调度，与当前研究画像的生产调度主题存在明显领域距离。其可迁移之处在于问题分解机制：把调度问题中的离散决策层剥离为图/独立集形式的组合内核，连续与可行性部分交由经典求解器处理，并保留可行性恢复与经典精修环节——这一模式对生产调度中的机台分配、序列决策等离散层与连续时间/资源约束的分层求解有借鉴价值（推测）。若要迁移到生产调度，需要具备可表示为 MWIS 或类似图结构的离散决策层、明确的可行性恢复流程，以及可用的量子或专用硬件后端（推测）。本文不涉及神经网络、图神经网络、强化学习或大模型智能体，因此对学习辅助搜索与智能体优化方向的直接贡献有限。
analysis.setting: 论文研究随机机组组合（stochastic unit commitment）这一电力系统调度优化问题，决策对象包括机组启停等离散决策以及连续出力调度，目标是在不确定性下获得可行且具有调度裕度的运行方案，关键约束通过将离散决策层转化为基于移动（move-based）的最大权独立集（MWIS）问题来编码，连续调度与可行性恢复保留在经典计算层完成。信息假设为随机场景下的机组组合模型，环境为静态优化问题而非在线动态扰动场景；硬件为 QuEra Aquila 中性原子量子处理器，具体场景为绿色氢能调度（green hydrogen scheduling）。其他约束细节与问题规模假设材料未说明。
analysis.title_zh: 面向随机机组组合的后端无关最大权独立集内核及中性原子硬件验证
analysis.uncertainty: 仅有标题与摘要，无法核实方法细节（如 MWIS 编码的具体构造、经典精修机制、基线与测试集设置）、实验的公平计算预算与统计学显著性，作者机构与通讯作者信息也未提供；相关性评分基于领域距离判断，若全文显示其分解与可行性恢复机制可更直接地迁移到生产调度，评分可能上调。
analysis.why_recommended: 尽管领域不完全重合，本文提供了一个清晰的“离散决策层与连续可行性层解耦、以求解器无关图表示对接专用硬件”的架构范例，并明确报告了可行性恢复与经典精修在评估中的位置。对关注约束可行性、求解质量与规模化瓶颈（如硬件/资源存活率）的调度研究者而言，其在分层建模、规模化瓶颈分析和硬件-经典协同流程上的做法具有方法论参考价值。

paper.abstract: Quantum hardware is beginning to address structured combinatorial optimisation, but two steps still block practical use: mapping real operational models onto hardware-compatible instances, and converting noisy hardware output back into feasible decisions. Here we introduce a backend-agnostic computational interface that compiles the discrete decision layer of stochastic unit commitment into a move-based maximum-weight independent set (MWIS) problem, while retaining continuous dispatch and feasibility recovery in the classical computational layer. We validate the approach in a green hydrogen scheduling setting and deploy it on the QuEra Aquila neutral-atom quantum processor. This is the first end-to-end industrial scheduling workflow that connects real operational decisions to programmable neutral-atom hardware through a solver-agnostic MWIS representation. Across a 15-day hardware campaign on 50-node instances, hardware-generated solutions after classical refinement match or exceed the dispatch margins obtained from exact MWIS on every day. When scaling to 144 nodes, encoding quality remains stable, while the probability that the full atom array survives, rather than graph embedding, emerges as the dominant bottleneck to further scaling. Together, these results establish a hardware-compatible computational pathway toward larger problem scales, and lay the groundwork for exploring regimes in which exact classical optimisation may no longer scale efficiently.

paper.abstract: We study the job shop scheduling problem with a conflict graph, in which adjacent jobs cannot be processed simultaneously on different machines, with the objective of minimizing the makespan. We establish a polynomial equivalence with a resource-constrained job shop problem having unit-capacity resources and binary resource requirements The problem is strongly NP-hard even on two machines with unit-time operations. For this setting, we derive an optimal-makespan formula and a linear-time algorithm when the conflict graph is a cluster graph, given the clique partition. We also develop a polynomial-time $4/3$-approximation algorithm for arbitrary conflict graphs on two machines when each job has exactly two unit-time operations. For the general problem, we propose four mixed-integer linear formulations, lower bounds, and a genetic algorithm with active, non-delay, and hybrid decoding procedures. Computational experiments on instances derived from the Lawrence and Taillard benchmarks and on randomly generated generalized job shop instances evaluate the proposed methods and show that the genetic algorithm generally improves on constructive heuristics.
paper.title: Minimizing the makespan in job shop scheduling under conflict graph constraints

analysis.analysis: 作者利用目标的无驱动动力学和推动接触的正锥表示来分析驱动约束，将追踪机器人的推动力表示为正锥中的向量，并识别出构型依赖的稀疏驱动约束。通过CLF约束保证目标参考跟踪的稳定性，通过CBF约束保证与圆形障碍物的安全距离。将CLF和CBF约束嵌入混合整数推力分配程序中，以处理单侧推动的稀疏性和间歇性控制权限。延迟感知反馈控制架构补偿了推动接触的延迟，采用混合系统H进行模式切换，在需要重新分配推动力时切换到保守模式。
challenges: 推动交互是单侧的，只能推不能拉，产生稀疏且依赖构型的驱动约束
当期望的推动分配变化时，追踪机器人需要物理重新定位到目标体上
控制权限是间歇性的，追踪机器人在施加所需力后离开目标进入自由飞行阶段
在自由飞行过渡期间必须确保安全，避免与障碍物碰撞
需要在稳定人类给定参考的同时保证安全，两者可能冲突

evidence.claim: 论文提出了一个安全关键框架，用于微重力下通过单侧推动接触协作运输被动目标，跟踪人类提供的高层速度旋量。
evidence.quote: We propose a safety-critical framework for the cooperative transportation of passive targets in microgravity, where a team of chaser robots acts through unilateral pushing contacts to track a human-provided desired twist while ensuring safe target motion.

evidence.claim: 推动交互的单侧性引入稀疏且依赖构型的驱动约束，需要追踪机器人物理重新定位。
evidence.quote: The pushing-only nature of the interaction introduces sparse, configuration-dependent actuation constraints requiring chasers to physically relocate on the target body when the desired pushing allocation changes.

evidence.claim: 作者将CLF和CBF约束嵌入混合整数推力分配程序，以强制目标的稳定性和安全性。
evidence.quote: To address these challenges, we formulate a delay-aware feedback control architecture leveraging Control Lyapunov Function (CLF) and Control Barrier Function (CBF) constraints within a mixed-integer thrust allocation program to enforce stability and safety of the target, respectively.

evidence.claim: 该框架在间歇性控制权限下实现了参考跟踪并保证了与圆形障碍物的避碰。
evidence.quote: The proposed framework enables reference tracking while guaranteeing obstacle avoidance with a circular obstacle despite intermittent control authority, providing a foundation for human-supervised cooperative transportation of free-flyers in space environments.

evidence.claim: 论文通过Gazebo仿真验证了所提框架。
evidence.quote: The proposed framework is validated through Gazebo simulations.

experiments: 通过Gazebo仿真验证所提框架
在仿真中，目标从起始位姿移动到目标区域，避开ISS的禁飞区和额外危险区域

analysis.motivation: 单体机器人系统在适应性、可扩展性和任务灵活性方面存在局限，而多智能体系统具有对个体故障的鲁棒性和提供更高集体推力的能力，因此更适合 demanding 的运输任务。推动交互无需抓取机构，简单且适合有限的追踪机器人。人类操作员提供高层决策可降低追踪机器人的计算资源需求，形成更便宜且容错的系统。现有工作通常只考虑稳定人类给定的参考，本文额外引入安全目标。
analysis.primary_topic: 微重力环境下多智能体通过单侧推动接触协作运输被动目标的安全关键控制
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文核心是多智能体在微重力环境下通过推动接触协作运输被动目标的控制问题，属于多智能体系统和安全关键控制领域，与智能优化、生产调度和AI4OR的研究主题有一定距离。然而，其方法中使用的混合整数二次规划（MIQP）推力分配、CLF/CBF约束嵌入优化问题、以及松弛QP加速求解的策略，与智能优化中学习辅助搜索和数学规划结合的方法有可迁移之处。推测：如果将CLF/CBF约束用于生产调度中的安全约束或资源分配问题，可能需要将连续动力学替换为离散事件或调度模型，并重新定义屏障函数和驱动约束。此外，人机在环的高层指令跟踪机制可迁移到生产调度中的人机协同决策，但需要明确调度问题的状态、动作和约束表示。
analysis.setting: 研究微重力环境下（如国际空间站附近）一组追踪机器人（chaser）通过单侧推动接触协作运输一个被动目标（如退役航天器或大型结构组件）的问题，目标是跟踪人类操作员提供的高层速度旋量（twist）指令，同时保证目标运动安全并避免与环境中圆形障碍物（如ISS）碰撞。关键约束包括：推动交互是单侧的，只能推不能拉，因此产生稀疏且依赖构型的驱动约束；当期望的推动分配变化时，追踪机器人需要物理重新定位到目标体上；控制权限是间歇性的，即追踪机器人在施加所需力后离开目标进入自由飞行阶段，期间必须确保安全。信息假设是目标被视为无驱动系统，人类操作员提供高层速度参考指令。环境为静态障碍物（圆形障碍物），动态由微重力下自由漂浮动力学决定。
analysis.title_zh: 微重力下自由飞行器的人机在环多智能体推动运输
analysis.uncertainty: 本文仅提供了摘要和部分全文节选，缺少完整的实验细节、基线对比、消融研究和泛化性评估。无法确认所提方法在更大规模实例或不同障碍物配置下的性能。此外，由于论文主题是微重力机器人控制，而非生产调度或智能优化，相关性评分基于方法迁移潜力而非直接主题匹配，存在一定主观性。
analysis.why_recommended: 虽然论文主题与生产调度不直接相关，但其将安全约束（CBF）和稳定性约束（CLF）嵌入混合整数规划的方法，以及采用松弛QP加速求解的策略，对智能优化中处理约束优化问题和学习辅助搜索有参考价值。特别是其延迟感知反馈控制架构和模式切换机制，可启发动态扰动下的生产调度问题中如何保证约束可行性和实时性。此外，人机在环的高层指令跟踪与生产调度中的人机协同决策有概念上的相似性。

The command is fed into a CLF-CBF controller ( 18 ) from which an optimal allocation and thrust for the chasers is computed. paper.abstract: We propose a safety-critical framework for the cooperative transportation of passive targets in microgravity, where a team of chaser robots acts through unilateral pushing contacts to track a human-provided desired twist while ensuring safe target motion. The pushing-only nature of the interaction introduces sparse, configuration-dependent actuation constraints requiring chasers to physically relocate on the target body when the desired pushing allocation changes. To address these challenges, we formulate a delay-aware feedback control architecture leveraging Control Lyapunov Function (CLF) and Control Barrier Function (CBF) constraints within a mixed-integer thrust allocation program to enforce stability and safety of the target, respectively. The proposed framework enables reference tracking while guaranteeing obstacle avoidance with a circular obstacle despite intermittent control authority, providing a foundation for human-supervised cooperative transportation of free-flyers in space environments. The proposed framework is validated through Gazebo simulations.
paper.title: Multi-Agent Transportation of Free-Flyers in Microgravity Via Pushing Interaction Under Human-in-the-Loop Control

analysis.analysis: 作者从时变到达时间函数的数学性质入手，将文献中仅在证明或命题层面描述的连续到达时间函数复合扩展到左连续函数，并证明检查器中的复合例程精确计算该操作；随后分析在 IEEE-754 双精度下评估与断点归一化何时精确，据此论证规范的无 epsilon 检查器必须如何定义目标。在此基础上，将随时启发式层与分支定价割精确组件整合，并用预承诺统计设计下的归一化带符号原始积分评估随时性能。

We prove that the composition routine shipped in the checker computes that operation exactly.

evidence.quote: KAYROS improves all 30 high-effort references of Blauth et al. and 10 literature best-known solutions, and publishes 704 such certificates.

experiments: 在来自五个问题族的 212 个实例上，以单线程一小时预算运行；KAYROS 的汇集随时得分比三个现有对比求解器（Timefold、Hexaly、jsprit）中最强者低 63.3%，三个对比在 Holm 校正下均显著。KAYROS 改进了 Blauth 等人的全部 30 个高努力参考解以及 10 个文献已知最优解，并发布了 704 个此类证书。求解器、基准与实验数据已公开。
摘要未提供训练开销、约束可行性统计、消融实验及泛化实验的具体结果。
analysis.insight: 其贡献的基础在于把连续到达时间函数的复合从文献中仅停留在证明或命题层面的描述，扩展到逐步基准所需的左连续函数，并证明随求解器发布的检查器所实现的复合运算确实精确；同时论证在 IEEE-754 双精度下评估与断点归一化何时精确，从而说明一个规范的无 epsilon 检查器必须如何定义目标。这样的函数级严谨性使随时层与精确层能够在同一目标定义下协同，既保证搜索过程中返回的解可被一致评估，又使分支定价割组件能够给出条件性最优性证书。

analysis.motivation: 城市物流的核心困难之一是旅行时间随一天中的时段变化，使一条路线的成本取决于何时行驶，因此需要能处理时变到达时间、同时兼顾解质量与计算预算的求解器。作者希望提供一个开源、既随时可返回改进解、又能在部分实例上给出条件性计算最优性证书的精确求解框架，并统一时变函数复合与检查器的规范定义。
analysis.primary_topic: 时变带时间窗车辆路径问题（TDVRPTW）的随时精确求解
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文直接处理带时间窗与车队成本的车辆路径优化，属于智能优化与运筹优化中组合调度的相邻方向：其随时启发式层（贪心构造、粒度局部搜索、迭代局部搜索）与精确分支定价割的结合，可为生产调度中的学习辅助搜索与数学规划混合提供参考。推测而言，若将时变到达时间函数复合与断点归一化思想迁移到柔性作业车间或生产运输协同问题，需要把工序开始时间与运输时间建模为类似的连续时间函数，并验证目标评估在下游检查器中的精确性；其随时评估方法论也可能用于比较不同调度启发式在固定计算预算下的表现。这些迁移均为推测，需结合具体调度约束重新验证。
analysis.setting: 论文研究时变带时间窗车辆路径问题（TDVRPTW）：在旅行时间随时间变化、且每个客户带有时间窗的城市场景中，为车队规划路线以最小化总行程时长（或考虑车队成本的目标）。决策对象是车辆路径与到达时间，关键约束包括时间窗与随时变的连续到达时间函数；目标函数需在 IEEE-754 双精度算术下被规范定义。环境为静态问题设定但行驶时间随出发时刻动态变化，信息假设与在线扰动处理在摘要中未说明。
analysis.title_zh: KAYROS：面向带时间窗时变车辆路径问题的随时精确求解器（扩展版）
analysis.uncertainty: 仅有标题与摘要，无法确认算法实现细节、基线设置、约束可行性处理、训练开销以及消融与泛化结果；作者单位与通讯作者未提供；相关性判断基于摘要所述问题域与方法机制，存在中等不确定性。
analysis.why_recommended: 对关注生产调度与 AI4OR 的研究者，该论文展示了随时启发式与精确分支定价割的工程化整合、时变时间函数复合的严谨处理，以及在预承诺统计设计下比较固定计算预算性能的评估方法，这些机制对柔性作业车间、分布式制造与生产运输协同中的时间依赖路径与调度问题具有直接借鉴价值。

paper.abstract: The Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (TDVRPTW) captures a central difficulty of urban logistics: travel times vary with the time of day, so the cost of a route depends on when it is driven. This paper introduces KAYROS, an open-source solver for the duration-minimization TDVRPTW that is both anytime and exact. It returns improving valid solutions throughout its time budget and can close instances with conditional computational optimality certificates through an integrated branch-price-and-cut component. We extend the composition of continuous arrival-time functions from the literature, previously described only at proof or proposition level, to the left-continuous functions that stepwise benchmarks require. We prove that the composition routine shipped in the checker computes that operation exactly. We analyze when its evaluation and breakpoint normalization are exact in IEEE-754 double-precision arithmetic, and argue that a canonical, epsilon-free checker must define the objective. The anytime layer combines greedy construction, granular time-dependent local search over balanced route trees, and iterated local search, with a fleet-aware descent for a fleet-cost objective. We further propose an anytime evaluation methodology based on a normalized signed primal integral under a pre-committed statistical design. On 212 instances from five families at a one-hour single-threaded budget, KAYROS achieves a pooled anytime score 63.3% lower than the strongest of three available contenders (Timefold, Hexaly, jsprit). All three contrasts are significant under Holm correction. KAYROS improves all 30 high-effort references of Blauth et al. and 10 literature best-known solutions, and publishes 704 such certificates. The solver, benchmarks and campaign data are openly released.
paper.comment: 93 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Extended version of a manuscript prepared for journal submission. Companion papers and reports: arXiv:2608.18288, arXiv:2607.23116, arXiv:2608.10079. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22095718, https://github.com/0nyr/kayros-campaign-analysis, https://github.com/0nyr/kayros
paper.title: KAYROS: An Anytime and Exact Solver for the Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows - Extended Version

analysis.analysis: 作者利用 CVRP 解结构的可分解性，将构造过程重新表述为对多个路径分量的维护与合并；通过将每个分量视为隐式仓库闭合路径，使任意中间状态对应完整可行解，并把合并前后的成本差精确对应为 Clarke-Wright 节约。这样就把原本难以从剩余容量获得的回仓库信号替换为一个可计算、可学习且结构一致的节约信号，供神经策略在每一步决策中使用。摘要未说明作者是否使用图表示、下界或理论分析来支撑该结论，仅说明基于 CW 节约进行解释与策略学习。
challenges: 多分量并行构造会移除逐条路径构造中由剩余容量提供的回仓库线索，导致策略难以判断分量应何时闭合。
在任意中间状态需要保证解的可行性，并要求合并操作不破坏容量约束。
需要在没有明确路径归属的情况下学习全局协调的合并顺序与合并对象选择。
需要评估策略在不同问题规模（CVRP100 到 CVRP1000）和不同容量严格程度下的泛化能力。
需验证 CW 信号是否真正必要，以及学习到的路径闭合行为是否影响紧约束下的性能退化。

evidence.claim: 论文提出多分量构造，同时维护多条路径分量并以任意顺序合并，以克服逐条路径构造的早期承诺问题。
evidence.quote: We propose multi-component construction, which maintains many route components simultaneously and merges them in an arbitrary order.

evidence.claim: 作者通过将每个分量视为隐式仓库闭合路径，使标准 CVRP 构造的任意中间状态都是完整可行解，且合并的精确成本下降等于 Clarke-Wright 节约。
evidence.quote: Under this depot-closed interpretation, every intermediate state of standard CVRP construction is a complete feasible solution, and the exact cost reduction of a merge is the Clarke-Wright saving.

evidence.claim: 神经策略结合 CW 节约信号与分量状态来学习连接对象与连接时机。
evidence.quote: The neural policy combines this CW-saving signal with the evolving component state to learn what to connect and when to connect.

evidence.claim: 仅在 CVRP100 上训练的策略在 CVRP100-500 的贪婪推理下优于代表性神经求解器，并在复用为 ruin-and-reconstruct 时在至 CVRP1000 的规模上表现强劲。
evidence.quote: A policy trained only on CVRP100 outperforms the reported results of representative neural solvers on CVRP100-500 with greedy inference and, reused for ruin-and-reconstruct, performs strongly at all evaluated sizes up to CVRP1000.

evidence.claim: 在容量从 C=10 到 C=500 的零样本约束紧度评估中，该方法在每个容量下均优于已报告的神经求解器。
evidence.quote: In a zero-shot Constraint Tightness evaluation with capacities from $C=10$ to $500$, it outperforms the reported neural solvers at every capacity.

evidence.claim: 受控分析表明，移除 CW 信号后鲁棒性仍然存在，并提示学习到的路径闭合行为可能是逐条路径求解器在紧约束下退化的原因之一。
evidence.quote: Controlled analyses show that robustness persists without CW grounding and point to learned route-closing behavior as a plausible contributor to the tight-regime degradation of learned route-by-route solvers.

experiments: 在 CVRP100 上训练的策略，在 CVRP100 至 CVRP500 的贪婪推理下优于代表性神经求解器的已报告结果。
同一策略复用于 ruin-and-reconstruct 时，在至 CVRP1000 的所有评估规模上表现强劲。
在容量从 C=10 到 C=500 的零样本 Constraint Tightness 评估中，该策略在每个容量值上都优于已报告的神经求解器。
受控分析显示，在移除 CW 信号后鲁棒性仍然存在，并指出学习到的路径闭合行为可能是学习式逐条路径求解器在紧约束条件下性能退化的一个原因。
摘要未提供具体运行时间、训练开销、公平计算预算、消融实验的完整设置或统计显著性等细节。
analysis.insight: 在标准 CVRP 构造中，逐条路径构造依赖于“剩余容量”所提供的回仓库线索；一旦改为同时维护多个分量，这一线索消失。作者的关键洞察是：把每个分量都解释为“隐式仓库闭合路径”（depot-closed），则标准 CVRP 构造的任意中间状态都对应一个完整可行解，而且两个分量合并所精确带来的成本下降恰好等于 Clarke-Wright 节约。由此 CW 节约可以作为有效的即时学习信号，用来补偿回仓库线索的缺失，并指导策略学习“连接什么”与“何时连接”。
limitations: 作者未在摘要中明确陈述局限性；材料未说明。
method: 提出 multi-component construction：在构造过程中同时维护多个路径分量，并以任意顺序合并它们，而非逐条路径完成后再开始下一条。
引入 depot-closed 解释：将每个分量视为隐式仓库闭合路径，使得标准 CVRP 构造的任意中间状态都是完整可行解。
利用 Clarke-Wright 节约作为合并的精确成本下降量，为多分量构造提供结构化的信号。
设计神经策略，将 CW 节约信号与不断演化的分量状态结合，学习在每一步选择连接哪些分量以及何时连接。
训练策略在 CVRP100 上进行，并支持贪婪推理以及作为 ruin-and-reconstruct 的重建算子复用。
analysis.motivation: 主流神经构造式求解器采用逐条路径构造范式，必须先完成一条路径再开始下一条，这会在早期就固定路径成员归属，阻碍跨路径的全局协调；作者希望去掉这种早期承诺，实现多路径分量的并行维护与任意顺序合并。
analysis.primary_topic: 神经组合优化 / 车辆路径问题的构造式求解
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文本身研究的是 CVRP 的神经构造式求解，属于人工智能驱动运筹优化与神经组合优化的核心方向。其多分量并行构造、以 CW 节约作为结构化学习信号、以及策略可复用为 ruin-and-reconstruct 算子的设计，与“学习辅助搜索”“学习与数学规划/启发式结合”的研究兴趣直接相关。迁移到生产调度（如柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造、生产运输协同）需要将“分量”概念重新定义为调度中的部分解或子调度，并找到与 CW 节约对应的结构化成本下降信号，同时需要处理调度中更复杂的机器容量、顺序和时序约束；这属于推测，需进一步验证。该工作也为动态扰动下的在线重建提供了可借鉴的重建算子思路，但摘要未涉及动态环境或多目标能效优化。
analysis.setting: 研究问题为 CVRP 的神经构造式求解：决策对象是如何在构造过程中建立并合并路径分量以形成完整车辆路径；优化目标是最小化总行驶成本，核心约束为车辆容量约束和路径的仓库闭合（每条路径从仓库出发并返回仓库）；信息假设为求解过程中可实时获得部分已构造分量的状态以及基于容量剩余量的 CW 节约信号；环境为静态组合优化问题（后续在 ruin-and-reconstruct 框架中反复重建，但仍围绕同一静态实例），摘要未说明是否考虑动态扰动或在线到达。
analysis.title_zh: 面向神经车辆路径规划的 Depot-Closed 多分量构造方法
analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据标题与摘要，无法确认网络结构、状态与动作的具体表示、CW 信号与神经策略的融合方式、训练细节、基线集合、计算预算是否公平，以及 ruin-and-reconstruct 的具体实现；作者也未在摘要中列出明确局限，因此关于迁移到生产调度的判断属于推测。
analysis.why_recommended: 推荐阅读的理由在于：其一，它提出了一种去除逐条路径早期承诺的构造范式，对生产调度中“部分解并行维护与合并”的求解设计有直接启发；其二，它展示了如何用经典启发式（Clarke-Wright 节约）的精确成本差来构造神经策略的学习信号，这与学习辅助搜索、学习与数学规划结合的研究路线高度一致；其三，它系统评估了零样本容量紧约束下的泛化，并探讨了路径闭合行为与紧约束退化的关系，对关注约束可行性、泛化和公平比较的调度研究具有方法论参考价值。

paper.abstract: Most neural constructive solvers for the vehicle routing problem (VRP) use route-by-route construction, extending one route until completion before starting the next. This commits route membership early and hinders global coordination across routes. We propose multi-component construction, which maintains many route components simultaneously and merges them in an arbitrary order. This removes the depot-return cue that route-by-route construction obtains from the remaining capacity; to compensate, we introduce an interpretation in which every component is treated as an implicitly depot-closed route. Under this depot-closed interpretation, every intermediate state of standard CVRP construction is a complete feasible solution, and the exact cost reduction of a merge is the Clarke-Wright saving. The neural policy combines this CW-saving signal with the evolving component state to learn what to connect and when to connect. A policy trained only on CVRP100 outperforms the reported results of representative neural solvers on CVRP100-500 with greedy inference and, reused for ruin-and-reconstruct, performs strongly at all evaluated sizes up to CVRP1000. In a zero-shot Constraint Tightness evaluation with capacities from $C=10$ to $500$, it outperforms the reported neural solvers at every capacity. Controlled analyses show that robustness persists without CW grounding and point to learned route-closing behavior as a plausible contributor to the tight-regime degradation of learned route-by-route solvers.
paper.title: Depot-Closed Multi-Component Construction for Neural Vehicle Routing

paper.abstract: Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) is one of the highlights in the recent AI for Optimization trend. This paradigm's bi-level workflow leverages the learnable algorithm design policy at meta level to ensure the performance and generalization improvement on the low-level optimization task. While MetaBBO helps advance the performance lower bound of the resulted optimization system, it is currently handcrafted and customized case by case to adapt different optimization problems, which inevitably introduces inherent subjectivity and hence restricts the performance upper bound and usability in practice. In this paper, we address this issue by regarding MetaBBO's design loop as coding task, where we could introduce openendedness into MetaBBO with recursive self-improvement capability of advanced coding agents. Specifically, we propose a dual-agent framework: i) a task agent continuously refines the codebase of a target MetaBBO approach through code evolution; ii) a hyper agent progressively modifies the task agent and itself to provide open-ended design behavior; iii) the evolved MetaBBO codebase is evaluated and all in-execution information is fed back to the agents for recursive self-referential improvement. As a result, given a naive MetaBBO template, our framework automates a design evolution and finds novel variants superior to up-to-date human-made MetaBBO baselines. Surprisingly, the experimental results also demonstrate that our framework supports fast adaption across different optimization domains. Solid interpretation analysis further reveals interesting design principles emerge in such open-ended process. This work serves as the first exploration on automating design of complex learning-assisted optimization algorithms.
paper.title: Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero

method: 输入包括两类：目标MetaBBO项目源码（元层策略、低层优化器、问题集、训练逻辑、评估协议，记作M）；以及两个基于LLM的编码智能体——超智能体A_hyper与任务智能体A_task，分别负责开放式改进与任务求解。
输出为演化后的MetaBBO项目M*，其通过超智能体和任务智能体驱动的迭代演化修改获得，在对应任务上达到最优可达优化性能。所有输入与输出均被视为可编辑的源代码文件。

演化循环：从AET中采样父节点，给定父项目的代码与Info，超智能体与任务智能体按顺序操作。步骤1：超智能体获得完全访问权限（材料在此处被截断，后续具体权限内容材料未说明）。
任务智能体持续通过代码演化精炼目标MetaBBO方法的代码库；超智能体逐步修改任务智能体及自身，以提供开放式设计行为。
演化后的MetaBBO代码库被评估，所有执行中信息反馈给智能体，用于递归自我指涉改进。
analysis.motivation: MetaBBO通过双层学习到优化架构提升了下界性能，但其设计目前仍依赖人工逐案定制，引入固有主观性，限制了性能上界与实际可用性。作者希望借助先进编码智能体的开放式自我改进能力，将MetaBBO的设计循环自动化，从而摆脱劳动密集的元层/低层人工设计。

analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实：该工作面向AI for Optimization中的MetaBBO，使用基于LLM的双编码智能体对学习辅助优化算法的代码进行开放式演化，属于自动算法设计与学习辅助搜索的交叉方向，所演化的对象正是含神经策略的元层设计策略与低层优化器。迁移设想（推测）：其“将算法设计循环建模为编码任务+执行反馈闭环”的机制，可能被迁移到生产调度中的启发式规则或元启发式策略自动生成场景，例如让智能体演化柔性作业车间/流水车间的调度规则或元层参数控制策略；但迁移需要满足若干条件，包括提供可执行的调度仿真环境与统一评估接口、明确约束可行性检查、保证公平计算预算与可复现性，以及处理好调度问题中离散、强约束和组合爆炸带来的评估噪声。以上迁移为推测，非作者结论。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是如何自动设计MetaBBO（元黑盒优化）这一双层学习辅助优化框架，而非人工逐案定制。决策对象是目标MetaBBO项目的源代码（包括元层策略、低层优化器、优化问题集、训练逻辑与评估协议），目标是给定一个朴素的MetaBBO模板（即“zero”起点），自动演化出性能优于现有人工设计基线的变体，并支持跨优化领域的快速适配。关键约束与信息假设包括：算法设计循环被建模为编码任务，依赖LLM编码智能体的开放式改进能力；演化过程通过执行演化后的MetaBBO代码来评估，并将执行中的全部信息（代码、补丁、执行日志、性能分数等）反馈给智能体用于递归自我指涉改进。优化问题设定涉及单目标、约束、多目标三类，环境为静态（材料未说明动态扰动设定）。

analysis.why_recommended: 该论文展示了一条与大模型智能体、学习辅助搜索和自动算法设计直接相关的路径：它不再只把LLM用于问题求解，而是让LLM编码智能体递归修改含神经策略的优化算法代码库，并给出了单目标、约束、多目标三类优化上相对人工MetaBBO基线的量化提升（121.7%、114.7%、104.3%）。对于关注生产调度中进化算法、学习辅助搜索与LLM自动建模/自动设计结合的研究者，其双智能体分工、演化树历史管理和执行反馈闭环是可借鉴的机制框架；同时其公开代码与神经参数有利于复现性评估。需注意其当前实验以连续优化为主，向调度问题的迁移尚属推测，阅读时应重点核查评估公平性、约束处理与跨域泛化的证据强度。

paper.abstract: Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) is one of the highlights in the recent AI for Optimization trend. This paradigm's bi-level workflow leverages the learnable algorithm design policy at meta level to ensure the performance and generalization improvement on the low-level optimization task. While MetaBBO helps advance the performance lower bound of the resulted optimization system, it is currently handcrafted and customized case by case to adapt different optimization problems, which inevitably introduces inherent subjectivity and hence restricts the performance upper bound and usability in practice. In this paper, we address this issue by regarding MetaBBO's design loop as coding task, where we could introduce openendedness into MetaBBO with recursive self-improvement capability of advanced coding agents. Specifically, we propose a dual-agent framework: i) a task agent continuously refines the codebase of a target MetaBBO approach through code evolution; ii) a hyper agent progressively modifies the task agent and itself to provide open-ended design behavior; iii) the evolved MetaBBO codebase is evaluated and all in-execution information is fed back to the agents for recursive self-referential improvement. As a result, given a naive MetaBBO template, our framework automates a design evolution and finds novel variants superior to up-to-date human-made MetaBBO baselines. Surprisingly, the experimental results also demonstrate that our framework supports fast adaption across different optimization domains. Solid interpretation analysis further reveals interesting design principles emerge in such open-ended process. This work serves as the first exploration on automating design of complex learning-assisted optimization algorithms.
paper.title: Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero

analysis.analysis: 作者将大规模路径优化的困难归因于搜索空间随规模快速增长，并把问题重构为“初始化质量”而非“求解过程复杂度”。其分析路径是：把大规模实例压缩到一个紧凑的代理空间，在代理空间中优化全局路由结构，再将该结构恢复为原始空间的初始解；由于初始化已捕获全局结构，后续轻量精化只需修正剩余局部决策，而无需重建整个解。摘要与结论指出这一视角可使现有求解器聚焦于有希望的区域。若精化过程中不存在改进邻居，则该过程终止。材料未提供压缩方式、代理空间建模及恢复过程的更多技术细节。
challenges: 如何在压缩的代理空间中保留原始大规模实例的全局路径结构而不过度丢失约束相关信息。
如何将代理空间中得到的解恢复为原始空间中的可行且面向优化友好的初始解。
如何保证该初始化组件不依赖训练、与具体求解器无关，并适配 TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP 等多类问题。
在 1K 至 100K 节点规模上保持解质量与运行时间的可扩展性，并应对 GPU 内存与时间限制。

evidence.claim: 论文提出免训练、求解器无关的初始化组件，面向大规模路径优化。
evidence.quote: We propose Just Initialize, a training-free and solver-agnostic initialization component for large-scale routing optimization.

evidence.claim: 方法将大规模实例压缩到紧凑代理空间，优化全局路由结构并恢复为原始空间的起始解。
evidence.quote: Just Initialize compresses a large routing instance into a compact surrogate space, optimizes its global routing structure, and recovers the resulting solution as an optimization-friendly starting point in the original space.

evidence.claim: 实验覆盖 TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP，规模从 1K 到 100K 节点，并报告平均约 70 倍加速、10K 节点亚秒级、100K 节点数十秒级运行时间。
evidence.quote: including an average speedup of approximately 70$\times$, sub-second runtimes on 10K-node instances, and runtimes within tens of seconds on 100K-node instances.

evidence.claim: 作者的核心视角是改进优化从哪里开始，而非不断改进优化过程本身。
evidence.quote: This motivates a complementary perspective: improving where optimization begins.

evidence.claim: 初始化已捕获全局结构，后续轻量精化只需修正局部决策；若无改进邻居则终止。
evidence.quote: Since the initialization already captures the global routing structure, this lightweight refinement only needs to correct remaining local decisions without rebuilding the solution.

evidence.claim: 实验表明方法可在 1K 至 100K 节点上保持有竞争力的解质量并显著降低计算成本。
evidence.quote: Extensive experiments on TSP, CVRP, VRPTW, and PCTSP demonstrate that Just Initialize scales to instances from 1K to 100K nodes while maintaining competitive solution quality with substantially reduced computational cost.

experiments: 在 TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP 四类问题上进行实验，实例规模从 1K 到 100K 节点。
与 LKH-3（参考）、POMO、LEHD、INViT、SIL、L2C-Insert、DIFUSCO、GLOP、UDC、H-TSP、TTPL 等方法比较。
TSP 表1显示：JI+Refine 在 5K 至 100K 节点上 Gap 分别为 3.30、3.40、3.56、3.62、3.65，运行时间分别为 0.24 s、0.53 s、1.47 s、4.83 s、12.21 s；部分对比方法在大规模上出现 OOM 或超时。
CVRP 表1片段显示 JI+Refine 在相应规模上具有竞争力，具体数值在所选节选中不完整。
摘要称平均加速约 70 倍，10K 节点实例达到亚秒级运行时间，100K 节点实例运行时间在数十秒以内。
消融类结果以 Gap 和 Time 形式报告，不同规模下方法相对表现存在波动；完整实验细节、训练开销与公平计算预算说明在节选中未完整给出。

analysis.insight: 在大规模组合搜索空间中，一个捕获了全局路径结构的初始解可以显著降低下游搜索的难度；与其让求解器从零开始搜索整个解空间，不如先在压缩的代理空间中确定全局结构，再将其恢复为原始空间中“易于优化”的起点。这样把“解发现”与“解优化”解耦，使求解器聚焦于有希望区域的局部修正，从而在保持解质量的同时大幅降低计算成本。
limitations: 作者明确将自身定位为初始化组件，声称与求解器无关且免训练；材料未列出作者明确陈述的局限。

method: 提出 Just Initialize：一种免训练、求解器无关的初始化组件。
压缩：将大规模路径实例压缩为一个紧凑的代理空间。
代理空间优化：在代理空间中优化全局路由结构。
恢复：将代理空间解恢复为原始空间中面向优化的起始解。
下游精化：可用 VND 或 Refine 等轻量过程对初始解进行局部改进；若不存在改进邻居则终止。
analysis.motivation: 大规模路径问题的搜索空间随问题规模迅速增长，现有方法主要通过改进优化过程本身（更复杂的架构、训练流程或搜索机制）来提升性能，但这通常以不断增加计算成本为代价。作者转向一个互补视角：改进“优化从哪里开始”，即提供一个良好的初始解，使下游精化只需处理少量局部决策，从而在有限精化预算下得到高质量解。
analysis.primary_topic: 大规模路径优化（TSP/CVRP/VRPTW/PCTSP）的免训练初始化与降维代理空间求解
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文直接面向大规模路径优化这一 AI4OR 核心问题，与智能优化、学习辅助搜索紧密结合。其“压缩代理空间—优化全局结构—恢复为初始解—轻量精化”的思路可直接迁移至柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造与生产运输协同调度：例如将大规模调度实例压缩为粗粒度工序/机器/车辆序列表示，在代理空间中确定全局分派结构，再恢复为可行调度并由局部搜索或数学规划精化。迁移需要满足的条件包括：存在可压缩且能保留关键约束的代理表示、恢复过程能保证可行性、下游精化能有效利用全局结构。这些迁移属于推测，并非作者结论。该方法本身免训练、求解器无关，若能与图神经网络或强化学习产生的构造策略结合，也可能作为学习辅助搜索的初始化模块。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是大规模路径优化问题（TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP）的高效求解。决策对象为路径（访问顺序/车辆路径）的全局结构。优化目标是在有限计算预算下于原始大规模实例（1K 至 100K 节点）上获得高质量可行解；关键约束为路径问题的可行性约束（如 CVRP 的容量约束、VRPTW 的时间窗约束、PCTSP 的收益收集约束）。信息假设：实例完全已知且为静态环境，论文未说明是否处理动态扰动。求解范式为：先初始化，再由下游求解器/精化过程完成局部优化。
analysis.title_zh: 只需初始化：面向大规模路径优化的免训练初始化组件
analysis.uncertainty: 所选全文节选不完整，缺少方法细节（压缩与恢复的具体机制）、完整实验表格、公平计算预算说明以及作者对局限的明确陈述；因此对方法内部原理、约束可行性保证和泛化能力的判断存在不确定性。相关性评分基于该工作直接面向大规模路径优化与学习辅助求解框架，若后续发现其压缩表示难以适配车间调度约束，则迁移价值需下调。
analysis.why_recommended: 对研究智能优化与生产调度者而言，该工作提供了一个不同于“改进求解过程”的互补方向：通过更好的初始化来降低下游搜索难度，并在 1K 至 100K 节点的大规模路径问题上展示了显著速度优势。其免训练、求解器无关的特性降低了复现与迁移门槛，且“压缩—代理优化—恢复”的框架对大规模车间调度、分布式制造与生产运输协同中的全局结构诱导具有直接借鉴价值。阅读时建议重点关注其压缩与恢复机制如何保证可行性，以及在不同约束类型（容量、时间窗、收益收集）下的适应性。

figures.caption: Rethinking large-scale routing optimization. (a) Conventional paradigm and our paradigm. (b) Performance comparison with SOTA methods on 100K-node TSP instances.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of Just Initialize. The framework compresses the original solution space, optimizes in a compact space, recovers an optimization-friendly initialization, and performs lightweight refinement in the original space.
figures.label: Figure 2

paper.abstract: Large-scale routing problems are difficult to solve efficiently as their search spaces grow rapidly with problem size. Existing approaches primarily improve the optimization procedure itself, often at increasing computational cost. We instead shift the focus to a useful initialization that can be refined into a high-quality solution with limited downstream refinement. We propose Just Initialize, a training-free and solver-agnostic initialization component for large-scale routing optimization. Just Initialize compresses a large routing instance into a compact surrogate space, optimizes its global routing structure, and recovers the resulting solution as an optimization-friendly starting point in the original space. Extensive experiments on Traveling Salesman Problems (TSPs), Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems (CVRPs), Vehicle Routing Problems with Time Windows (VRPTWs), and Prize-Collecting Traveling Salesman Problems (PCTSPs) demonstrate that Just Initialize achieves high-quality solutions comparable to or better than state-of-the-art methods while substantially reducing computational cost across instances ranging from 1K to 100K nodes, including an average speedup of approximately 70$\times$, sub-second runtimes on 10K-node instances, and runtimes within tens of seconds on 100K-node instances.
paper.title: Just Initialize: A Training-Free Initialization Component for Large-Scale Routing Optimization

analysis.analysis: 作者将搜索过程分解为“搜索情境—搜索行为（搜索配方）—观测结果”的关联表示，并借用神经认知记忆中情境敏感存储、检索与复用的功能角色，设计了多时间尺度记忆架构和基于相似性的上下文检索；检索结果不作为候选点回放，而是用于选择探索、定向和局部搜索等行为并配合自适应搜索几何，从而分析记忆如何改变执行行为的分布。
challenges: 如何定义并表征搜索情境（context）以支持相似性检索
如何组织多时间尺度记忆（工作、情景、巩固）并实现强化、巩固、遗忘与持续获取
如何同时利用正、负经验而不导致过早收敛或行为停滞
检索到的经验不能直接回放旧候选点，需要将其转化为基于当前种群的搜索配方
在 BBOB/CEC2017 和光伏参数估计中保持竞争性且问题依赖的性能

evidence.claim: CMDO 是面向种群搜索的无导数优化器，将经验表示为搜索情境、搜索行为与观测结果之间的关系
evidence.quote: We introduce Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization (CMDO), a derivative-free population-based optimizer that represents experience as the relationship between search context, search behavior, and observed outcome.

evidence.claim: 记忆按工作、情景和巩固三类组织，并基于与当前搜索状态的相似性进行检索
evidence.quote: CMDO organizes these experiences across working, episodic, and consolidated memory, retrieves them according to similarity with the current search state, and uses both positive and negative evidence to guide subsequent search.

evidence.claim: 检索到的经验不回放旧候选位置，而是选择由当前种群重建的搜索配方
evidence.quote: Retrieved experience does not replay previous candidate locations; instead, it selects search recipes that are reconstructed from the current population through exploratory, directed, and local search behaviors with adaptive search geometry.

evidence.claim: 在 CEC2017 F10 上取得所比较方法中最低的中位误差
evidence.quote: The results show problem-dependent but competitive optimization performance, including the lowest median error among the compared methods on CEC2017 F10.

evidence.claim: 搜索轨迹分析表明上下文相关回忆改变了执行搜索行为的分布，失败经验作为负证据保留
evidence.quote: analysis of the search traces shows that context-dependent recall changes the distribution of executed search behaviors, while unsuccessful experiences remain available as negative evidence for later decisions, showing that accumulated experience directly influences subsequent search behavior.

evidence.claim: 评估基线包括 DE、CMA-ES、SHADE、GWO、HHO 和 ORCA，并在匹配实验条件下比较
evidence.quote: include DE, CMA-ES, SHADE, GWO, HHO, and ORCA under matched experimental conditions.

evidence.claim: 作者指出未来需研究更高维、噪声、约束、动态和多目标场景以及经验迁移
evidence.quote: work should examine higher-dimensional, noisy, constrained, dynamic, and multi-objective settings, as well as whether useful experience can be transferred across related optimization tasks.

experiments: 在选定的 BBOB/COCO 和 CEC2017 问题上评估，基线包括 DE、CMA-ES、SHADE、GWO、HHO 和 ORCA，且实验条件匹配
在七参数光伏模型估计中使用实测电流—电压数据进行应用研究
结果表明性能是问题依赖但具有竞争力的，包括在 CEC2017 F10 上取得所比较方法中最低的中位误差
搜索轨迹分析显示上下文相关回忆改变了执行搜索行为的分布，且不成功经验作为负证据保留并影响后续决策
材料未给出具体数值、运行时间、训练开销、计算预算、消融细节、约束可行性或泛化性的量化结果
analysis.first_affiliation: The University of Alabama, AL, USA（计算机科学系）
analysis.insight: 该工作有效性源于将优化记忆从“记住好解/好参数”转变为“记住行为与情境和结果的关联”，并在当前状态相似时检索相关经验、同时保留失败经验作为负证据。这样，历史经验不再是回放旧候选点，而是用于选择由当前种群重建的搜索配方，从而直接改变后续执行的搜索行为分布，使搜索控制具有自适应性。
limitations: 作者明确指出未来工作需考察更高维、噪声、约束、动态和多目标场景，以及有用经验能否在相关优化任务间迁移；这些方向当前尚未验证
结论部分提到需要更丰富的情境表示和更大、更多样的优化设置
method: 将搜索经验表示为搜索情境、所应用行为与观测结果之间的关系
构建工作记忆、情景记忆和巩固记忆的多时间尺度记忆架构
根据当前搜索状态与记忆条目的相似性进行上下文相关检索
检索不重放旧候选位置，而是选择由当前种群重建的搜索配方（搜索行为）
搜索配方涵盖探索性、定向和局部搜索行为，并具有自适应搜索几何
同时使用正向和负向证据：强化有效行为、在相关状态下抑制先前不成功的行为
记忆更新包含强化、巩固、遗忘与持续获取经验
analysis.motivation: 现有种群式优化方法（如 DE、CMA-ES、SHADE、自适应算子选择）虽利用成功解、参数或算子得分等历史信息，但很少保留“搜索行为在何种搜索情境下成功或失败”的上下文；同一行为在不同搜索阶段可能有效或无效，因此需要一种能表示并复用“情境—行为—结果”关系的记忆机制来主动控制搜索。
analysis.primary_topic: 基于显式记忆机制的种群式无导数黑箱优化算法
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文面向连续黑箱优化，未直接涉及柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造或生产运输协同等调度问题；但其“情境—行为—结果”显式记忆与上下文检索机制在方法论上与学习辅助搜索、智能体优化有明确关联。推测而言，若将搜索情境定义为调度问题的状态特征（如机器负载、工件剩余工序、扰动类型），将搜索行为定义为邻域算子、优先级规则或求解器配置，并将结果定义为解质量或约束违反度，则该记忆控制思路可能迁移到生产调度中的算子选择或超启发式控制；迁移需要额外的状态表示设计、约束可行性处理和在调度基准上的公平预算验证，这些均非原文已验证内容。
analysis.setting: 研究面向连续黑箱优化问题：决策对象是种群搜索过程中下一步采用何种搜索行为（搜索配方），目标是在探索与开发之间自适应平衡以最小化目标函数误差。算法假设目标函数为无导数黑箱、可评估但梯度不可用，环境为静态（BBOB/CEC2017 基准及光伏参数估计），问题维度、噪声、约束等要素在不同测试中由基准给定，材料未说明动态或多目标场景下的具体设定。
analysis.title_zh: CMDO：一种面向自适应种群搜索的认知记忆驱动优化算法
analysis.uncertainty: 输入为全文节选，缺少方法细节（情境表示、相似性度量、记忆更新公式）、实验数值、运行时间与公平计算预算的具体设置，也缺少约束、动态、多目标场景的验证；因此对性能强弱、可迁移性和复现性的判断存在较大不确定性，相关性评分基于方法机制而非调度应用证据。
analysis.why_recommended: 对研究智能优化与学习辅助搜索的读者，该文提供了一个将记忆机制从解/参数层面提升到“情境—行为—结果”层面的具体框架，并区分正负经验与多时间尺度记忆；其“检索经验用于选择当前种群重建的搜索配方而非回放旧解”的设计，以及通过搜索轨迹分析记忆对行为分布影响的思路，可为调度问题中的自适应算子选择、超启发式控制和经验迁移研究提供可借鉴的方法结构。

figures.label: Figure 1

paper.abstract: Population-based optimization methods often use previous search information through successful solutions, parameter adaptation, or operator performance, but they rarely retain the context in which a search behavior succeeded or failed. We introduce Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization (CMDO), a derivative-free population-based optimizer that represents experience as the relationship between search context, search behavior, and observed outcome. CMDO organizes these experiences across working, episodic, and consolidated memory, retrieves them according to similarity with the current search state, and uses both positive and negative evidence to guide subsequent search. Retrieved experience does not replay previous candidate locations; instead, it selects search recipes that are reconstructed from the current population through exploratory, directed, and local search behaviors with adaptive search geometry. We evaluate CMDO on selected Blackbox Optimization Benchmarking test suite on COCO (BBOB/COCO) and Congress on Evolutionary Computation 2017 (CEC2017) problems against DE, CMA-ES, SHADE, GWO, HHO, and ORCA, and further study its application to seven-parameter photovoltaic model estimation using measured current--voltage data. The results show problem-dependent but competitive optimization performance, including the lowest median error among the compared methods on CEC2017 F10. More importantly, analysis of the search traces shows that context-dependent recall changes the distribution of executed search behaviors, while unsuccessful experiences remain available as negative evidence for later decisions, showing that accumulated experience directly influences subsequent search behavior. These results support the use of explicit context--behavior--outcome memory as an active mechanism for controlling population-based search.
paper.title: CMDO: A Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization Algorithm for Adaptive Population-Based Search

analysis.analysis: 作者通过行为分析、表示探测和因果干预三类手段分析问题：行为层面跟踪生成路径的几何性质（如相对于起始节点的角度位移、onion 层振荡频率与强度）；表示层面使用探测方法检查各层表示中可线性访问的信息以及跨实例对齐情况；因果层面使用均值消融等干预手段检验特定节点表示（当前节点、起始节点、未来节点）对下一步决策的因果作用。
challenges: 神经组合优化模型的内部决策机制缺乏可解释性
重编码器-轻解码器架构的轻量解码导致上下文感知不足与几何策略僵化
模型在训练分布之外的大规模和聚簇分布上的泛化能力受限
需要在公平的贪心单轨迹解码协议下比较不同架构的内在决策行为，避免测试时增强混淆机制分析

evidence.claim: 论文研究自回归 NCO 模型的内部决策机制，覆盖 AM、POMO 与 LEHD 两种编码器-解码器配置
evidence.quote: we investigate three representative autoregressive NCO models spanning two encoder-decoder configurations: AM and POMO (heavy-encoder, light-decoder), and LEHD (light-encoder, heavy-decoder).

evidence.claim: 评估使用贪心单轨迹解码且不使用测试时增强
evidence.quote: all models are evaluated using greedy, single-trajectory decoding without model-specific test-time enhancements, such as POMO’s rotational augmentation or LEHD’s RRC.

evidence.claim: 行为分析显示 AM 与 POMO 主要遵循持久几何模式，而 LEHD 包含关于多个未来动作的线性可访问信息
evidence.quote: Our results suggest that AM and POMO predominantly follow a persistent geometric pattern throughout solution construction, whereas LEHD contains linearly accessible information about multiple future actions.

evidence.claim: 因果实验表明 LEHD 依赖编码的前瞻轨迹决定局部动作
evidence.quote: This provides causal evidence that LEHD relies on its encoded look-ahead trajectory to determine its local actions.

evidence.claim: POMO 倾向于顺时针构造路径而 AM 倾向于逆时针
evidence.quote: POMO exhibits a systematic tendency to construct tours in a clockwise manner while AM constructs in an anti-clockwise manner

evidence.claim: LEHD 将当前节点表示映射到相对共享的潜在区域
evidence.quote: Cross-instance alignment analyses additionally indicate that LEHD maps current-node representations into a relatively shared latent region, which may provide a stable reference for evaluating subsequent decisions.

evidence.claim: 模型在 Uniform TSP-100 上训练并在 TSP-500 等七种分布上评估泛化
evidence.quote: All models are trained on Uniform TSP-100 and evaluated in Figure 2 on TSP-500 across seven distributions, thereby testing both size and distribution generalization.

evidence.claim: L2C-Insert 推理成本更高且未持续提升解质量，LEHD 解质量有竞争力且推理成本显著更低
evidence.quote: L2C-Insert incurs substantially higher inference costs without consistently improving solution quality over LEHD. LEHD achieves competitive solution quality across diverse distributions while maintaining substantially lower inference cost than the insertion-based baseline.

experiments: 所有模型在 Uniform TSP-100 上训练，并在 TSP-500 上的七种分布评估，以测试规模与分布泛化；报告最优性间隙、凸包违反率和推理运行时间（对数刻度）。
L2C-Insert 的推理成本显著更高，且相对 LEHD 并未持续提升解质量；LEHD 在多种分布上取得有竞争力的解质量并保持显著更低的推理成本。
行为结果显示：POMO 系统性地按顺时针方向构造路径，AM 按逆时针方向构造；两者在不同 onion 层深度间振荡的频率和强度显著高于对比求解器，且这种空间差异在更大问题规模上更明显。
AM 与 POMO 在聚簇分布上性能退化，作者归因于其仅用均匀点分布训练带来的刚性几何策略，以及轻量解码器架构导致上下文感知不足。
LEHD 的因果实验表明其依赖编码的前瞻轨迹决定局部动作；对 TSP-100 的 LCS 与 Rev. LCS 相似度比较按角度区间给出了数值（如 0°–30° 时 LEHD 的 LCS 为 0.769、Rev. LCS 为 0.147，POMO 的 LCS 为 0.963、Rev. LCS 为 0.030）。
逐层跨实例对齐表显示 LEHD 的当前节点表示在较深解码层具有更高的对齐度（如 Dec. 4 为 0.886 ± 0.046），起始节点次之，随机节点最低。
作者表明测试时多起点采样的有效性直接源于对抗 POMO 的刚性几何策略，但由于采样灵活性受限，随实例规模增大 POMO 与 LEHD 的性能差距扩大。
analysis.first_affiliation: Sharif University of Technology 计算机工程系
analysis.insight: 不同编码器-解码器资源分配会导致本质不同的决策模式：重编码器-轻解码器（AM、POMO）主要依赖一种贯穿解构造过程的持久几何模式，因此对当前节点周围局部几何不敏感、在更大规模与聚簇分布上表现退化；而轻编码器-重解码器（LEHD）在其解码器表示中线性可访问关于多个未来动作的信息，并同时依赖当前节点表示做即时局部决策、依赖起始节点表示做更全局的导航，这解释了它为何能更动态地适应局部实例几何。
limitations: 材料未说明
method: 选取三个代表性自回归 NCO 模型并覆盖两种编码器-解码器配置：AM 与 POMO 为重编码器-轻解码器，LEHD 为轻编码器-重解码器；另纳入基于插入的 L2C-Insert 作为参考。
统一评估协议：所有模型使用贪心、单轨迹解码，不使用模型特定的测试时增强，以研究学习策略的内在决策行为。
行为分析：跟踪路径构造过程中的角度位移和 onion 层振荡，比较不同求解器的几何构造策略。
表示探测：对 LEHD 各编码器/解码器层进行逐层探测，检验当前节点、起始节点和随机节点表示中可线性访问的信息量，并做跨实例对齐分析。
因果干预：使用均值消融等手段分别消融当前节点、起始节点和未来节点表示，观察干净下一步节点概率的变化，以建立表示与决策之间的因果关系。
在 TSP 和 CVRP 上验证上述分析，模型在 Uniform TSP-100 上训练并在 TSP-500 等七种分布上评估泛化。
作者提供代码与额外可视化：https://github.com/NCO-Interpretability/NCO-Interpretability。
analysis.motivation: NCO 已在经验上取得较强性能，但驱动模型决策的内部机制仍 largely unexplored；作者希望弄清这些模型如何构造解、如何在解码过程中使用内部表示，从而为更可解释的 NCO 求解器分析奠定基础。
analysis.primary_topic: 神经组合优化求解器的可解释性与决策机制分析
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实：该工作直接研究 TSP/CVRP 上自回归 NCO 求解器的内部决策机制，涉及 Transformer 编码器-解码器、强化学习训练（AM、POMO）与监督学习训练（LEHD），并分析不同架构对局部与全局几何信息的利用方式。与智能优化、学习辅助搜索、神经网络辅助求解方向高度相关，因为其结论说明表示容量分配如何影响求解器的泛化与几何适应性。迁移设想（推测）：若要把这类机制分析迁移到生产调度，例如柔性作业车间、流水车间或生产运输协同问题，需要将路径构造的几何/角度分析替换为调度解构造中的序列决策结构（如机器分配、工序排序），并重新设计探测与因果干预对象（机器表示、工序表示、剩余加工时间表示等）；其可解释性方法本身可能可迁移，但结论不能直接外推。
analysis.setting: 论文研究自回归神经组合优化（NCO）求解器在构造路径解时的内部决策机制，决策对象是 TSP 与 CVRP 这类路径问题中每一步应追加的下一个节点；目标不是提升求解性能，而是刻画不同编码器-解码器配置的模型如何利用内部表示做出决策；关键约束与信息假设包括：所有模型采用贪心单轨迹解码、不使用测试时增强（如 POMO 的旋转增强或 LEHD 的 RRC），模型主要在 Uniform TSP-100 上训练，静态环境，材料未说明在线或动态扰动设定。
analysis.title_zh: 理解神经路径求解器的决策机制

paper.abstract: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) has achieved strong empirical success, yet the internal mechanisms driving model decisions remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate three representative autoregressive NCO models spanning two encoder-decoder configurations: AM and POMO (heavy-encoder, light-decoder), and LEHD (light-encoder, heavy-decoder). Through behavioral analyses, representation probing, and causal interventions, we examine how these models construct solutions and use internal representations during decoding. Our results suggest that AM and POMO predominantly follow a persistent geometric pattern throughout solution construction, whereas LEHD contains linearly accessible information about multiple future actions. Causal experiments further provide evidence for the role of future-node representations in LEHD's decision-making. We also observe that LEHD relies strongly on the current-node representation for immediate local decisions, while the start-node representation plays a broader navigational role over the subsequent route. Cross-instance alignment analyses additionally indicate that LEHD maps current-node representations into a relatively shared latent region, which may provide a stable reference for evaluating subsequent decisions. Across the Traveling Salesman Problem and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, these results reveal distinct decision-making patterns across these architecturally distinct solvers and provide a foundation for more interpretable analyses of NCO solvers. Code and additional visualizations are provided in the https://github.com/NCO-Interpretability/NCO-Interpretability.
paper.title: Understanding Decision-Making Mechanisms in Neural Routing Solvers

paper.abstract: Recent advances in agentic heuristic design use AI agents and execution feedback to automate algorithm discovery for challenging optimization problems. In many practical settings, high-quality solutions must be obtained under strict runtime constraints, motivating hybrid approaches that combine problem-specific heuristics with powerful mathematical programming solvers. However, existing approaches typically improve heuristic components within predefined procedures or tune solver configurations in isolation. This limits holistic adaptation of where to allocate computation, how to leverage solvers, and how to refine the overall algorithmic structure. To address these limitations, we propose HeurEvo, an automated plan--code--component co-evolution framework that jointly evolves the high-level algorithmic structures, their implementations, and a shared pool of reusable components. A planner determines which algorithmic components to use, how to combine them, and how to allocate runtime across stages, a coder realizes the resulting plan as executable code, while a component evolver updates the shared component pool. Within an island-based evolutionary framework, plans and implementations co-evolve with feedback from an interpreter agent that analyzes execution results and identifies opportunities for improvement. Across diverse combinatorial optimization benchmarks and challenging MIPLIB instances, HeurEvo finds high-quality solutions within tight runtime budgets, often matching or surpassing state-of-the-art optimization solvers given hours or days of computation. On several nonlinear geometry problems such as hexagon packing, it also improves upon the best previously reported results. These results highlight the value of jointly searching over algorithmic structure and implementation for agentic heuristic design.
paper.title: HeurEvo: Agentic Evolution of Hybrid Solver-Augmented Heuristics for Time-Critical Mathematical Optimization

paper.abstract: Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO) traditionally relies on Bayesian or ensembling surrogates for uncertainty quantification. While historically treated as fully data-driven, SMBO increasingly integrates external domain expertise to accelerate discovery. To overcome the opaque guidance and diminished integration fidelity of standard acquisition re-weighting, Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) have emerged as a generative surrogate alternative, enabling direct knowledge injection via conditional sampling. However, these generative routines lack the formal exploration-exploitation semantics required for rigorous optimization. We introduce the Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo), a novel metric that unifies the flexibility and efficiency of PCs with a formal uncertainty framework. DisCo provides a bounded, $[0, 1]$-normalized measure of model "surprise" that (1) recovers properties comparable to kernel-based uncertainty known from, e.g., Gaussian Processes, while maintaining linear-time inference, and (2) enables accurate assessment of conformance of external knowledge w.r.t. model evidence. We then present DisCoMBO, a framework leveraging these properties for robust, knowledge-aware optimization. We prove that DisCoMBO is a zero-regret algorithm and demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse benchmarks from AutoML, material optimization, and wind park optimization.
paper.title: DisCoMBO: Steering Expert-in-the-Loop Black Box Optimization via Distributional Conformance

figures.caption: The overall framework of BiFE. To balance search efficiency and rule quality, F H ​ F F_{HF} evaluates heuristics via expensive MILP solving while F L ​ F F_{LF} offers a cheap surrogate by measuring consistency with strong-branching decisions. An LLM generator produces new heuristics through three operations: initialization, crossover, and mutation. The evolutionary process has two stages: (1) Initialization: the LLM generates an initial population, ranked by F L ​ F F_{LF} with the top α \alpha forming the elite set ℰ \mathcal{E} for F H ​ F F_{HF} evaluation. (2) Evolutionary Loop: parent selection is elite-prioritized, where elites are ranked by F H ​ F F_{HF} and others by F L ​ F F_{LF} , and selected parents are passed to the LLM for crossover or mutation. New candidates with F L ​ F F_{LF} exceeding threshold τ \tau undergo F H ​ F F_{HF} evaluation and are admitted into ℰ \mathcal{E} . Survival selection retains all elites and fills the remaining slots from the general population. This selective allocation lets BiFE explore broadly with F L ​ F F_{LF} while using F H ​ F F_{HF} to correct the surrogate on promising candidates.

figures.caption: LLM-based rule generator. Given an operation instruction (initialization, crossover, or mutation), a problem description, and a rule template, the LLM generates a new rule. The LLM-generated rules undergo evolution and selection within the BiFE framework to yield an optimal rule.

paper.abstract: In branch-and-bound (B&B) for mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), branching variable selection critically impacts efficiency. Existing neural branching policies often require GPU inference, while CPU-efficient symbolic expressions lack the representational capacity for complex logic. Large Language Model (LLM)-generated code provides a flexible search space for designing lightweight branching rules with diverse algorithmic logic. To discover effective rules within LLM-based evolutionary frameworks, a core challenge arises: full B&B evaluation on real instances is prohibitively expensive, whereas offline imitation learning suffers from distribution shift. To address this, we introduce a Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary framework (BiFE). It employs low-fidelity imitation scores as a rapid pre-screener and selectively applies high-fidelity on-instance evaluation only to elite candidates, effectively balancing search efficiency with performance reliability. Experiments validate both the search efficiency of BiFE and the competitiveness of its discovered rules, which outperform the SCIP solver and other baselines on CPUs, and even surpass certain GPU-based neural policies.
paper.title: BiFE: Search-Efficient Discovery of CPU-Only Branching Policies via LLM-based Bi-Fidelity Evolution

paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for automated heuristic design (AHD), enabling iterative generation and refinement of heuristics. However, the dominant paradigm embeds LLMs as narrow, fixed components, such as crossover or mutation, within heavily hand-engineered evolutionary frameworks. We argue this misapprehends LLMs. It treats them as specialized tools rather than general reasoners, constrains them to low-level operations, and underutilizes their autonomy. Moreover, the extensive human priors in these frameworks violate the bitter lesson principle that general methods scaling with computation surpass hand-crafted solutions. This raises a key question: which AHD framework designs best convert stronger LLM capabilities into better heuristics? To address this, we propose metrics for LLM-driven AHD framework handcraftedness (AHI) and intelligence conversion efficiency (ICE). Evaluating ten LLMs across three challenging combinatorial optimization problems, we obtain a notable finding that frameworks with fewer human priors consistently yield higher ICE. Based on this finding, we propose SimpleEvol, an agent-loop framework for AHD which removes nearly all human priors and allows the LLM to operate autonomously. SimpleEvol consistently achieves the highest ICE, often by a large margin. Our results challenge the trend toward complex AHD pipelines and point to a lighter and more model-centric alternative, suggesting that reducing human priors is a more effective strategy to scale up with model intelligence. paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have provided a unified interface for end-to-end combinatorial optimization (CO), but textual serialization alone may obscure spatial and relational structures that are important for generating effective CO solutions. This paper presents a general-purpose vision-language solver that augments textual instance descriptions with input-derived visual representations. A single vision-language model (VLM) is applied across different CO tasks and trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by verifier-guided reinforcement learning. While the visual inputs contain no gold solutions or solution-derived information, our experiments show that the VLM generally improves solution quality over its text-only counterpart, with particularly clear gains on more complex CO problems such as CVRP and JSSP. The advantage of visual information is more pronounced at large problem scales.
paper.title: VLM Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Combinatorial Optimization

paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving combinatorial optimization (CO) problems on graphs by learning to sample high-quality solutions. A common inference-time approach is to generate multiple candidate solutions independently and return the best-performing sample, improving solution quality at the expense of an increase in computational cost. In this work, we introduce PT-Denoise, an inference-time procedure that allows these concurrent denoising trajectories to interact through parallel tempering, without requiring retraining or fine-tuning of the underlying denoiser. Our method assigns a temperature to each diffusion process and allows processes to swap temperatures based on their relative performance. This dynamically reallocates promising, low-energy trajectories to colder, more concentrated sampling regimes while allowing higher-energy states to escape local minima through randomized exploration. Experiments on canonical graph-structured CO problems show that our approach consistently improves the quality of the best solution found, while only adding minimal computational overhead.
paper.title: Parallel Tempering for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization

paper.abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search can discover complex programs, but existing methods mostly only save candidate programs and fitness scores while discarding which component edits produced which fitness metric changes. Existing methods force the mutator LLM to infer the effect of prior edits from cluttered histories, making program search slow and unstable. This is especially true for locally servable LLMs to evolve multi-component systems. We introduce component-aware feedback, which compares each evaluated program with its parent, identifies the components that changed, and logs them with the associated metric differences into an attribution memory that later mutations read. The memory keeps each change in two reference frames, local against the parent it came from and global against the seed program, which shows both the immediate effect of a change and the cumulative progress made since the seed. We study this on LLM reranking, a multi-objective optimization problem where a multi-stage pipeline must balance quality against serving cost. Across twelve \textsc{Bright} datasets, our method reaches the strongest baseline's final quality after a median of one third of the search budget and ends 7.2\% higher in held-out nDCG@10, and under a cost-aware objective it finds pipelines that are on average more accurate while using 11\% fewer tokens per query, showing component-aware feedback to be a promising direction for more efficient self-evolving systems.
paper.title: Component-Aware Feedback for Self-Evolving Programs

paper.abstract: Scalable robotic fleets have become increasingly popular for various applications such as package delivery, warehouse management, and military operations. Prior fleet control algorithms solve centralized routing problems with up to $1{,}000$ tasks in controlled environments, yet they fail to consider realistic constraints such as limited observation and communication ranges typical of decentralized fleets. Thus, deploying existing fleet control algorithms into real-world settings is currently infeasible. To tackle this, we propose Heterogeneous Allocation via Localized Observations (HALO) to solve the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP). HALO is a hybrid method that splits the VRP into allocation and routing portions to provide onboard, real-time solutions to robots in dynamic environments. During the allocation phase, HALO utilizes a heterogeneous graph neural network framework with unique message passing layers to explicitly separate the learning of spatial distributions and task-to-robot compatibility. Evaluation results on a partially observable, online variant of the VRP show HALO significantly outperforms the heuristic baseline while maintaining similar solution quality to an all-knowing offline variant of HALO. While HALO is explicitly designed for partially observable environments, it imposes no strict upper bound on the observation space allowing us to test HALO on the traditional static, single-depot VRP. Here, HALO outperforms state-of-the-art architectures strictly optimized for the static variant of the VRP by up to $14.06\%$. Throughout all testing, this framework maintains the quickest execution times which emphasizes its potential for large-scale, real-time deployment.

paper.abstract: Next-token prediction has driven remarkable progress in large language models, yet a growing body of evidence suggests that they can struggle on problems governed by complex global constraints. In this work, we focus on this regime and ask whether some of these limitations arise from the inference interface induced by next-token prediction itself. We study this question through blackboard intelligence: an inference-time perspective in which a model works on a fixed, revisable canvas and searches over candidate solution states rather than committing to a causal, left-to-right trajectory. We instantiate this idea with diffusion language models, whose any-order prediction interface naturally exposes predictions over partially filled solution states. Our key observation is that mean confidence, a simple model-internal quantity available from the standard masked diffusion objective, provides a useful proxy for global coherence and can guide inference-time search and revision. Empirically, across ZebraLogic, Nurse Rostering, and Job-Shop Scheduling, Blackboard consistently improves inference while holding the fine-tuned LLaDA-8B-Instruct checkpoint fixed and substantially outperforms same-scale autoregressive baselines, reaching 90.4% accuracy on ZebraLogic-Hard, 76.4% exact feasibility on Nurse Rostering, and 80.2% optimality on JSSP. Stronger autoregressive search and refinement also fail to close the gap on ZebraLogic-Hard, while Blackboard surpasses tested frontier LLMs there and on JSSP despite their substantially greater scale and strong test-time reasoning. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/jwoosang1/blackboard-intelligence.
paper.title: Blackboard Intelligence Can Surpass Autoregressive on Globally Constrained Problems

paper.abstract: The two-dimensional irregular knapsack problem in a fixed circular container is an important combinatorial optimization problem for maximizing material utilization in manufacturing. Conventional geometric packing solvers can produce tightly packed layouts, yet they often partition the residual space into isolated small pockets that cannot fit valuable unplaced polygons. To overcome this late-stage packing bottleneck, we propose a failure-aware large neighborhood search framework named GeoNest, driven by a graph policy trained via reinforcement learning. Specifically, we first construct neighborhoods by pairing failed target polygons with residual pockets. We then use explanatory poses to identify the placed polygons that block candidate insertions. These diagnosed blocking relations define bounded, fixed-item repair subproblems for the underlying geometric solver. Finally, the graph policy selects the most promising subproblem for execution. For evaluation, we introduce CircleNest-Bench, a benchmark comprising 2,391 load-controlled instances from four contour sources, including a held-out industrial CAD source. Experimental results demonstrate that, under the same total time budget, GeoNest improves mean utilization over a state-of-the-art standalone packing solver by about 0.9% on average across the three main test sets and by about 0.6% on the held-out industrial set.
paper.title: GeoNest: Learning to Select Failure-Aware Neighborhoods for the Irregular Knapsack Problem in a Circular Container

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文与 AI4OR 和自动建模方向直接相关：它关注大语言模型从自然语言生成数学规划模型与求解器代码，并强调正确性与计算效率的双重评价。对于研究智能优化与生产调度的读者，这篇工作提示在构建自动建模或大模型辅助优化流程时，不能只看模型是否正确，还要度量端到端构建与求解开销。其多智能体框架与专家建模知识库的思路可迁移到生产调度问题的自动建模与建模技术选择，但迁移到柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造或生产运输协同等具体问题需要适配领域约束、目标函数与实例规模；此类迁移为推测，尚需在相应调度基准上验证约束可行性与计算预算公平性。论文本身并未直接研究生产调度问题。
analysis.setting: 论文研究如何让大语言模型从自然语言问题描述中识别问题结构并应用合适的优化建模技术，从而生成既能正确求解又计算高效的数学模型与求解器代码。决策对象是建模技术的选择与模型代码的生成；目标同时包含求解正确性和计算代价（记录求解时间与内存）；关键约束是所生成模型需在相同任务与数据下与专家模型可比；信息假设是模型仅基于自然语言描述与现有优化基准；静态或动态环境材料未说明。

analysis.uncertainty: 本次分析仅依据标题与摘要，未提供全文；因此方法细节（如多智能体分工、输入输出、智能体间通信）、实验设置（如基线模型名称、实例规模、计算预算、硬件、统计方法）、局限性与消融实验均无法确认。对迁移到生产调度的可行性只能作为推测，缺乏论文证据支持。

paper.abstract: Optimization modeling formulates real-world decision problems as mathematical programs that solvers can use to find optimal decisions. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, but the resulting correct formulations can require substantial time and memory to construct and solve, limiting practical scalability. Therefore, we systematically investigate whether LLMs can identify problem structure from natural-language descriptions and apply suitable optimization modeling techniques to generate mathematical models and solver code that solve the problems correctly and efficiently. To this end, we first curate OptTips, a knowledge base of 50 expert modeling techniques in eight families. Using this knowledge, we develop OptDachshund, a multi-agent framework that transforms problems from existing optimization benchmarks into new tasks for evaluating LLMs' use of modeling techniques. It constructs conventional and expert mathematical models with solver code for the same task and data, providing baselines for correctness and computational cost. The resulting EfficientOpt benchmark contains 561 expert-reviewed tasks with paired reference implementations. Evaluation of 11 representative LLMs reveals an efficiency gap on correctly solved tasks with comparable measurements: for every LLM, most generated programs take longer to solve than their expert counterparts. Within the comparable reference-size subset, 57\% of programs with correct objective values and fewer variables and linear constraints have longer recorded solver times. Case studies show that different modeling techniques can achieve the same optimal value at similar recorded cost. Faster solving may not reduce execution time if the code takes longer to prepare data and build the model. LLM optimization modeling should therefore be evaluated for both correctness and computational efficiency.
paper.title: Right Answers, Costly Models: The Efficiency Gap in LLM-based Optimization Modeling

analysis.analysis: 作者将自动研究过程分解为三层：审阅与构思层将任务与证据转化为结构化的研究方向池；算法搜索层把可执行实验组织成算法树并维护当前节点与前沿；验证层执行注册实验并把结果回写为可复用的研究证据。通过这种分解，候选生成与主动搜索被分离，方向切换（R）与局部精化（L）成为由历史状态驱动的显式动作。材料未说明作者是否使用问题结构下界或图表示等数学分析手段。
challenges: 长时程自动研究中相互竞争的研究思想难以系统管理
实验轨迹长且状态复杂，需要保存与恢复可复用的实验工件
在有限计算预算内决定继续精化还是切换方向
MILP与MINLP实例上严格改进当前最好解或达到历史目标值本身是NP难任务

evidence.claim: AutoMIP通过思想池与算法树搜索组织混合整数规划的长时程自动研究。
evidence.quote: We introduce AutoMIP, a reusable agent skill for organizing long-horizon autoresearch in mixed-integer programming through idea pooling and algorithm tree search.

evidence.claim: 在MIPLib上为60个实例中的31个发现新的最好解，在MINLPLib上为60个实例中的52个取得新的最好解。
evidence.quote: On MIPLib, AutoMIP discovers new best solutions for 31 of 60 instances, surpassing existing autoresearch frameworks. On MINLPLib, it achieves new best solutions for 52 of 60 instances.

evidence.claim: 消融研究显示思想池与算法树搜索具有互补贡献。
evidence.quote: Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary contributions of idea pooling and algorithm tree search, highlighting the importance of jointly maintaining diverse research ideas and structured experimental trajectories for long-horizon autoresearch.

evidence.claim: 现有自动研究智能体主要用于机器学习与科学发现，对MILP/MINLP运筹优化问题关注较少。
evidence.quote: However, existing autoresearch agents have primarily been developed for machine learning and scientific discovery, with applications spanning domains such as chemistry, biology, and materials science. NP-hard operations research (OR) problems modeled as mixed-integer linear or nonlinear programs (MILPs or MINLPs) have received comparatively less attention

evidence.claim: 审阅与构思层生成并筛选五到十个互补研究方向，候选在核心假设或策略族上不同。
evidence.quote:
At the beginning of a problem-solving run,
PoolThink
synthesizes evidence from task structure, current code, execution logs, and previous attempts to generate and screen five to ten complementary research directions.

evidence.claim: 验证层评估可行性、目标值、运行时间及其他任务特定接受准则，并在预算耗尽或停止谓词满足时终止。
evidence.quote: the evaluator assesses feasibility, objective value, runtime, and other task-specific acceptance criteria. The layer outputs the evaluation result, updated exploration state, and the current best verified solution.

evidence.claim: MIPLib的Open与Hard集合各含60个实例，Open在43,200秒内追求严格改进或首次可行，Hard在3,600秒内追求指定历史目标值。

Open and Hard set each comprises 60 instances

)
. For Open set, we seek a strict improvement over the best known solution, or first feasibility when no feasible solution is found yet, within 43,200 s. For Hard set, we seek a specified historical objective target within 3,600 s.

evidence.claim: 当前实证范围局限于MIPLib与MINLPLib，扩展到其他领域需要调整。
evidence.quote: The current empirical scope is focused on MIPLib and MINLPLib. Extending AutoMIP to other research domains requires adjustments.

experiments: 在MILP与MINLP基准队列上，AutoMIP在评估的自动研究框架中取得最高最终成功率。
在MIPLib上，AutoMIP为60个实例中的31个发现新的最好解，超过现有自动研究框架。
在MINLPLib上，AutoMIP为60个实例中的52个取得新的最好解。
消融研究表明思想池与算法树搜索具有互补贡献，说明同时维护多样化研究思想与结构化实验轨迹对长时程自动研究很重要。
MIPLib的Open与Hard集合各含60个实例；Open集合在43,200秒内寻求对最好已知解的严格改进，或在尚无可行解时首次找到可行解；Hard集合在3,600秒内寻求指定的历史目标值；MINLPLib使用60实例队列与43,200秒时长。
所有配置运行在Apple M4 Pro机器上，具有12个逻辑CPU、12个物理CPU核心与24 GB内存；基于Codex的配置使用GPT-5.5，Claude Code接口使用Claude Sonnet 5。
基线包括直接用于任务分析、代码修改、执行与验证的Codex编码智能体，以及将自动研究循环适配到优化的Loop方法。

跨智能体评估在20个实例上进行：Codex使用AutoMIP总体完成9/15（其中0–1小时6/9、1–3小时2/5、3–6小时1/1、6–12小时0/0），累计时间13,250秒、token 1,621,633；Claude Code使用AutoMIP总体完成6/12（其中0–1小时2/7、1–3小时2/3、3–6小时2/2、6–12小时0/0），累计时间20,209秒、token 2,324,256。
材料未说明基线在相同实例上的具体成功率、解质量差距、约束可行性的详细统计，以及训练开销（该框架为LLM智能体驱动，未报告模型训练开销）。
analysis.insight: 有效性的关键在于把“保留多样化待探索假设”与“结构化组织可执行实验轨迹”这两件事解耦并同时维护：思想池让未被选中的方向不会因为当前方向被持续细化而丢失，算法树让每个节点携带可恢复的实验状态与工件，从而使智能体既能沿有希望的方向做局部精化，又能依据历史状态切换到替代的方法论方向。消融实验显示两个组件具有互补贡献，说明仅有多样想法或仅有结构化轨迹都不足以支撑长时程自动研究。
limitations: 当前实证范围集中在MIPLib与MINLPLib，将AutoMIP扩展到其他研究领域需要调整。
未来工作包括为更广泛领域开发可自动演化的任务技能与算法搜索机制。
method: AutoMIP是一个可复用的智能体技能（agent skill），用于组织混合整数规划中的长时程自动研究。
审阅与构思层包含证据审阅、候选生成与筛选、池收集三步；PoolThink将证据综合为可执行研究方向，总结每个方向的理由与需求，筛除冗余或不可行提案，输出思想池记录并维护池P_t。
思想池中每个记录包含身份、假设（研究方向）、支持证据、与已尝试方向的差异、启动需求、潜在失败风险与状态（如未使用或已选择）；候选方向鼓励在核心假设或策略族（如邻域搜索、结构分解、模型强化）上不同，同假设内的参数变化被视为局部精化而非独立方向。
算法搜索层将可执行实验组织为算法树，节点注册实验并保存观察、评估证据与新生成的工件、恢复的实验状态；维护前沿与当前节点供下一步搜索。
验证层从恢复的实验状态出发，由主任务技能构建并执行候选，评估器评估可行性、目标值、运行时间及其他任务特定接受准则，输出评估结果、更新后的探索状态与当前最佳已验证解。
验证结果回写：注册节点存储观察与工件，思想池更新对应研究方向的生命周期，前沿与当前节点刷新；成功实验可触发进一步L次精化，持续停滞或假设被反驳可触发R次方向切换。
研究在计算预算B耗尽或停止谓词τ满足时终止。
初始运行时PoolThink综合任务结构、当前代码、执行日志与先前尝试的证据，生成并筛选五到十个互补研究方向。
analysis.motivation: 现有自动研究智能体主要面向机器学习与科学发现，对以MILP/MINLP建模的运筹优化问题关注较少；而直接使用Gurobi、SCIP等精确求解器在困难实例上耗时巨大，学习引导的方法又需要大量深度学习专业知识与问题特定的模型设计与调参。已有LLM辅助算法设计方法虽能通过种群式搜索或树式搜索探索算法空间，但长时程研究需要系统性地管理相互竞争的研究思想与实验轨迹。
analysis.primary_topic: 基于大模型智能体的混合整数规划自动算法研究框架
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实：AutoMIP是面向MILP/MINLP的LLM智能体自动研究框架，通过思想池与算法树搜索组织长时程算法设计实验，直接以“自动建模/自动算法设计+大模型智能体+求解器执行”的方式做运筹优化，与本方向关注的大模型智能体、自动建模、学习辅助搜索高度契合。迁移设想（推测）：将思想池与算法树机制迁移到柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造或生产运输协同调度，需要把任务契约、可行性判定与接受准则替换为调度问题的约束体系与目标函数，把实验工件替换为调度算法代码或求解器配置，并重新定义方向切换与精化的触发信号；其在调度多目标与动态扰动场景下的泛化性未被本文验证。

paper.abstract: Despite recent progress in autoresearch, applying it to practical operations research problems, typically formulated as NP-hard mixed-integer linear or nonlinear programs (MILPs or MINLPs), remains challenging because effective research requires systematically managing competing ideas and long-horizon experimental trajectories. We introduce AutoMIP, a reusable agent skill for organizing long-horizon autoresearch in mixed-integer programming through idea pooling and algorithm tree search. AutoMIP maintains a persistent pool of complementary candidate ideas while organizing executable experiments into an algorithm tree, enabling the agent to preserve unexplored hypotheses, refine promising algorithms, and switch to alternative methodological directions based on historical states. On MILP and MINLP benchmark cohorts, AutoMIP achieves the highest final success rates among the evaluated autoresearch frameworks. On MIPLib, AutoMIP discovers new best solutions for 31 of 60 instances, surpassing existing autoresearch frameworks. On MINLPLib, it achieves new best solutions for 52 of 60 instances. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary contributions of idea pooling and algorithm tree search, highlighting the importance of jointly maintaining diverse research ideas and structured experimental trajectories for long-horizon autoresearch.
paper.title: Autoresearch in Mixed-Integer Linear and Nonlinear Programming

paper.abstract: Unit Commitment is a computationally demanding mixed-integer linear optimisation problem requiring many binary commitment decisions across a scheduling horizon. To reduce this computational burden, machine learning approaches can predict a subset of these decisions, thereby shrinking the search space explored by the optimisation solver. Existing confidence-based approaches determine which variables to fix based on user-defined probability thresholds, which are agnostic to the downstream optimisation problem. We address this limitation by introducing an optimisation-aware framework that yields generator-specific confidence thresholds based on the impact of fixing errors on Unit Commitment solution quality. This approach won first place in the 2025 EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition. The proposed framework achieves a mean optimality gap below 0.5% while also delivering an average speed-up of more than 20x. It therefore provides a general mechanism for translating probabilistic predictions into controlled reductions of mixed-integer search spaces, directly linking learning decisions to their downstream computational and economic consequences.
paper.title: Learning to Fix: Optimisation-Aware Machine Learning for Accelerated Unit Commitment

paper.abstract: Routing and switch placement are fundamental combinatorial optimization problems in chip design, requiring the joint optimization of routing topology and physical placement under strict structural, geometric and logical constraints. Existing approaches typically rely on carefully engineered heuristics that incorporate strong problem-specific biases to navigate the enormous space of possible designs. In this work, we introduce a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for joint routing and switch placement at the level of logical communication routes. Starting from a minimal routing graph, our method progressively constructs increasingly expressive solutions through three coupled operations: switch expansion, switch placement, and route refinement. These operations preserve routing validity by construction, restricting exploration to feasible configurations where every communicating initiator-target pair has one assigned loop-free route. We explore the induced solution space using Gumbel Monte Carlo Tree Search, showing that neural-guided search substantially improves solution quality over non-learning optimization methods. Furthermore, pretraining across floorplans provides a strong initialization for fine-tuning on unseen instances.
paper.title: Validity-Preserving Hierarchical RL for Joint Routing and Switch Placement in EDA

analysis.analysis: 作者将问题结构化为带析取约束的非线性优化问题：先用位置、能量、时间间隔与充电时长等连续变量参数化整条轨迹，再以总任务时间为目标，写出物理与运行约束，其中包括统一定义的电池动态模型与对每种充电模式时间分配的析取约束。随后利用析取约束的最小值/最大值结构，构造光滑函数近似并给出近似误差上界（附录中通过 φ_p(z) 的展开与不等式推导证明），从而把含析取的结构转化为可由光滑非线性算法处理的形式，避免引入整数变量。

analysis.insight: 核心洞察在于：充电模式的切换本质上是可以由连续时间分配表达的析取结构，而非必须用整数变量建模。作者用一个统一的电池动态模型加上对每种模式所占时间的析取约束来刻画非线性充电，再通过光滑近似以有界误差替代析取约束，从而把混合整数非线性问题转化为光滑非线性规划。这样既保留了恒流—恒压等非线性充电行为的物理保真度，又使问题可由光滑非线性优化算法高效求解，并可通过理论误差界控制近似质量。
limitations: 作者明确提到未来工作才计划将模型扩展到多无人机系统与持续监测应用，说明当前模型仅面向单无人机场景

method: 轨迹参数化：用 N 个时间戳上的位置 r_k、归一化电池水平 e_k、时间间隔 s_k 以及充电时长 c_k 作为连续决策变量
目标函数：以总任务时间最小化为目标，隐式平衡飞行时间与充电时间
统一电池动态模型：同时描述放电飞行与充电过程，支持非线性（恒流—恒压）充电动态
析取约束建模：对分配给每种充电模式的时间施加析取约束，以刻画模式切换
光滑近似：用光滑函数近似析取约束并给出有界近似误差，从而消除整数变量
求解方式：由于模型不再含整数变量，直接调用光滑非线性优化算法求解（正文提及 Algorithm 1，全文节选中未给出其具体细节）
analysis.motivation: 在基础设施稀疏环境中，用移动充电站为无人机补给可延长续航与作业范围，但任务顺序、何时何地与移动充电站会合充电、以及充电站受地形限制的可达区域相互耦合，导致轨迹规划非凸且计算昂贵；已有方法要么依赖较强的假设（已知会合点、已知动作顺序、离散化电池水平），要么使用混合整数规划，求解代价高。因此作者希望避免整数变量，同时保留非线性充电动态与地形约束，从而高效获得高质量近似解。

analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文属于数学规划驱动的轨迹与调度协同优化，其核心机制——用统一动态模型加析取约束描述多模式切换、再用光滑近似消除整数变量以获得有界误差并交由连续非线性优化高效求解——与智能优化和生产调度中“学习辅助搜索/数学规划结合”的求解范式高度互补。论文事实：作者确实采用连续非线性规划替代混合整数非线性规划，并报告计算时间从小时级降至分钟级。迁移设想（推测）：把“模式切换→析取约束→光滑近似→连续求解”这一思路迁移到柔性作业车间或生产运输协同调度，需要把机器/车辆的状态切换（如加工、待机、充能、装卸）建模为分段时间分配变量，并验证光滑近似在离散事件与顺序约束下的可行性保持与解质量；此外，若要在动态扰动场景使用，还需额外的滚动时域或在线重优化机制，论文本身未提供该能力。
analysis.setting: 研究面向由地面移动充电站支持的无人机系统的轨迹优化问题：决策对象包括无人机在各时间戳的位置、归一化电池水平、时间间隔以及分配给移动充电站的充电时长；目标是最小化总任务时间；关键约束涵盖多个空间分布任务的完成、无人机与移动充电站之间的充电耦合、恒流—恒压非线性充电动态、移动充电站比无人机更严格的地形可达约束（限制可充电地点）、充放电阶段不同的速度上界以及电量动态平衡；信息假设为离线已知任务位置与地形信息，环境为静态确定性场景；材料未说明在线扰动、随机性或动态重规划机制。
