analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据摘要与部分全文节选，未能核对完整实验表格、消融细节与参考gap的归一化方式；关键节点抽取器与偏置强度的具体实现细节在节选中不完整；迁移到车间调度或生产运输协同的可行性属于我的推测，作者未涉及。
analysis.why_recommended: 它给出了一种低成本、可检查的约束适配范式：不改策略、不重训，只把自然语言需求编译为规则化掩码与搜索先验，契合AI4OR中对部署后需求变化快速响应的关注。更重要的是，作者明确区分了“局部掩码保证即时合法”与“全局可行续解可达”这两个层次，并用固定rollout预算下的关键节点偏置搜索处理后者，这对生产调度中硬约束与求解预算的权衡、以及约束可行性评估协议的设计具有直接借鉴意义。其失败分析也提醒研究者在LLM驱动的建模管线中单独评估语义规则正确性与搜索引导能力。

paper.abstract: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) rapidly produces high-quality solutions for problem structures encountered during training, but operational requirements may change after deployment and be communicated in natural language. We propose LangNCO, a framework that compiles instance-specific requirements into structured inference-time interventions for a frozen NCO solver, without changing the pretrained policy's architecture, learned input representation, or parameters. A pretrained LLM serves as a replaceable semantic front end, translating each requirement into a schema-validated domain-specific language (DSL) rule set. A deterministic Rule Executor applies the rules as nonexpansive hard action masks. Because local masking prevents immediate violations but does not ensure that a complete feasible continuation remains reachable, Critical-Offset Decoding extracts rule-referenced critical nodes and reallocates part of a fixed rollout budget to multi-strength biased rollouts. Using controlled task-specific language to isolate solver adaptation from open-ended language robustness, we evaluate a CVRP policy on road closures, time windows, vehicle assignments, visit-order requirements, all pairwise combinations, and twelve additional constraint types. LangNCO achieves 100% feasibility on the four primary datasets with mean reference gaps of 1.63--3.26%, 97.33--100% feasibility when separately generated rules are composed for pairwise constraints, and 98.67% feasibility across the additional constraints. These results demonstrate modular post-training adaptation of a frozen NCO solver through inspectable language-derived rules, without retraining.
paper.title: LangNCO: Compiling Natural-Language Constraints into Inference-Time Interventions for Neural Combinatorial Optimization

paper.abstract: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) and its variants are leading algorithms to help solve challenging combinatorial optimization problems. QAOA maps these problems to Ising Hamiltonians such that their ground state is the desired solution. Candidate solutions are then drawn from a variational quantum circuit. The performance of QAOA hinges on a set of variational angles. However, finding good angles is an instance-specific and computationally expensive non-convex classical optimization task. Here, we learn the mapping from the problem instance to high-quality QAOA angles. Our learned models replace the per-instance optimization, that we call the solver, with a single forward pass that is several orders of magnitude faster than the solver with a near identical quality. Our models further generalize to unseen topologies such as Barab\'asi-Albert and 2D grid graphs. Experiments on quantum hardware confirm that QAOA samples with angles produced by our open-source models are indistinguishable from solver angles. Crucially, models sensitive to the topology of the problem instance increase the quality of the QAOA angles. Our work amortizes a major bottleneck in QAOA by an up-front data generation and training cost. Importantly, this cost can be amortized over time in settings where many similar problems are optimized on a regular basis, as is often the case in applications for industry.
paper.title: Learning angles for quantum approximate optimization

paper.abstract: Multi-criteria models for healthcare operations need weights that express how stakeholders trade off patient waiting time, provider workload, and operating cost, but these weights are difficult to quantify. Teams of large language model (LLM) agents, each prompted to represent a stakeholder, have been used to supply them. We propose a framework for assessing the reliability of LLM-generated preferences as inputs to multi-objective optimization and quantifying how their uncertainty affects decisions. We study explicit preferences by asking agents to rate the importance of the criteria in an outpatient appointment scheduling problem, and implicit preferences by inferring trade-offs from the agents' pairwise choices between emergency department configurations. The computational experiments show that the explicit preferences respond to the clinic's operating conditions and differ across roles, but deliberation among the agents can erase these differences, whereas simple averaging preserves them. The pairwise choices used to reveal the agents' implicit preferences depend largely on which option is presented first, and we find limited evidence that a statistical model using contextual information alongside presentation order predicts the agents' choices on new comparison pairs better than a model using presentation order alone. We then formulate robust weighted-sum optimization models to account for preference uncertainty. In most cases, these models select different schedules or configurations from those obtained using average preference weights. These results indicate that LLM-generated preferences need an audit of this kind before they are used as optimization weights in healthcare decision support.
paper.title: On the possibilities and limitations of LLM-based multi-agent systems for multi-criteria decision-making in healthcare operations management

analysis.uncertainty: 仅有标题与摘要，缺少全文；无法核实理论分析的具体假设与证明强度、基线公平计算预算、高维合成基准的维度规模、真实任务的约束处理方式及超参数敏感性，因此对其实际效果与可迁移性的判断存在不确定性。

paper.abstract: Many real-world tasks require optimizing expensive black-box functions accessible only through noisy evaluations, a setting commonly addressed with Bayesian optimization. While Gaussian processes(GPs) and Bayesian neural networks have driven significant progress, GP-based methods scale cubically with observations, and BNN-based approaches remain burdened by expensive posterior sampling such as Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, and inner-loop acquisition optimization in high-dimensional setting. In this work, we propose VBO-MI, a fully gradient-based BO framework that requires no assumptions on a Gaussian prior or a variational posterior family over $f$. While our framework uses gradient-based updates to train the internal action and information-estimation networks, it treats the objective function $f$ as a strict black box, requiring only zeroth-order evaluations. To enable end-to-end gradient flow, we employ an actor-critic architecture consisting of an action-net to navigate the input space and a variational critic to estimate a surrogate information signal for exploration. Additionally, we design a lightweight surrogate that approximates the objective from observed data using a replay buffer, which reduces the total required real function queries to one batch per iteration. We provide theoretical analysis for our framework, establishing convergence of its training objective and surrogate estimator, and showing, that near-optimal solutions exist. We evaluate our method on a diverse suite of benchmarks, including high-dimensional synthetic function and complex real-world tasks such as Rover Trajectory planning optimization, the Lunar Lander, and Pest Control problems. Our experiments demonstrate that VBO-MI provides the same or superior optimization performance over the various baselines.
paper.title: VBO-MI: A Differentiable Black-Box Optimization Framework via Variational Mutual Information Estimation

paper.abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used for expensive black-box optimization, yet observation noise makes each evaluation less informative and slows posterior learning. Standard BO learns from costly outcomes gathered during optimization. In many applications, however, low-cost auxiliary data are available beforehand. We introduce Auxiliary-Informed Gaussian Process Bandit (AI-GPB), a variance-reduction method that combines an offline estimate of the auxiliary mean with a correction coefficient learned from paired online observations. Notably, it exploits correlation between paired observation errors without requiring the auxiliary mean to approximate the objective. We establish finite-sample GP confidence bounds and regret guarantees, including explicit cumulative and simple regret rates for Mat\'ern kernels. Numerical experiments across continuous BO benchmarks with varied landscapes and dimensions show consistent reductions in cumulative and simple regret relative to vanilla GP-UCB, even when within-pair correlation is moderate and the auxiliary mean is estimated from noisy offline data.
paper.title: Gaussian Process Bandits with Paired Auxiliary Observations

paper.abstract: We present \'{E}pi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. \'{E}pi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. \'{E}pi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, \'{E}pi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. We extend this research process to algorithmic coding with \'{E}pi-turbo, a lightweight configuration that develops executable solvers for tasks including vehicle routing, scheduling and production planning. On 30 FrontierOR tasks, \'{E}pi-turbo achieves a 5.4% higher total benchmark score than Codex at 64% of its model cost, using the same underlying model and reasoning effort. \'{E}pi is designed to support human understanding by connecting computational results to explicit methods and mathematical arguments that researchers can examine and build upon.
paper.title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research

analysis.analysis: 作者以热电机组-only MILP最优解为参照，在不同配置下对比PPO、动作分支DQN、按边际成本排序的merit-order规则的成本与开机台数，借此把性能差距拆解到“多开机组”这一结构现象；再通过细调阶段注入探索噪声、去掉奖励塑形项、在可比噪声下比较规则与智能体等对照，检验过度开机是否由探索驱动；最后以模仿MILP解初始化策略并保守微调，并将高置信决策固定为MILP变量，测量加速比与相对最优解的偏移，从而将策略诊断转化为求解器协同机制。

需要在加速MILP与保证近优解质量之间取得可控权衡

experiments: 在所有测试配置中，从零训练的PPO与动作分支DQN的开机台数约为热电机组-only MILP最优解的两倍，成本高39-64%

模仿MILP解并保守微调后，PPO成本进入最优解2.6%以内，且受罚成本在所有评估方法中最低（约5%）
固定微调策略的置信决策后，MILP加速3.8-8.5倍，解质量在最优解0.10-0.25%以内；最坏情形优于同等固定变量数的纯模仿策略（1.1%对8.9%）
调度方法与基准范围本身可使报告的最优性比例偏移最多3.6%和9%
基线包括merit-order规则与热电机组-only MILP；训练开销、实例规模扩展与公平计算预算的细节材料未说明
analysis.insight: 作者将RL相对MILP的差距主要归因于智能体自身的探索行为，而非仅仅是策略表达能力不足。核心机制是：当每台机组的开停机决策被独立采样时，随机停机会导致供能不足风险，策略因此倾向于多开冗余机组来“保险”，形成过度开机（over-commitment），并推高成本。由此，控制探索、注入结构化噪声、用MILP解进行模仿与保守微调能够收缩机组集合；反过来，训练后策略的高置信决策可固定为MILP的变量，从而在极小质量损失下加速精确求解。
limitations: 材料未说明作者明确陈述的局限；仅从摘要可见结论限于51机组72小时EPRI基准与热电机组-only MILP对照，跨规模、跨系统的泛化未经验证

analysis.relation_to_research: 论文直接研究机组组合这一电力生产调度核心问题，并给出“学习策略引导精确求解器”的协同范式：RL负责提供高置信的开停机决策以固定MILP变量，MILP保证可行性与近优性。这与智能优化中学习辅助搜索、神经网络与数学规划结合的路线高度一致。作者揭示的探索导致过度开机、模仿与保守微调纠偏的机制，可作为生产调度中“学习策略给组合决策、精确算法给时序与资源分配”的参考。迁移到柔性作业车间、流水车间、分布式制造或生产运输协同属于推测，需要满足：存在可固定为整数决策的高置信变量、有可用的MILP或约束规划作为精确后端、以及可重复的基准与公平计算预算口径；动态扰动与大模型智能体在本文中未被涉及。

analysis.title_zh: 在EPRI AI加速机组组合基准上的强化学习：诊断过度开机并用以学习策略引导MILP
analysis.uncertainty: 仅依据标题与摘要，无法核实网络结构、状态动作奖励的具体设计、训练预算、随机种子与统计显著性，也无法判断结论在更大规模或含网络约束、储能等扩展UC上的适用性；单位与机构信息缺失。
analysis.why_recommended: 该文不只报告RL在某基准上的表现，而是诊断出探索造成过度开机的具体机制，并把诊断结论转化为对MILP的可控加速手段，同时给出衡量加速与质量损失的对照实验和报告口径。对研究学习辅助搜索、约束可行性、求解质量与公平基准比较的博士生具有直接的方法论价值。

paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In the first study of RL on the 51-generator, 72-hour benchmark of the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition, we trace this gap to the agents' own exploration, close most of it, and show that the resulting policy can accelerate an exact solver. In every configuration tested, Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) and an action-branching Deep Q-Network (DQN) trained from scratch committed about twice the units of a thermal-only MILP optimum, at 39-64% higher cost, whereas a merit-order rule came within 1.6-7% (10-24% when unserved energy is priced). When each unit's decision is sampled independently, spare units insure against random de-commitments. Consistent with this, injecting exploration noise during fine-tuning enlarged a lean policy's fleet, a reward without shaping terms did not remove the over-commitment, and under their training noise the agents outperformed the rule subjected to comparable noise. Imitating the MILP solutions and fine-tuning conservatively brought PPO within 2.6% of the optimum, and these policies had the lowest penalised cost of any evaluated (about 5%). Fixing the fine-tuned policy's confident decisions made the MILP 3.8-8.5 times faster within 0.10-0.25% of the best solution, with a smaller worst case than an imitation-only policy fixing as many variables (1.1% against 8.9%). Because dispatch method and benchmark scope alone shift the reported optimality ratio by up to 3.6% and 9%, we propose a reporting protocol.
paper.title: Reinforcement learning on the EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment benchmark: diagnosing over-commitment and guiding MILP with learned policies

analysis.analysis: 作者将问题形式化为：从环境分布P采样e∈E=I×D×S，执行h得到损失ℓ(h;e)，失败设为固定惩罚ℓ_fail；总体目标为argmin_h CVaR_q(L_h)，其中CVaR_q(L)=inf_η{η+1/(1-q)E[(L-η)_+]}。作者论证均值聚合会忽略仅发生在不利评估条件子集上的失败，而CVaR通过在最差分位内取平均兼顾尾部强调与单点稳健性，并用实验验证其经验选择效果。
challenges: 平均适应度会掩盖稀有但严重的失败，使选择出的程序在分布漂移下不稳定
需在异构评估条件（实例族、规模、随机种子）上定义并公平估计尾部风险，样本有限
程序执行存在解析、编译、超时、不可行等失败模式，需统一映射为损失惩罚
如何在有限评估预算和代际预算下将尾部风险反馈给LLM提示，而不引入评估信息泄漏或过拟合
权衡量化尾部风险与保持平均性能竞争力
验证发现所得鲁棒性是否能迁移到更大未见过实例与独立整理的同域基准

evidence.claim: 论文提出用LLM变异可执行启发式程序、并以异构评估条件下的经验CVaR排序候选的风险敏感进化框架
evidence.quote: We propose CVaR-RMD, a risk-sensitive evolutionary framework that uses an LLM to mutate executable heuristic programs and ranks candidates by empirical conditional value-at-risk over heterogeneous evaluation conditions.

evidence.claim: 动机是基于均值的候选选择会掩盖稀有但严重的失败，导致跨实例族、随机种子和规模退化
evidence.quote: candidates selected by average performance may degrade across instance families, random seeds, and problem scales because mean-based objectives can obscure rare but severe failures.

evidence.claim: 在三个组合优化域上CVaR选择改善上尾性能并降低失败率，同时保持有竞争力的均值表现，且收益在更大未见实例与独立基准上持续
evidence.quote: Across three combinatorial optimization domains, CVaR-based selection improves upper-tail performance and reduces failure rates while maintaining competitive mean performance. These gains persist on larger unseen instances and independently curated within-domain benchmarks

evidence.claim: 基准包含在线装箱、CVRP与排列流水车间调度
evidence.quote: The benchmark suite covers online bin packing, capacitated vehicle routing (CVRP), and permutation flow-shop scheduling

evidence.claim: CVaR-RMD与Mean-RMD仅在候选排序准则上不同，其余流程相同
evidence.quote: They differ only in candidate ranking: empirical CVaR for CVaR-RMD and empirical mean loss for Mean-RMD.

evidence.claim: 作者明确陈述的局限包括仅三个任务与尾部水平q超参数
evidence.quote: The empirical evaluation focuses on three representative combinatorial optimization tasks, and further validation on additional problem classes would help assess the generality of the approach.

experiments: 基准覆盖在线装箱、容量约束车辆路径（CVRP）与排列流水车间调度三个组合优化域，分别对应在线决策、可行性约束和排序交互带来的脆弱性
每个方法使用15个独立发现种子{0,…,14}；发现后用各种子最佳存档程序在共享留出环境上评估，报告均值、标准差和标准化效应量，并用10,000次重采样的配对双侧bootstrap检验显著性；默认基线为Mean-RMD
发现阶段使用中等规模实例，留出测试覆盖分布内与更大规模的迁移以及独立整理的同域基准
摘要报告：CVaR选择提升上尾性能并降低失败率，同时保持有竞争力的平均性能，且收益在更大未见实例与独立整理基准上持续
消融涉及提示中是否包含累积损失与尾部记录、尾部水平q=0.80/0.95等设置；节选中表格数字不完整，无法可靠摘录具体数值，故不列举
基线、实例规模细节、约束可行性统计、运行时间、训练开销与公平计算预算的完整对比在提供的节选中材料未说明
analysis.insight: 贡献不在于引入新搜索结构，而在于重新定义候选排序的统计对象：把每个候选在由实例、规模、种子构成的异构评估环境上的损失视为随机变量，用经验CVaR（对最差1-q分位的平均损失）替代经验均值来驱动进化保留与提示构建。这样能在不改变代码接口、验证器、变异算子和预算的情况下，系统性地惩罚依赖有利评估条件的候选，抑制尾部灾难性失败，同时由于CVaR对分位内损失取平均，不会让单个极端观测主导排序。
limitations: 实证仅覆盖三个代表性组合优化任务，需在更多问题类上验证通用性
CVaR-RMD引入尾部水平q这一鲁棒性超参数，虽然单一默认值在实验中表现稳定，但最优取值可能随应用中对平均与最差性能权衡的偏好而变化
method: 把每个候选启发式表示为一个保持固定Python函数接口的可执行程序h；执行环境由实例i、规模d、随机种子s组成，损失为任务目标值，解析/编译/接口/超时/不可行失败统一记为ℓ_fail
采用进化式程序搜索：由LLM（GPT-4o，temperature 0.7，top-p 0.95，最大输出2048 token，格式错误至多重试3次）对父代程序做变异，生成完整Python函数
提示包含任务定义、所需函数签名、父代程序、验证约束以及其高损失案例的紧凑摘要，使搜索获得尾部失败信号
候选排序使用异构评估条件上的经验CVaR_q，而非经验均值；CVaR-RMD与Mean-RMD共享代码接口、验证器、变异算子、种群大小、代际预算、存档机制和留出评估，仅排序准则不同
流程为：生成/变异→在采样环境上执行并记录损失→按经验CVaR排序→保留存档并选择下一轮父代；LLM调用仅发生在发现阶段，测试阶段冻结最佳存档程序
analysis.motivation: 现有LLM迭代程序搜索（如FunSearch、EoH、ReEvo、LLaMEA）主要用有限评估得到的标量平均适应度来选择候选。平均目标会掩盖罕见但严重的失败，导致生成的启发式依赖特定评估协议（窄实例生成器、少量种子、受限规模），在实例族、随机种子和问题规模变化时退化。作者希望在不为发现流程增加复杂架构组件的前提下，把选择压力移向最差分位表现，从而提升域内迁移鲁棒性。
analysis.primary_topic: 大模型驱动的元启发式自动发现中的风险敏感选择机制
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文事实：该工作直接研究LLM驱动的元启发式自动发现，并在排列流水车间调度与CVRP等生产调度/物流优化任务上验证了风险敏感选择。与当前研究画像中的“大模型智能体、自动建模、学习辅助搜索”高度对接：它不改变搜索骨架，而是替换进化选择目标。推测（非作者结论）：可迁移到柔性作业车间、分布式制造与生产运输协同等问题的启发式/规则自动发现中，把实例族、规模、随机种子乃至动态扰动场景视为评估环境维度，用CVaR排序抑制对特定基准过拟合的规则；迁移所需条件是定义统一的程序接口与可行解验证器、构建覆盖扰动与规模漂移的环境采样分布，并在相同评估预算下与均值选择基线对比。
analysis.setting: 研究问题是在“域内迁移+基准分布漂移”条件下自动发现可执行的启发式程序：决策对象是一个满足指定调用接口的Python启发式程序h；目标是最小化损失的经验CVaR（尾部风险），而非仅最小化平均损失；关键约束包括程序需可解析、编译、满足接口、在时限内终止并返回可行解，否则记失败惩罚；信息假设是评估环境e=(i,d,s)由实例i、规模参数d、随机种子s组成，并从固定分布P采样，发现阶段仅能获得有限经验评估；环境是静态的实例分布与随机种子集合，但训练与测试之间存在实例族、规模和种子上的漂移。
analysis.title_zh: CVaR-RMD：面向鲁棒元启发式发现的CVaR选择压力
analysis.uncertainty: 提供的全文节选存在多处截断（如方法细节、表格数值、实验设置部分缺失），三个任务的具体数字、基线完整结果、运行时间与计算预算对比无法核实，因此实验结论主要依据摘要表述；作者未声称可迁移到柔性作业车间等更复杂调度场景，相关迁移为推测。
analysis.why_recommended: 对关注AI4OR与大模型自动算法设计的研究者，该文提供了一个低成本、机制清晰的改进点：在进化程序搜索中用CVaR替换均值选择，直接针对基准分布漂移下的尾部失败问题，且与现有FunSearch类流程兼容。其评估协议（多发现种子、冻结后留出测试、规模迁移、配对bootstrap检验）对生产调度中的智能算法可复现比较具有参考价值，也提示在调度规则自动发现中应关注最差场景而非平均表现。

figures.caption: Motivation for CVaR-RMD. Mean-based fitness in LLM-driven metaheuristic discovery rewards strong average performance while tolerating severe failures on rare instances or seeds. CVaR shifts selection pressure toward worst-quantile behavior, discouraging heuristics that depend on favorable evaluation conditions.
figures.label: Figure 1

paper.abstract: Large language models have recently been used to discover heuristics through iterative program search, offering a promising approach to automated algorithm design. However, candidates selected by average performance may degrade across instance families, random seeds, and problem scales because mean-based objectives can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose CVaR-RMD, a risk-sensitive evolutionary framework that uses an LLM to mutate executable heuristic programs and ranks candidates by empirical conditional value-at-risk over heterogeneous evaluation conditions. Across three combinatorial optimization domains, CVaR-based selection improves upper-tail performance and reduces failure rates while maintaining competitive mean performance. These gains persist on larger unseen instances and independently curated within-domain benchmarks
paper.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/BeyondHeaven/CVaR-RMD
paper.title: CVaR-RMD: CVaR Selection Pressure for Robust Metaheuristic Discovery

analysis.analysis: 作者从 FJSP 序列决策的结构出发，观察到相邻决策间全局状态变化有限，把状态分解为区间级表示状态与逐步可行性状态；用可行动作集递推式 A_t=f_mask(s^{feas}_{t-1},a_{t-1}) 说明掩码更新只改变可行动作范围而不修改状态特征；在区间边界用向量化重建函数 f_recon 一次性处理大部分特征，仅对具有严格顺序依赖的工序相对完工时间做顺序更新，从而在结构上分离表示刷新与可行性维护。材料未说明更形式化的下界或图论分析。
challenges: 区间级表示复用会造成表示陈旧，影响可行动作之间的排序质量
复用的同时仍需保证每一步构造的调度连续可行，需精确维护动态约束与可行动作集
区间边界需重建完整状态，其中相对完工时间存在严格顺序依赖，难以完全批量更新
区间长度如何选取缺乏自适应机制
加速幅度依赖图编码确实是推理成本的主要部分

evidence.claim: 论文将图表示刷新与可行性更新解耦，使编码次数由 T 降为 ⌈T/X⌉
evidence.quote: By reusing interval-level graph representations across consecutive scheduling decisions, CoRS reduces the number of graph encoding operations from T T to ⌈ T / X ⌉ \lceil T/X\rceil

evidence.claim: 现有神经 FJSP 求解器每步都刷新图表示，造成大量计算
evidence.quote: existing methods perform complete feature encoding for highly similar states, resulting in substantial computation and significantly degrading solution efficiency.

evidence.claim: 增强静态特征用于缓解区间状态重用导致的表示陈旧
evidence.quote: to alleviate representation staleness caused by interval-level state reuse, CoRS introduces enhanced static features as a compensation mechanism.

evidence.claim: 实验显示推理时间显著降低并保持有竞争力的解质量
evidence.quote: Extensive experiments on synthetic and multiple public FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that CoRS significantly reduces inference time while maintaining competitive solution quality

evidence.claim: 作者承认区间长度需人工选择且假设静态确定性 FJSP
evidence.quote: A current limitation is that the composite interval length is manually selected. The current method assumes a static deterministic FJSP and an exact stepwise feasibility tracker.

experiments: 在合成实例与多个公开 FJSP 基准上评测，报告推理时间显著降低且解质量具竞争力，在紧墙钟预算与低延迟场景下取得较好的速度—质量折中
表 2 考察区间长度 X∈{2,3,4,5} 与增强静态特征的交互：CoRS 在 G/S 两类数据上 Cmax 约 107.91–109.35 与 101.94–102.62；去掉增强静态特征后 Cmax 变差（G 约 108.89–113.56，S 约 102.34–109.63），说明复用时补偿特征重要
表 3 从 DANIEL 渐进到 DANIEL+CR 再到 CoRS：G 上 Cmax 1031.95→1044.98→1032.45，时间 0.912→0.307→0.213；S 上 Cmax 978.33→991.05→982.23，时间 3.25→1.118→0.895，显示 CR 机制大幅降时、增强特征部分挽回质量
材料未说明并行基线、训练开销与公平计算预算的具体细节
analysis.first_affiliation: 吉林大学计算机科学与技术学院
analysis.insight: 贡献有效的关键在于把调度状态按更新代价与更新必要性解耦为两个时间尺度：只需保证可行性在每步精确，昂贵但变化缓慢的图表示可以跨多个决策复用，从而把图编码次数从 T 降到 ⌈T/X⌉，在不减少动作生成步数、不放松约束的前提下摊薄编码开销；同时用显式动态可行性掩码和区间边界的完整状态重建来控制复用带来的表示陈旧误差。
limitations: 复合区间长度需人工选择
方法假设静态确定性的 FJSP 与精确的逐步可行性跟踪器
陈旧表示仍可能影响可行动作之间的排序
可获得的加速取决于图编码在推理成本中占主要比重
method: 两时间尺度状态演化（Composite Regressive 机制）：区间级图表示只在复合区间边界刷新，逐步可行性状态在每个动作后更新
复合区间解码算法：每步通过动态可行性掩码 f_mask 更新机器释放时间、候选工序及机器兼容关系、最早开始时间，屏蔽不可行动作
区间边界的状态同步：区间 B^τ 完成后，用 f_recon 以向量化方式重建下一输入状态，仅相对完工时间顺序更新
增强静态特征作为补偿机制，为模型提供更全面的问题结构信息，缓解表示陈旧
图编码产生机器与工序的全局表示并拼接为 h_global，供决策与价值评估
Actor–Critic 框架训练，拼接后的区间特征输入策略网络
analysis.motivation: 现有神经 FJSP 求解器在每次“工序—机器”决策后都重新刷新完整图表示并更新可行性，但相邻决策间全局状态变化有限，而图编码远比可行性更新昂贵。作者因此质疑“每步必须刷新表示”的隐含假设，希望在放宽约束、不并行化动作生成的前提下降低推理时间，满足大规模与低延迟调度需求。
analysis.primary_topic: 神经组合优化求解柔性作业车间调度（FJSP）的推理效率优化
analysis.relation_to_research: 论文直接研究柔性作业车间的神经求解方法，属于 AI4OR 与学习辅助搜索的核心方向；其“将昂贵的表示刷新与廉价的可行性更新解耦”的机制可迁移到其他序列决策式调度求解器。推测：迁移到生产运输协同、动态扰动或分布式制造时，需引入事件触发式状态重建以应对动态事件，并在多目标场景中验证表示陈旧对 Pareto 质量的影响；迁移到其他组合优化问题时需保证存在廉价且精确的可行性增量更新结构。
analysis.setting: 研究静态确定性柔性作业车间调度问题（FJSP）：决策对象是每步选择一道可加工工序及其加工机器，目标是最小化最大完工时间（Cmax，由实验表中Cmax列可推知），关键约束为工序优先关系、机器兼容性与释放时间等调度可行性约束；信息假设为调度状态以操作—机器图表示，需在每步决策后保持可行性精确；环境为静态确定性，不含动态扰动，且依赖精确的逐步可行性跟踪器。
analysis.title_zh: CoRS：通过复合区间状态重用来实现快速神经柔性作业车间调度
analysis.uncertainty: 仅获得摘要与部分全文节选，缺少完整实验设置、基线构成、训练细节与统计显著性，因此对实验结论的外部有效性判断有限；部分方法细节（如增强静态特征的具体构成）由片段推断，需核对原文。
analysis.why_recommended: 对关注神经调度求解器推理效率、公平计算预算与低延迟部署的研究者具有直接价值：它提出表示刷新频率这一被忽视的设计维度，给出可行性保持的解码与状态同步细节，并在公开 FJSP 基准上报告速度—质量折中，便于与并行自回归或非自回归方法对照，也提示了表示陈旧与区间长度自适应等可继续研究的问题。

paper.abstract: Neural solvers for the Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) typically refresh graph representations and update feasibility after every operation--machine decision. However, only feasibility must remain exact at every step, whereas graph encoding is substantially more expensive and can potentially be refreshed less frequently. We present CoRS, which decouples them: an interval-level graph representation is reused across multiple sequential decisions, while a stepwise feasibility state is updated after every action. This two-timescale design amortizes graph encoding without parallelizing action generation or relaxing scheduling constraints. CoRS further develops a feasibility-preserving composite-interval decoding scheme with dynamic constraint tracking and boundary state synchronization, which reduces representation refresh frequency while maintaining continuous feasible schedule construction. Furthermore, to alleviate representation staleness caused by interval-level state reuse, CoRS introduces enhanced static features as a compensation mechanism. By providing more comprehensive structural information of the scheduling problem, these features improve the model's perception of overall problem characteristics. Extensive experiments on synthetic and multiple public FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that CoRS significantly reduces inference time while maintaining competitive solution quality, achieving favorable speed-quality trade-offs under tight wall-clock budgets and low-latency scenarios.
paper.title: CoRS: Fast Neural Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling via Composite Interval State Reuse

analysis.motivation: 传统民用导航系统无法同时考虑实时交通变化与车辆特定约束，导致应急响应出现本可避免的关键延误，因此需要一套面向应急协调的约束感知实时路径规划系统。
analysis.primary_topic: 应急车辆动态路径规划中的约束感知实时求解
analysis.relation_to_research: 该论文研究城市应急车辆的动态路径规划，属于智能优化与调度中的路径决策问题，与生产调度中的动态扰动响应、约束可行性保障有结构相似性；其将经典搜索与约束满足结合的架构思路可迁移至带车辆/资源约束的调度路径子问题。但论文未涉及神经网络、强化学习、图神经网络、大模型智能体或学习辅助搜索，也未涉及柔性作业车间、流水车间或分布式制造等生产调度设定。若迁移到生产调度，推测需要重新定义约束满足模型、将工序/资源约束映射为 CSP，并验证在更大规模与更复杂动态扰动下的实时性与可行性，迁移效果尚未被作者验证。
analysis.setting: 研究面向城市环境中的警车、消防车和救护车等应急车辆，要求在动态交通环境下进行路径决策，目标是在尽可能短的时间内到达事件地点，同时满足车辆特定约束；摘要提及使用 OpenStreetMap 大都市路网数据和模拟动态交通场景进行评估，但事件时序、扰动分布、车辆约束的具体形式以及信息假设（如实时交通信息获取的完整性与延迟）材料未说明。
analysis.title_zh: CARRS：面向城市环境应急车辆的一种约束感知实时路径规划系统
analysis.uncertainty: 仅能依据标题与摘要判断，无法确认约束满足的具体建模方式、算法实现细节、基线设置、实例规模与统计严谨性；摘要中的性能数字缺少实验条件与对比基线说明，因此结论的泛化性存在较大不确定性。
analysis.why_recommended: 对关注动态扰动下的约束感知重规划、实时性与约束可行性权衡的研究者有参考价值：论文给出了经典搜索与约束满足融合的系统架构及初步性能指标，可作为生产运输协同或动态调度中路径决策模块的设计参照；同时其未使用学习方法，也提示可进一步探索学习辅助搜索在同类约束路径问题中的位置。

paper.abstract: Emergency vehicles such as police vehicles, fire engines, and ambulances require a stable and efficient route optimization to reach life-critical events in the shortest times possible. However, the dynamic nature of urban traffic makes this ideal scenario much more challenging, causing critical life-threatening delays. Traditional civilian navigation systems cannot account for real-time traffic changes alongside vehicle-specific constraints, creating inadequate routing scenarios. This research presents the Constraint-Aware Real-Time Routing System (CARRS), a unified software architecture tailored for emergency coordination. The CARRS architecture is engineered to fuse together classical pathfinding algorithms such as A*, Dijkstra, and Bidirectional A*, with Constraint Satisfaction Problem methodologies. The Design Science Research Methodology is the research framework, and prototyping is the iterative process. The artifact was empirically evaluated using OpenStreetMap data for major metropolitan road networks, combined with simulated dynamic traffic scenarios. Performance metrics focused on route optimality, constraint adherence, rerouting responsiveness, and the potential for future system scalability. Findings revealed the system's capability to generate optimal routes for operationally relevant subgraphs in under 35 seconds, with incremental rerouting responsiveness below 20 seconds. Furthermore, the system achieved more than 90% adherence to vehicle-specific constraints, making the CARRS architecture viable for real-time dynamic routing requirements. This study delivers a routing platform that bridges artificial intelligence-driven optimization with software engineering operational compliance, presenting a practical transformative step toward adaptive emergency vehicle coordination in dynamic urban environments.
paper.title: CARRS: A Constraint-Aware, Real-Time Routing System for Emergency Vehicles in Urban Environments
